If name is ‘-’, it makes the set of shell options local to the function in which local is invoked: any shell options changed using the set builtin inside the function after the call to local are restored to their original values when the function returns. The restore is performed as if a series of set commands were executed to restore the values that were in place before the function.
如果名称是‘ - ’，它会使 shell 选项仅对调用 local 的函数局部有效：在函数中使用 set 内置命令更改的任何 shell 选项，在调用 local 之后，当函数返回时会恢复为原来的值。恢复操作如同执行一系列 set 命令来恢复函数调用前的值一样进行。

With no operands, local writes a list of local variables to the standard output.
如果没有参数， local 会将局部变量列表写入标准输出。

The return status is zero unless local is used outside a function, an invalid name is supplied, or name is a readonly variable.
返回状态为零，除非在函数外部使用 local ，或者提供了无效的名称，或者名称是只读变量。

logout ¶
logout [n]

Exit a login shell, returning a status of n to the shell’s parent.
退出登录 shell，将状态 n 返回给 shell 的父进程。

mapfile ¶
mapfile [-d delim] [-n count] [-O origin] [-s count]
    [-t] [-u fd] [-C callback] [-c quantum] [array]

Read lines from the standard input, or from file descriptor fd if the -u option is supplied, into the indexed array variable array. The variable MAPFILE is the default array. Options, if supplied, have the following meanings:
从标准输入读取行，或者如果提供了 -u 选项，则从文件描述符 fd 读取，存入索引数组变量 array 中。变量 MAPFILE 是默认数组。如果提供了选项，其含义如下：

-d

Use the first character of delim to terminate each input line, rather than newline. If delim is the empty string, mapfile will terminate a line when it reads a NUL character.
使用 delim 的第一个字符来终止每一行输入，而不是换行符。如果 delim 是空字符串， mapfile 会在读取到 NUL 字符时终止一行。

-n

Copy at most count lines. If count is 0, copy all lines.
最多复制 count 行。如果 count 为 0，则复制所有行。

-O

Begin assigning to array at index origin. The default index is 0.
从索引 origin 开始将行赋值给数组。默认的索引是 0。

-s

Discard the first count lines read.
丢弃读取的第一个 count 行。

-t

Remove a trailing delim (default newline) from each line read.
从每行末尾删除 delim（默认换行符）。

-u

Read lines from file descriptor fd instead of the standard input.
从文件描述符 fd 读取行，而不是标准输入。

-C

Evaluate callback each time quantum lines are read. The -c option specifies quantum.
每次读取 quantum 行时评估回调函数。 -c 选项指定 quantum。

-c

Specify the number of lines read between each call to callback.
指定每次调用回调函数之间读取的行数。

If -C is specified without -c, the default quantum is 5000. When callback is evaluated, it is supplied the index of the next array element to be assigned and the line to be assigned to that element as additional arguments. callback is evaluated after the line is read but before the array element is assigned.
如果指定了 -C 但没有指定 -c ，则默认的量子值为 5000。当回调函数被求值时，会额外提供两个参数：即将被赋值的数组元素的索引以及要赋值给该元素的行。回调函数在读取行之后但在数组元素被赋值之前进行求值。

If not supplied with an explicit origin, mapfile will clear array before assigning to it.
如果没有提供显式的起始位置， mapfile 会在赋值之前清空数组。

mapfile returns zero unless an invalid option or option argument is supplied, array is invalid or unassignable, or if array is not an indexed array.
mapfile 返回零，除非提供了无效的选项或选项参数，数组无效或无法赋值，或者数组不是索引数组。

printf ¶
printf [-v var] format [arguments]

Write the formatted arguments to the standard output under the control of the format. The -v option assigns the output to the variable var rather than printing it to the standard output.
将格式化的参数按照格式输出到标准输出。 -v 选项将输出赋值给变量 var，而不是打印到标准输出。

The format is a character string which contains three types of objects: plain characters, which are simply copied to standard output, character escape sequences, which are converted and copied to the standard output, and format specifications, each of which causes printing of the next successive argument. In addition to the standard printf(3) format characters cCsSndiouxXeEfFgGaA, printf interprets the following additional format specifiers:
格式是一个字符字符串，其中包含三种类型的对象：普通字符，直接复制到标准输出；字符转义序列，被转换后复制到标准输出；以及格式说明符，每个格式说明符会导致下一个参数被打印。除了标准的 printf(3) 格式字符 cCsSndiouxXeEfFgGaA ， printf 还解释以下附加的格式说明符：

%b

Causes printf to expand backslash escape sequences in the corresponding argument in the same way as echo -e (see Bash Builtin Commands).
导致 printf 以与 echo -e 相同的方式在对应参数中展开反斜杠转义序列（参见 Bash 内置命令）。

%q

Causes printf to output the corresponding argument in a format that can be reused as shell input. %q and %QP use the ANSI-C quoting style (see ANSI-C Quoting) if any characters in the argument string require it, and backslash quoting otherwise. If the format string uses the printf alternate form, these two formats quote the argument string using single quotes.
导致 printf 以可被重新用作 shell 输入的格式输出对应参数。 %q 和 %Q P 会在参数字符串中需要时使用 ANSI-C 的引号风格（参见 ANSI-C 引用），否则使用反斜杠引号。如果格式字符串使用 printf 替代形式，这两个格式则使用单引号引用参数字符串。

%Q

like %q, but applies any supplied precision to the argument before quoting it.
类似 %q ，但会在引号之前对参数应用任何提供的精度。

%(datefmt)T

Causes printf to output the date-time string resulting from using datefmt as a format string for strftime(3). The corresponding argument is an integer representing the number of seconds since the epoch. This format specifier recognizes Two special argument values: -1 represents the current time, and -2 represents the time the shell was invoked. If no argument is specified, conversion behaves as if -1 had been supplied. This is an exception to the usual printf behavior.
导致 printf 输出由使用 datefmt 作为格式字符串对 strftime （3）进行格式化所得到的日期时间字符串。对应的参数是一个整数，表示自纪元以来的秒数。此格式说明符识别两个特殊参数值：-1 表示当前时间，-2 表示调用 shell 的时间。如果没有指定参数，转换行为将如同 -1 被提供一样。这是对通常 printf 行为的一个例外。

The %b, %q, and %T format specifiers all use the field width and precision arguments from the format specification and write that many bytes from (or use that wide a field for) the expanded argument, which usually contains more characters than the original.
%b、%q 和 %T 格式说明符都使用格式说明中的字段宽度和精度参数，并从（或使用该宽度的字段）扩展后的参数中写入相应数量的字节。通常，扩展后的参数包含比原始参数更多的字符。

The %n format specifier accepts a corresponding argument that is treated as a shell variable name.
%n 格式说明符接受一个对应的参数，该参数被当作 shell 变量名来处理。

The %s and %c format specifiers accept an l (long) modifier, which forces them to convert the argument string to a wide-character string and apply any supplied field width and precision in terms of characters, not bytes. The %S and %C format specifiers are equivalent to %ls and %lc, respectively.
%s 和 %c 格式说明符接受一个 l（长）修饰符，这会强制它们将参数字符串转换为宽字符字符串，并以字符而非字节为单位应用任何提供的字段宽度和精度。%S 和 %C 格式说明符分别等同于 %ls 和 %lc。

Arguments to non-string format specifiers are treated as C language constants, except that a leading plus or minus sign is allowed, and if the leading character is a single or double quote, the value is the numeric value of the following character, using the current locale.
非字符串格式指定符的参数被视为 C 语言常量，除了允许有前导加号或减号外，如果前导字符是单引号或双引号，则值为后续字符的数值，使用当前区域设置。

The format is reused as necessary to consume all of the arguments. If the format requires more arguments than are supplied, the extra format specifications behave as if a zero value or null string, as appropriate, had been supplied. The return value is zero on success, non-zero if an invalid option is supplied or a write or assignment error occurs.
格式会在必要时被重复使用以消耗所有参数。如果格式需要的参数多于提供的参数，则多余的格式说明符将被视为提供了零值或空字符串，视情况而定。成功时返回零，若提供无效选项或发生写入或赋值错误则返回非零值。

read ¶
read [-Eers] [-a aname] [-d delim] [-i text] [-n nchars]
    [-N nchars] [-p prompt] [-t timeout] [-u fd] [name ...]

Read one line from the standard input, or from the file descriptor fd supplied as an argument to the -u option, split it into words as described above in Word Splitting, and assign the first word to the first name, the second word to the second name, and so on. If there are more words than names, the remaining words and their intervening delimiters are assigned to the last name. If there are fewer words read from the input stream than names, the remaining names are assigned empty values. The characters in the value of the IFS variable are used to split the line into words using the same rules the shell uses for expansion (described above in Word Splitting). The backslash character ‘\’ removes any special meaning for the next character read and is used for line continuation.
从标准输入读取一行，或从作为 -u 选项参数提供的文件描述符 fd 中读取，按照上面在单词分割部分所述的方式将其分割成单词，并将第一个单词赋值给第一个名称，第二个单词赋值给第二个名称，依此类推。如果单词数量多于名称数量，剩余的单词及其间隔的分隔符将被赋值给最后一个名称。如果从输入流中读取的单词数量少于名称数量，剩余的名称将被赋空值。 IFS 变量中的字符用于按照 shell 用于展开的相同规则将行分割成单词（如上文单词分割部分所述）。反斜杠字符‘ \ ’会移除下一个字符的特殊含义，并用于行继续。

Options, if supplied, have the following meanings:
如果提供了选项，其含义如下：

-a aname

The words are assigned to sequential indices of the array variable aname, starting at 0. All elements are removed from aname before the assignment. Other name arguments are ignored.
单词被依次赋值给数组变量 aname 的索引，从 0 开始。在赋值之前，会将 aname 的所有元素清除。其他名称参数将被忽略。

-d delim

The first character of delim terminates the input line, rather than newline. If delim is the empty string, read will terminate a line when it reads a NUL character.
delim 的第一个字符用于终止输入行，而不是换行符。如果 delim 为空字符串， read 会在读取到 NUL 字符时终止行。

-e

If the standard input is coming from a terminal, read uses Readline (see Command Line Editing) to obtain the line. Readline uses the current (or default, if line editing was not previously active) editing settings, but uses Readline’s default filename completion.
如果标准输入来自终端， read 使用 Readline（参见命令行编辑）来获取行。Readline 使用当前（如果之前未激活行编辑，则使用默认）的编辑设置，但使用 Readline 的默认文件名补全功能。

-E

If the standard input is coming from a terminal, read uses Readline (see Command Line Editing) to obtain the line. Readline uses the current (or default, if line editing was not previously active) editing settings, but uses Bash’s default completion, including programmable completion.
如果标准输入来自终端， read 使用 Readline（参见命令行编辑）来获取行。Readline 使用当前（如果之前未激活行编辑，则使用默认）的编辑设置，但使用 Bash 的默认补全功能，包括可编程补全。

-i text

If Readline is being used to read the line, read places text into the editing buffer before editing begins.
如果使用 Readline 来读取行， read 在编辑开始前将文本放入编辑缓冲区中。

-n nchars

read returns after reading nchars characters rather than waiting for a complete line of input, unless it encounters EOF or read times out, but honors a delimiter if it reads fewer than nchars characters before the delimiter.
read 在读取 nchars 个字符后返回，而不是等待完整的输入行，除非遇到 EOF 或 read 超时，但如果在遇到分隔符前读取的字符少于 nchars，则会尊重该分隔符。

-N nchars

read returns after reading exactly nchars characters rather than waiting for a complete line of input, unless it encounters EOF or read times out. Delimiter characters in the input are not treated specially and do not cause read to return until it has read nchars characters. The result is not split on the characters in IFS; the intent is that the variable is assigned exactly the characters read (with the exception of backslash; see the -r option below).
read 在读取了正好 nchars 个字符后返回，而不是等待完整的输入行，除非遇到 EOF 或 read 超时。输入中的分隔符字符不会被特别处理，直到读取了 nchars 个字符后才会导致 read 返回。结果不会根据 IFS 中的字符进行分割；意图是变量被赋值正好是读取的字符（除了反斜杠；参见下面的 -r 选项）。

-p prompt

Display prompt, without a trailing newline, before attempting to read any input, but only if input is coming from a terminal.
在尝试读取任何输入之前显示提示符，但不带换行符，但仅当输入来自终端时才这样做。

-r

If this option is given, backslash does not act as an escape character. The backslash is considered to be part of the line. In particular, a backslash-newline pair may not then be used as a line continuation.
如果此选项被指定，反斜杠不会作为转义字符起作用。反斜杠被视为行的一部分。特别是，反斜杠换行符对将不能再用作行延续。

-s

Silent mode. If input is coming from a terminal, characters are not echoed.
静默模式。如果输入来自终端，字符不会被回显。

-t timeout

Cause read to time out and return failure if it does not read a complete line of input (or a specified number of characters) within timeout seconds. timeout may be a decimal number with a fractional portion following the decimal point. This option is only effective if read is reading input from a terminal, pipe, or other special file; it has no effect when reading from regular files. If read times out, it saves any partial input read into the specified variable name, and returns a status greater than 128. If timeout is 0, read returns immediately, without trying to read any data. In this case, the exit status is 0 if input is available on the specified file descriptor, or the read will return EOF, non-zero otherwise.
导致 read 在 timeout 秒内没有读取到完整的一行输入（或指定数量的字符）时超时并返回失败。timeout 可以是一个带有小数部分的十进制数。此选项只有在 read 从终端、管道或其他特殊文件读取输入时才有效；从普通文件读取时无效。如果 read 超时，它会将已读取的任何部分输入保存到指定的变量名中，并返回一个大于 128 的状态码。如果 timeout 为 0， read 会立即返回，而不会尝试读取任何数据。在这种情况下，如果指定文件描述符上有输入，则退出状态为 0，否则为非零。

-u fd

Read input from file descriptor fd instead of the standard input.
从文件描述符 fd 读取输入，而不是从标准输入。

Other than the case where delim is the empty string, read ignores any NUL characters in the input.
除非 delim 是空字符串，否则 read 会忽略输入中的任何 NUL 字符。

If no names are supplied, read assigns the line read, without the ending delimiter but otherwise unmodified, to the variable REPLY.
如果没有提供变量名， read 将读取的行赋值给变量 REPLY ，不包含结尾的分隔符，但其他部分保持不变。

The exit status is zero, unless end-of-file is encountered, read times out (in which case the status is greater than 128), a variable assignment error (such as assigning to a readonly variable) occurs, or an invalid file descriptor is supplied as the argument to -u.
退出状态为零，除非遇到文件结尾， read 超时（此时状态大于 128），发生变量赋值错误（例如，将值赋给只读变量），或者向 -u 传递了无效的文件描述符。

readarray ¶
readarray [-d delim] [-n count] [-O origin] [-s count]
    [-t] [-u fd] [-C callback] [-c quantum] [array]

Read lines from the standard input into the indexed array variable array, or from file descriptor fd if the -u option is supplied.
从标准输入读取行到索引数组变量 array 中，或者如果提供了 -u 选项，则从文件描述符 fd 中读取。

A synonym for mapfile.
mapfile 的同义词。

source ¶
source [-p path] filename [arguments]

A synonym for . (see Bourne Shell Builtins).
. 的同义词（参见 Bourne Shell Builtins）。

type ¶
type [-afptP] [name ...]

Indicate how each name would be interpreted if used as a command name.
指示每个名称如果作为命令名称使用时会被如何解释。

If the -t option is used, type prints a single word which is one of ‘alias’, ‘keyword’, ‘function’, ‘builtin’, or ‘file’, if name is an alias, shell reserved word, shell function, shell builtin, or executable file, respectively. If the name is not found, type prints nothing and returns a failure status.
如果使用 -t 选项， type 会打印一个单词，该单词为 ‘ alias ’、‘ keyword ’、‘ function ’、‘ builtin ’ 或 ‘ file ’，分别对应名称是别名、shell 保留字、shell 函数、shell 内置命令或可执行文件的情况。如果名称未找到， type 会打印空内容并返回失败状态。

If the -p option is used, type either returns the name of the executable file that would be found by searching $PATH for name, or nothing if -t would not return ‘file’.
如果使用 -p 选项， type 会返回在 $PATH 中搜索 name 所找到的可执行文件的名称，如果 -t 不会返回 ‘ file ’，则打印空内容。

The -P option forces a path search for each name, even if -t would not return ‘file’.
-P 选项强制对每个名称进行路径搜索，即使 -t 不会返回 ‘ file ’。

If a name is present in the table of hashed commands, options -p and -P print the hashed value, which is not necessarily the file that appears first in $PATH.
如果一个名称存在于哈希命令表中，选项 -p 和 -P 会打印出该名称的哈希值，这不一定是 $PATH 中首先出现的文件。

If the -a option is used, type returns all of the places that contain a command named name. This includes aliases, reserved words, functions, and builtins, but the path search options (-p and -P) can be supplied to restrict the output to executable files. If -a is supplied with -p, type does not look in the table of hashed commands, and only performs a PATH search for name.
如果使用 -a 选项， type 会返回所有包含名为 name 的命令的位置。这包括别名、保留字、函数和内置命令，但可以通过提供路径搜索选项（ -p 和 -P ）来限制输出仅限于可执行文件。如果 -a 与 -p 一起使用， type 不会在哈希命令表中查找，而只执行 PATH 搜索来查找 name。

If the -f option is used, type does not attempt to find shell functions, as with the command builtin.
如果使用 -f 选项， type 不会尝试查找 shell 函数，如同 command 内置命令一样。

The return status is zero if all of the names are found, non-zero if any are not found.
如果所有名称都被找到，返回状态为零；如果任何一个名称未被找到，返回状态为非零。

typeset ¶
typeset [-afFgrxilnrtux] [-p] [name[=value] ...]

The typeset command is supplied for compatibility with the Korn shell. It is a synonym for the declare builtin command.
typeset 命令是为了与 Korn shell 兼容而提供的。它等同于 declare 内置命令。

ulimit ¶
ulimit [-HS] -a
ulimit [-HS] [-bcdefiklmnpqrstuvxPRT] [limit]

ulimit provides control over the resources available to the shell and to processes it starts, on systems that allow such control. If an option is given, it is interpreted as follows:
ulimit 用于控制 shell 及其启动的进程可使用的资源，在允许此类控制的系统上。如果指定了选项，则解释如下：

-S

Change and report the soft limit associated with a resource.
更改并报告与某一资源相关的软限制。

-H

Change and report the hard limit associated with a resource.
更改并报告与某一资源相关的硬限制。

-a

Report all current limits; no limits are set.
报告所有当前的限制；不设置任何限制。

-b

The maximum socket buffer size.
最大套接字缓冲区大小。

-c

The maximum size of core files created.
生成的核心文件的最大大小。

-d

The maximum size of a process’s data segment.
进程的数据段的最大大小。

-e

The maximum scheduling priority ("nice").
最大调度优先级("nice")。

-f

The maximum size of files written by the shell and its children.
shell 及其子进程可以写入的最大文件大小。

-i

The maximum number of pending signals.
待处理信号的最大数量。

-k

The maximum number of kqueues that may be allocated.
可以分配的最大 kqueues 数量。

-l

The maximum size that may be locked into memory.
可以锁定到内存中的最大大小。

-m

The maximum resident set size (many systems do not honor this limit).
最大驻留集大小（许多系统不承认此限制）。

-n

The maximum number of open file descriptors (most systems do not allow this value to be set).
最大打开文件描述符数量（大多数系统不允许设置此值）。

-p

The pipe buffer size.
管道缓冲区大小。

-q

The maximum number of bytes in POSIX message queues.
POSIX 消息队列中的最大字节数。

-r

The maximum real-time scheduling priority.
实时调度优先级的最大值。

-s

The maximum stack size.
最大堆栈大小。

-t

The maximum amount of cpu time in seconds.
最大 CPU 时间，以秒为单位。

-u

The maximum number of processes available to a single user.
单个用户可拥有的最大进程数。

-v

The maximum amount of virtual memory available to the shell, and, on some systems, to its children.
shell 可以使用的最大虚拟内存数量，以及在某些系统上，其子进程也可以使用的最大虚拟内存数量。

-x

The maximum number of file locks.
文件锁的最大数量。

-P

The maximum number of pseudoterminals.
伪终端的最大数量。

-R

The maximum time a real-time process can run before blocking, in microseconds.
实时进程在被阻塞之前可以运行的最大时间，以微秒为单位。

-T

The maximum number of threads.
最大线程数。

If limit is supplied, and the -a option is not used, limit is the new value of the specified resource. The special limit values hard, soft, and unlimited stand for the current hard limit, the current soft limit, and no limit, respectively. A hard limit cannot be increased by a non-root user once it is set; a soft limit may be increased up to the value of the hard limit. Otherwise, ulimit prints the current value of the soft limit for the specified resource, unless the -H option is supplied. When more than one resource is specified, the limit name and unit, if appropriate, are printed before the value. When setting new limits, if neither -H nor -S is supplied, ulimit sets both the hard and soft limits. If no option is supplied, then -f is assumed.
如果指定了 limit 值，并且没有使用 -a 选项，那么 limit 就是所指定资源的新值。特殊限制值 hard 、 soft 和 unlimited 分别代表当前硬限制、当前软限制和无限制。一旦硬限制被设置，非 root 用户就无法将其增加；软限制可以增加到硬限制的值。否则， ulimit 会打印所指定资源的当前软限制值，除非指定了 -H 选项。当指定多个资源时，会在值之前打印限制名称和单位（如果适用）。当设置新的限制时，如果既没有指定 -H 也没有指定 -S ，则 ulimit 会同时设置硬限制和软限制。如果没有指定任何选项，则 -f 被假定为默认值。

Values are in 1024-byte increments, except for -t, which is in seconds; -R, which is in microseconds; -p, which is in units of 512-byte blocks; -P, -T, -b, -k, -n and -u, which are unscaled values; and, when in POSIX mode (see Bash and POSIX), -c and -f, which are in 512-byte increments.
数值以 1024 字节为单位递增，除了 -t 以秒为单位； -R 以微秒为单位； -p 以 512 字节块为单位； -P 、 -T 、 -b 、 -k 、 -n 和 -u 是未缩放的值；在 POSIX 模式下（参见 Bash 和 POSIX）， -c 和 -f 以 512 字节为单位递增。

The return status is zero unless an invalid option or argument is supplied, or an error occurs while setting a new limit.
返回状态为零，除非提供了无效的选项或参数，或者在设置新的限制时发生错误。

unalias ¶
unalias [-a] [name ... ]

Remove each name from the list of aliases. If -a is supplied, remove all aliases. The return value is true unless a supplied name is not a defined alias. Aliases are described in Aliases.
从别名列表中删除每个名称。如果提供了 -a ，则删除所有别名。返回值为真，除非提供的名称不是已定义的别名。别名的描述请参见 Aliases。

Next: Special Builtins, Previous: Bash Builtin Commands, Up: Shell Builtin Commands   [Contents][Index]

4.3 Modifying Shell Behavior ¶
4.3 修改 Shell 行为 ¶

  • The Set Builtin
  • The Shopt Builtin

Next: The Shopt Builtin, Up: Modifying Shell Behavior   [Contents][Index]

4.3.1 The Set Builtin ¶

This builtin is so complicated that it deserves its own section. set allows you to change the values of shell options and set the positional parameters, or to display the names and values of shell variables.
这个内置命令非常复杂，值得拥有自己的一个章节。 set 允许你更改 shell 选项的值，设置位置参数，或者显示 shell 变量的名称和值。

set ¶
set [-abefhkmnptuvxBCEHPT] [-o option-name] [--] [-] [argument ...]
set [+abefhkmnptuvxBCEHPT] [+o option-name] [--] [-] [argument ...]
set -o
set +o

If no options or arguments are supplied, set displays the names and values of all shell variables and functions, sorted according to the current locale, in a format that may be reused as input for setting or resetting the currently-set variables. Read-only variables cannot be reset. In POSIX mode, only shell variables are listed.
如果没有提供选项或参数， set 会按照当前区域设置，以一种可以重新用于设置或重置当前变量的格式，显示所有 shell 变量和函数的名称及值。只读变量不能被重置。在 POSIX 模式下，仅列出 shell 变量。

When options are supplied, they set or unset shell attributes. Any arguments remaining after option processing replace the positional parameters.
当提供选项时，它们会设置或取消设置 shell 属性。在处理完选项后，任何剩余的参数会替换位置参数。

Options, if specified, have the following meanings:
如果指定了选项，它们的含义如下：

-a

Each variable or function that is created or modified is given the export attribute and marked for export to the environment of subsequent commands.
每个被创建或修改的变量或函数都会被赋予 export 属性，并被标记以便导出到后续命令的环境中。

-b

Cause the status of terminated background jobs to be reported immediately, rather than before printing the next primary prompt or, under some circumstances, when a foreground command exits. This is effective only when job control is enabled.
立即报告已终止的后台作业的状态，而不是在打印下一个主要提示符之前，或者在某些情况下，当前台命令退出时。这仅在启用了作业控制时才有效。

-e

Exit immediately if a pipeline (see Pipelines), which may consist of a single simple command (see Simple Commands), a list (see Lists of Commands), or a compound command (see Compound Commands) returns a non-zero status. The shell does not exit if the command that fails is part of the command list immediately following a while or until reserved word, part of the test in an if statement, part of any command executed in a && or || list except the command following the final && or ||, any command in a pipeline but the last (subject to the state of the pipefail shell option), or if the command’s return status is being inverted with !. If a compound command other than a subshell returns a non-zero status because a command failed while -e was being ignored, the shell does not exit. A trap on ERR, if set, is executed before the shell exits.
如果管道（见 Pipelines）返回非零状态，立即退出。管道可能由一个简单命令（见 Simple Commands）、一个命令列表（见 Lists of Commands）或一个复合命令（见 Compound Commands）组成。如果失败的命令是以下情况之一，则 shell 不会退出：位于 while 或 until 保留字之后的命令列表中的一部分、在 if 语句中的测试部分、在 && 或 || 列表中执行的任何命令（除了最终 && 或 || 之后的命令），或者在管道中的除最后一个命令以外的命令（取决于 pipefail shell 选项的状态），或者当命令的返回状态被 ! 反转时。如果复合命令（除子 shell 外）因为忽略 -e 而返回非零状态，shell 也不会退出。如果设置了 ERR 的陷阱，会在 shell 退出前执行。

This option applies to the shell environment and each subshell environment separately (see Command Execution Environment), and may cause subshells to exit before executing all the commands in the subshell.
此选项适用于 shell 环境及其每个子 shell 环境（参见命令执行环境），可能导致子 shell 在执行完子 shell 中的所有命令之前退出。

If a compound command or shell function executes in a context where -e is being ignored, none of the commands executed within the compound command or function body will be affected by the -e setting, even if -e is set and a command returns a failure status. If a compound command or shell function sets -e while executing in a context where -e is ignored, that setting will not have any effect until the compound command or the command containing the function call completes.
如果复合命令或 shell 函数在忽略 -e 的上下文中执行，那么在复合命令或函数体中执行的任何命令都不会受到 -e 设置的影响，即使 -e 被设置并且某个命令返回失败状态也是如此。如果复合命令或 shell 函数在忽略 -e 的上下文中执行时设置了 -e ，那么该设置在复合命令或包含函数调用的命令执行完毕之前不会产生任何效果。

-f

Disable filename expansion (globbing).
禁用文件名展开（globbing）。

-h

Locate and remember (hash) commands as they are looked up for execution. This option is enabled by default.
定位并记住（哈希）命令，以便在执行时查找。此选项默认启用。

-k

All arguments in the form of assignment statements are placed in the environment for a command, not just those that precede the command name.
所有以赋值语句形式出现的参数都会被放置到命令的环境中，而不仅仅是那些在命令名之前的参数。

-m

Job control is enabled (see Job Control). All processes run in a separate process group. When a background job completes, the shell prints a line containing its exit status.
启用作业控制（参见作业控制）。所有进程都在独立的进程组中运行。当一个后台作业完成时，shell 会打印一行包含其退出状态的信息。

-n

Read commands but do not execute them. This may be used to check a script for syntax errors. This option is ignored by interactive shells.
读取命令但不执行它们。这可以用来检查脚本中的语法错误。此选项被交互式 shell 忽略。

-o option-name

Set the option corresponding to option-name. If -o is supplied with no option-name, set prints the current shell options settings. If +o is supplied with no option-name, set prints a series of set commands to recreate the current option settings on the standard output. Valid option names are:
设置对应于 option-name 的选项。如果 -o 未指定 option-name，则 set 会打印当前 shell 的选项设置。如果 +o 未指定 option-name，则 set 会打印一系列 set 命令到标准输出，以重新创建当前的选项设置。有效的选项名称包括：

allexport

Same as -a.
与 -a 相同。

braceexpand

Same as -B.
与 -B 相同。

emacs

Use an emacs-style line editing interface (see Command Line Editing). This also affects the editing interface used for read -e.
使用 emacs 风格的行编辑接口（参见命令行编辑）。这同样影响用于 read -e 的编辑接口。

errexit

Same as -e.
与 -e 相同。

errtrace

Same as -E.
与 -E 相同。

functrace

Same as -T.
与 -T 相同。

hashall

Same as -h.
与 -h 相同。

histexpand

Same as -H.
与 -H 相同。

history

Enable command history, as described in Bash History Facilities. This option is on by default in interactive shells.
启用命令历史记录，如 Bash History Facilities 中所述。此选项在交互式 shell 中默认是开启的。

ignoreeof

An interactive shell will not exit upon reading EOF.
交互式 shell 在读取 EOF 后不会退出。

keyword

Same as -k.
与 -k 相同。

monitor

Same as -m.
与 -m 相同。

noclobber

Same as -C.
与 -C 相同。

noexec

Same as -n.
与 -n 相同。

noglob

Same as -f.
与 -f 相同。

nolog

Currently ignored.   当前被忽略。

notify

Same as -b.
与 -b 相同。

nounset

Same as -u.
与 -u 相同。

onecmd

Same as -t.
与 -t 相同。

physical

Same as -P.
与 -P 相同。

pipefail

If set, the return value of a pipeline is the value of the last (rightmost) command to exit with a non-zero status, or zero if all commands in the pipeline exit successfully. This option is disabled by default.
如果设置，管道的返回值是管道中最后一个（最右边）退出状态非零的命令的返回值，或者如果管道中所有命令都成功退出，则为零。此选项默认是禁用的。

posix

Enable POSIX mode; change the behavior of Bash where the default operation differs from the POSIX standard to match the standard (see Bash and POSIX). This is intended to make Bash behave as a strict superset of that standard.
启用 POSIX 模式；将 Bash 的行为在默认操作与 POSIX 标准不同时，改为符合标准（参见 Bash 和 POSIX）。这旨在使 Bash 的行为成为该标准的严格超集。

privileged

Same as -p.
与 -p 相同。

verbose

Same as -v.
与 -v 相同。

vi

Use a vi-style line editing interface. This also affects the editing interface used for read -e.
使用 vi 风格的行编辑接口。这同样会影响 read -e 所使用的编辑接口。

xtrace

Same as -x.
与 -x 相同。

-p

Turn on privileged mode. In this mode, the $BASH_ENV and $ENV files are not processed, shell functions are not inherited from the environment, and the SHELLOPTS, BASHOPTS, CDPATH and GLOBIGNORE variables, if they appear in the environment, are ignored. If the shell is started with the effective user (group) id not equal to the real user (group) id, and the -p option is not supplied, these actions are taken and the effective user id is set to the real user id. If the -p option is supplied at startup, the effective user id is not reset. Turning this option off causes the effective user and group ids to be set to the real user and group ids.
启用特权模式。在此模式下， $BASH_ENV 和 $ENV 文件不会被处理，shell 函数不会从环境中继承，如果环境中有 SHELLOPTS 、 BASHOPTS 、 CDPATH 和 GLOBIGNORE 变量，它们将被忽略。如果 shell 以有效用户（组）ID 不等于真实用户（组）ID 的方式启动，并且没有提供 -p 选项，那么将执行这些操作并将有效用户 ID 设置为真实用户 ID。如果在启动时提供了 -p 选项，则不会重置有效用户 ID。关闭此选项会导致有效用户和组 ID 被设置为真实用户和组 ID。

-r

Enable restricted shell mode (see The Restricted Shell). This option cannot be unset once it has been set.
启用受限 shell 模式（参见受限 Shell）。一旦设置了此选项，就无法取消设置。

-t

Exit after reading and executing one command.
执行完一条命令后退出。

-u

Treat unset variables and parameters other than the special parameters ‘@’ or ‘*’, or array variables subscripted with ‘@’ or ‘*’, as an error when performing parameter expansion. An error message will be written to the standard error, and a non-interactive shell will exit.
在进行参数扩展时，将未设置的变量和参数（除特殊参数 ‘ @ ’ 或 ‘ * ’，或使用 ‘ @ ’ 或 ‘ * ’ 下标访问的数组变量外）视为错误。会将错误信息写入标准错误，并且非交互式 shell 会退出。

-v

Print shell input lines to standard error as they are read.
将 shell 输入行输出到标准错误，当它们被读取时。

-x

Print a trace of simple commands, for commands, case commands, select commands, and arithmetic for commands and their arguments or associated word lists to the standard error after they are expanded and before they are executed. The shell prints the expanded value of the PS4 variable before the command and its expanded arguments.
在命令被展开但尚未执行之前，将简单命令、 for 命令、 case 命令、 select 命令和算术 for 命令及其参数或相关单词列表的跟踪信息输出到标准错误。shell 会在命令及其展开参数之前输出 PS4 变量的展开值。

-B

The shell will perform brace expansion (see Brace Expansion). This option is on by default.
shell 将执行花括号展开（参见花括号展开）。此选项默认开启。

-C

Prevent output redirection using ‘>’, ‘>&’, and ‘<>’ from overwriting existing files. Using the redirection operator ‘>|’ instead of ‘>’ will override this and force the creation of an output file.
防止使用‘ > ’、‘ >& ’和‘ <> ’进行输出重定向时覆盖现有文件。使用重定向操作符‘ >| ’代替‘ > ’将覆盖此设置并强制创建输出文件。

-E

If set, any trap on ERR is inherited by shell functions, command substitutions, and commands executed in a subshell environment. The ERR trap is normally not inherited in such cases.
如果设置，任何在 ERR 上的陷阱都会被 shell 函数、命令替换以及在子 shell 环境中执行的命令继承。 ERR 陷阱通常不会在这些情况下被继承。

-H

Enable ‘!’ style history substitution (see History Expansion). This option is on by default for interactive shells.
启用‘ ! ’风格的历史替换（参见 History Expansion）。此选项在交互式 shell 中默认是开启的。

-P

If set, Bash does not resolve symbolic links when executing commands such as cd which change the current directory. It uses the physical directory structure instead. By default, Bash follows the logical chain of directories when performing commands which change the current directory.
如果设置，Bash 在执行如 cd 之类的改变当前目录的命令时，不会解析符号链接。它会使用物理目录结构。默认情况下，Bash 在执行改变当前目录的命令时会遵循逻辑目录链。

For example, if /usr/sys is a symbolic link to /usr/local/sys then:
例如，如果 /usr/sys 是一个指向 /usr/local/sys 的符号链接，那么：

$ cd /usr/sys; echo $PWD
/usr/sys
$ cd ..; pwd
/usr

If set -P is on, then:
如果 set -P 开启，则： 

$ cd /usr/sys; echo $PWD
/usr/local/sys
$ cd ..; pwd
/usr/local
-T

If set, any traps on DEBUG and RETURN are inherited by shell functions, command substitutions, and commands executed in a subshell environment. The DEBUG and RETURN traps are normally not inherited in such cases.
如果设置，那么 DEBUG 和 RETURN 上的任何陷阱都会被 shell 函数、命令替换以及在子 shell 环境中执行的命令继承。 DEBUG 和 RETURN 陷阱通常不会在这种情况下被继承。

--

If no arguments follow this option, unset the positional parameters. Otherwise, the positional parameters are set to the arguments, even if some of them begin with a ‘-’.
如果没有跟随此选项的参数，则取消位置参数。否则，位置参数将被设置为这些参数，即使其中一些参数以‘ - ’开头。

-

Signal the end of options, and assign all remaining arguments to the positional parameters. The -x and -v options are turned off. If there are no arguments, the positional parameters remain unchanged.
表示选项结束，并将所有剩余参数分配给位置参数。 -x 和 -v 选项将被关闭。如果没有参数，则位置参数保持不变。

Using ‘+’ rather than ‘-’ causes these options to be turned off. The options can also be used upon invocation of the shell. The current set of options may be found in $-.
使用‘ + ’而不是‘ - ’会导致这些选项被关闭。这些选项也可以在调用 shell 时使用。当前的选项集合可以在 $- 中找到。

The remaining N arguments are positional parameters and are assigned, in order, to $1, $2, … $N. The special parameter # is set to N.
剩下的 N 个参数是位置参数，并按顺序分配给 $1 、 $2 、… $N 。特殊参数 # 被设置为 N。

The return status is always zero unless an invalid option is supplied.
返回状态总是零，除非提供了无效的选项。

Previous: The Set Builtin, Up: Modifying Shell Behavior   [Contents][Index]

4.3.2 The Shopt Builtin ¶

This builtin allows you to change additional optional shell behavior.
这个内置命令允许你更改其他可选的 shell 行为。

shopt ¶
shopt [-pqsu] [-o] [optname ...]

Toggle the values of settings controlling optional shell behavior. The settings can be either those listed below, or, if the -o option is used, those available with the -o option to the set builtin command (see The Set Builtin).
切换控制可选 shell 行为的设置值。这些设置可以是下列列出的选项，或者，如果使用了 -o 选项，则是通过 -o 选项传递给 set 内置命令可用的选项（参见 Set 内置命令）。

With no options, or with the -p option, display a list of all settable options, with an indication of whether or not each is set; if any optnames are supplied, the output is restricted to those options. The -p option displays output in a form that may be reused as input.
如果没有选项，或使用 -p 选项，则显示所有可设置选项的列表，并标明每个选项是否已设置；如果提供了任何 optnames，则输出仅限于这些选项。 -p 选项以可重用作输入的形式显示输出。

Other options have the following meanings:
其他选项的含义如下：

-s

Enable (set) each optname.
启用（设置）每个 optname。

-u

Disable (unset) each optname.
禁用（取消设置）每个 optname。

-q

Suppresses normal output; the return status indicates whether the optname is set or unset. If multiple optname arguments are supplied with -q, the return status is zero if all optnames are enabled; non-zero otherwise.
抑制正常输出；返回状态表示 optname 是否被设置或未被设置。如果使用 -q 并提供了多个 optname 参数，当所有 optnames 都被启用时返回状态为零；否则为非零。

-o

Restricts the values of optname to be those defined for the -o option to the set builtin (see The Set Builtin).
限制 optname 的值为 -o 选项在 set 内建命令中定义的值（参见 The Set Builtin）。

If either -s or -u is used with no optname arguments, shopt shows only those options which are set or unset, respectively.
如果 -s 或 -u 被使用且没有提供 optname 参数， shopt 将仅显示分别被设置或未被设置的选项。

Unless otherwise noted, the shopt options are disabled (off) by default.
除非另有说明， shopt 选项默认是禁用（关闭）的。

The return status when listing options is zero if all optnames are enabled, non-zero otherwise. When setting or unsetting options, the return status is zero unless an optname is not a valid shell option.
列出选项时，返回状态为零表示所有 optnames 都已启用，否则为非零。在设置或取消选项时，返回状态为零，除非 optname 不是有效的 shell 选项。

The list of shopt options is:
选项列表为：

array_expand_once

If set, the shell suppresses multiple evaluation of associative and indexed array subscripts during arithmetic expression evaluation, while executing builtins that can perform variable assignments, and while executing builtins that perform array dereferencing.
如果设置，shell 会在算术表达式求值期间抑制对关联数组和索引数组下标的多次求值，同时在执行可以进行变量赋值的内置命令以及执行进行数组解引用的内置命令时也这样做。

assoc_expand_once

Deprecated; a synonym for array_expand_once.
已弃用；是 array_expand_once 的同义词。

autocd

If set, a command name that is the name of a directory is executed as if it were the argument to the cd command. This option is only used by interactive shells.
如果设置，一个名为目录的命令名将被当作 cd 命令的参数来执行。此选项仅在交互式 shell 中使用。

bash_source_fullpath

If set, filenames added to the BASH_SOURCE array variable are converted to full pathnames (see Bash Variables).
如果设置，添加到 BASH_SOURCE 数组变量中的文件名会被转换为完整路径名（参见 Bash Variables）。

cdable_vars

If this is set, an argument to the cd builtin command that is not a directory is assumed to be the name of a variable whose value is the directory to change to.
如果设置， cd 内置命令的参数如果不是目录，则被假定为一个变量名，其值为要切换到的目录。

cdspell

If set, the cd command attempts to correct minor errors in the spelling of a directory component. Minor errors include transposed characters, a missing character, and one extra character. If cd corrects the directory name, it prints the corrected filename, and the command proceeds. This option is only used by interactive shells.
如果设置， cd 命令会尝试纠正目录组件拼写中的小错误。小错误包括字母顺序颠倒、缺少一个字母或有一个多余的字母。如果 cd 纠正了目录名，它会打印出纠正后的文件名，然后继续执行命令。此选项仅在交互式 shell 中使用。

checkhash

If this is set, Bash checks that a command found in the hash table exists before trying to execute it. If a hashed command no longer exists, Bash performs a normal path search.
如果设置此选项，Bash 在尝试执行命令之前会检查哈希表中的命令是否存在。如果一个被哈希的命令已经不存在，Bash 会执行正常的路径搜索。

checkjobs

If set, Bash lists the status of any stopped and running jobs before exiting an interactive shell. If any jobs are running, Bash defers the exit until a second exit is attempted without an intervening command (see Job Control). The shell always postpones exiting if any jobs are stopped.
如果设置此选项，Bash 在退出交互式外壳之前会列出所有已停止和正在运行的作业的状态。如果存在正在运行的作业，Bash 会延迟退出，直到再次尝试退出且中间没有执行其他命令（参见作业控制）。如果存在已停止的作业，外壳总是会延迟退出。

checkwinsize

If set, Bash checks the window size after each external (non-builtin) command and, if necessary, updates the values of LINES and COLUMNS, using the file descriptor associated with stderr if it is a terminal. This option is enabled by default.
如果设置此选项，Bash 会在每次执行外部（非内置）命令后检查窗口大小，并在必要时更新 LINES 和 COLUMNS 的值，使用与 stderr 关联的文件描述符，如果它是一个终端的话。此选项默认启用。

cmdhist

If set, Bash attempts to save all lines of a multiple-line command in the same history entry. This allows easy re-editing of multi-line commands. This option is enabled by default, but only has an effect if command history is enabled (see Bash History Facilities).
如果设置此选项，Bash 会尝试将多行命令的所有行保存在同一个历史记录条目中。这允许方便地重新编辑多行命令。此选项默认启用，但只有在启用了命令历史记录（参见 Bash 历史功能）时才会生效。

compat31
compat32
compat40
compat41
compat42
compat43
compat44

These control aspects of the shell’s compatibility mode (see Shell Compatibility Mode).
这些控制 shell 兼容模式的各个方面（参见 Shell 兼容模式）。

complete_fullquote

If set, Bash quotes all shell metacharacters in filenames and directory names when performing completion. If not set, Bash removes metacharacters such as the dollar sign from the set of characters that will be quoted in completed filenames when these metacharacters appear in shell variable references in words to be completed. This means that dollar signs in variable names that expand to directories will not be quoted; however, any dollar signs appearing in filenames will not be quoted, either. This is active only when Bash is using backslashes to quote completed filenames. This variable is set by default, which is the default Bash behavior in versions through 4.2.
如果设置，Bash 在执行补全时会对文件名和目录名中的 shell 元字符进行引用。如果未设置，Bash 会在补全的文件名中去除出现在 shell 变量引用中的元字符，如美元符号。这意味着在变量名中展开为目录的美元符号不会被引用；然而，文件名中的任何美元符号也不会被引用。此功能仅在 Bash 使用反斜杠来引用补全的文件名时生效。此变量默认被设置，这是 Bash 在版本 4.2 及更早版本中的默认行为。

direxpand

If set, Bash replaces directory names with the results of word expansion when performing filename completion. This changes the contents of the Readline editing buffer. If not set, Bash attempts to preserve what the user typed.
如果设置，Bash 在进行文件名补全时，会用单词扩展的结果替换目录名。这会改变 Readline 编辑缓冲区的内容。如果未设置，Bash 会尝试保留用户输入的内容。

dirspell

If set, Bash attempts spelling correction on directory names during word completion if the directory name initially supplied does not exist.
如果设置，Bash 在单词补全时会对目录名进行拼写校正，如果最初提供的目录名不存在的话。

dotglob

If set, Bash includes filenames beginning with a ‘.’ in the results of filename expansion. The filenames . and .. must always be matched explicitly, even if dotglob is set.
如果设置，Bash 会在文件名扩展的结果中包含以‘ . ’开头的文件名。文件名 . 和 .. 必须显式匹配，即使 dotglob 被设置也是如此。

execfail

If this is set, a non-interactive shell will not exit if it cannot execute the file specified as an argument to the exec builtin. An interactive shell does not exit if exec fails.
如果此选项被设置，非交互式 shell 在无法执行作为 exec 内置命令参数指定的文件时不会退出。交互式 shell 在 exec 失败时也不会退出。

expand_aliases

If set, aliases are expanded as described below under Aliases, Aliases. This option is enabled by default for interactive shells.
如果设置，别名会按照下面“别名”部分所述的方式进行展开。此选项在交互式 shell 中默认是启用的。

extdebug

If set at shell invocation, or in a shell startup file, arrange to execute the debugger profile before the shell starts, identical to the --debugger option. If set after invocation, behavior intended for use by debuggers is enabled:
如果在 shell 启动时或在 shell 启动文件中设置，会在 shell 开始执行前运行调试器配置文件，与 --debugger 选项的行为相同。如果在启动后设置，则启用调试器预期的行为：

  1. The -F option to the declare builtin (see Bash Builtin Commands) displays the source file name and line number corresponding to each function name supplied as an argument.
    -F 选项用于 declare 内置命令（参见 Bash 内置命令），显示每个作为参数提供的函数名对应的源文件名和行号。
  2. If the command run by the DEBUG trap returns a non-zero value, the next command is skipped and not executed.
    如果由 DEBUG 陷阱执行的命令返回非零值，下一个命令将被跳过并不会执行。
  3. If the command run by the DEBUG trap returns a value of 2, and the shell is executing in a subroutine (a shell function or a shell script executed by the . or source builtins), the shell simulates a call to return.
    如果由 DEBUG 陷阱执行的命令返回值为 2，并且 shell 正在子程序（shell 函数或由 . 或 source 内置命令执行的 shell 脚本）中运行，shell 会模拟调用 return 。
  4. BASH_ARGC and BASH_ARGV are updated as described in their descriptions (see Bash Variables).
    BASH_ARGC 和 BASH_ARGV 会根据其描述进行更新（参见 Bash Variables）。
  5. Function tracing is enabled: command substitution, shell functions, and subshells invoked with ( command ) inherit the DEBUG and RETURN traps.
    函数跟踪已启用：命令替换、shell 函数以及使用 ( command ) 调用的子 shell 会继承 DEBUG 和 RETURN 陷阱。
  6. Error tracing is enabled: command substitution, shell functions, and subshells invoked with ( command ) inherit the ERR trap.
    错误追踪已启用：命令替换、shell 函数以及使用 ( command ) 调用的子 shell 会继承 ERR 的 trap。
extglob

If set, enable the extended pattern matching features described above (see Pattern Matching).
如果设置，将启用上述（见 Pattern Matching）中描述的扩展模式匹配功能。

extquote

If set, $'string' and $"string" quoting is performed within ${parameter} expansions enclosed in double quotes. This option is enabled by default.
如果设置，在双引号内的 ${parameter} 扩展中会执行 $'string' 和 $"string" 引用。此选项默认启用。

failglob

If set, patterns which fail to match filenames during filename expansion result in an expansion error.
如果设置，在文件名扩展过程中无法匹配文件名的模式将导致扩展错误。

force_fignore

If set, the suffixes specified by the FIGNORE shell variable cause words to be ignored when performing word completion even if the ignored words are the only possible completions. See Bash Variables, for a description of FIGNORE. This option is enabled by default.
如果设置，由 FIGNORE shell 变量指定的后缀会导致在进行单词补全时忽略这些单词，即使这些被忽略的单词是唯一可能的补全项。参见 Bash Variables，了解 FIGNORE 的描述。此选项默认启用。

globasciiranges

If set, range expressions used in pattern matching bracket expressions (see Pattern Matching) behave as if in the traditional C locale when performing comparisons. That is, pattern matching does not take the current locale’s collating sequence into account, so ‘b’ will not collate between ‘A’ and ‘B’, and upper-case and lower-case ASCII characters will collate together.
如果设置，模式匹配中的范围表达式在进行比较时会表现得如同在传统的 C 区域设置中一样（参见 Pattern Matching）。也就是说，模式匹配不会考虑当前区域设置的排序序列，因此‘ b ’不会在‘ A ’和‘ B ’之间进行排序，大写和小写的 ASCII 字符会被视为相同。

globskipdots

If set, filename expansion will never match the filenames . and .., even if the pattern begins with a ‘.’. This option is enabled by default.
如果设置，文件名扩展将永远不会匹配文件名 . 和 .. ，即使模式以‘ . ’开头。此选项默认启用。

globstar

If set, the pattern ‘**’ used in a filename expansion context will match all files and zero or more directories and subdirectories. If the pattern is followed by a ‘/’, only directories and subdirectories match.
如果设置，在文件名扩展上下文中使用的模式‘ ** ’将匹配所有文件以及零个或多个目录和子目录。如果模式后跟‘ / ’，则只匹配目录和子目录。

gnu_errfmt

If set, shell error messages are written in the standard GNU error message format.
如果设置，shell 错误信息将使用标准的 GNU 错误信息格式输出。

histappend

If set, the history list is appended to the file named by the value of the HISTFILE variable when the shell exits, rather than overwriting the file.
如果设置，当 shell 退出时，历史列表将追加到由 HISTFILE 变量值指定的文件中，而不是覆盖该文件。

histreedit

If set, and Readline is being used, the user is given the opportunity to re-edit a failed history substitution.
如果设置，并且使用 Readline，用户将有机会重新编辑失败的历史替换命令。

histverify

If set, and Readline is being used, the results of history substitution are not immediately passed to the shell parser. Instead, the resulting line is loaded into the Readline editing buffer, allowing further modification.
如果设置，并且使用 Readline，历史替换的结果不会立即传递给 shell 解析器。相反，生成的行会被加载到 Readline 编辑缓冲区中，允许进一步修改。

hostcomplete

If set, and Readline is being used, Bash will attempt to perform hostname completion when a word containing a ‘@’ is being completed (see Letting Readline Type For You). This option is enabled by default.
如果设置，并且使用 Readline，Bash 会在补全包含‘ @ ’的单词时尝试进行主机名补全（参见 Letting Readline Type For You）。此选项默认启用。

huponexit

If set, Bash will send SIGHUP to all jobs when an interactive login shell exits (see Signals).
如果设置，Bash 会在交互式登录 shell 退出时将 SIGHUP 发送到所有作业（参见 Signals）。

inherit_errexit

If set, command substitution inherits the value of the errexit option, instead of unsetting it in the subshell environment. This option is enabled when POSIX mode is enabled.
如果设置，命令替换会继承 errexit 选项的值，而不是在子 shell 环境中取消设置。当 POSIX 模式启用时，此选项会启用。

interactive_comments

In an interactive shell, a word beginning with ‘#’ causes that word and all remaining characters on that line to be ignored, as in a non-interactive shell. This option is enabled by default.
在交互式 shell 中，以‘ # ’开头的单词会导致该单词以及该行上剩余的所有字符被忽略，如同在非交互式 shell 中一样。此选项默认启用。

lastpipe

If set, and job control is not active, the shell runs the last command of a pipeline not executed in the background in the current shell environment.
如果设置，且作业控制未激活，shell 会在当前 shell 环境中运行管道中的最后一个命令，而不是在后台执行。

lithist

If enabled, and the cmdhist option is enabled, multi-line commands are saved to the history with embedded newlines rather than using semicolon separators where possible.
如果启用，且 cmdhist 选项已启用，多行命令将保存到历史记录中，并保留嵌入的换行符，而不是在可能的情况下使用分号分隔。

localvar_inherit

If set, local variables inherit the value and attributes of a variable of the same name that exists at a previous scope before any new value is assigned. The nameref attribute is not inherited.
如果设置，本地变量在任何新值被赋之前会继承同名变量在先前作用域中的值和属性。 nameref 属性不会被继承。

localvar_unset

If set, calling unset on local variables in previous function scopes marks them so subsequent lookups find them unset until that function returns. This is identical to the behavior of unsetting local variables at the current function scope.
如果设置，在先前函数作用域中的本地变量调用 unset 会将其标记为已取消设置，直到该函数返回时，后续的查找才会发现这些变量未被设置。这与在当前函数作用域中取消设置本地变量的行为相同。

login_shell

The shell sets this option if it is started as a login shell (see Invoking Bash). The value may not be changed.
shell 在作为登录 shell 启动时会设置此选项（参见 Invoking Bash）。该值不能被更改。

mailwarn

If set, and a file that Bash is checking for mail has been accessed since the last time it was checked, Bash displays the message "The mail in mailfile has been read".
如果设置，且 Bash 正在检查的邮件文件自上次检查以来已被访问过，Bash 会显示消息 "The mail in mailfile has been read" 。

no_empty_cmd_completion

If set, and Readline is being used, Bash does not search the PATH for possible completions when completion is attempted on an empty line.
如果设置，并且使用 Readline，当在空行上尝试补全时，Bash 不会在 PATH 中查找可能的补全项。

nocaseglob

If set, Bash matches filenames in a case-insensitive fashion when performing filename expansion.
如果设置，Bash 在执行文件名扩展时会以不区分大小写的方式匹配文件名。

nocasematch

If set, Bash matches patterns in a case-insensitive fashion when performing matching while executing case or [[ conditional commands (see Conditional Constructs, when performing pattern substitution word expansions, or when filtering possible completions as part of programmable completion.
如果设置，Bash 在执行 case 或 [[ 条件命令时（参见条件结构），进行模式匹配时以不区分大小写的方式处理；在进行模式替换的单词扩展时，或在可编程补全中过滤可能的补全项时也是如此。

noexpand_translation

If set, Bash encloses the translated results of $"…" quoting in single quotes instead of double quotes. If the string is not translated, this has no effect.
如果设置，Bash 将使用单引号而不是双引号来包围$"…"引号转换后的结果。如果字符串未被转换，则此选项无效。

nullglob

If set, filename expansion patterns which match no files (see Filename Expansion) expand to nothing and are removed, rather than expanding to themselves.
如果设置，匹配不到文件的文件名扩展模式（参见文件名扩展）将被展开为空，并被移除，而不是展开为自身。

patsub_replacement

If set, Bash expands occurrences of ‘&’ in the replacement string of pattern substitution to the text matched by the pattern, as described above (see Shell Parameter Expansion). This option is enabled by default.
如果设置，Bash 会在模式替换的替换字符串中将‘ & ’的出现展开为模式匹配到的文本（如上所述，参见 Shell 参数扩展）。此选项默认启用。

progcomp

If set, enable the programmable completion facilities (see Programmable Completion). This option is enabled by default.
如果设置，启用可编程补全功能（参见可编程补全）。此选项默认启用。

progcomp_alias

If set, and programmable completion is enabled, Bash treats a command name that doesn’t have any completions as a possible alias and attempts alias expansion. If it has an alias, Bash attempts programmable completion using the command word resulting from the expanded alias.
如果设置，并且可编程补全功能已启用，Bash 会将没有任何补全的命令名视为可能的别名，并尝试进行别名展开。如果该命令有别名，Bash 会使用展开后的命令词尝试可编程补全。

promptvars

If set, prompt strings undergo parameter expansion, command substitution, arithmetic expansion, and quote removal after being expanded as described below (see Controlling the Prompt). This option is enabled by default.
如果设置，提示字符串在按下面所述进行扩展后，会经历参数扩展、命令替换、算术扩展和引号删除处理（参见控制提示）。此选项默认启用。

restricted_shell

The shell sets this option if it is started in restricted mode (see The Restricted Shell). The value may not be changed. This is not reset when the startup files are executed, allowing the startup files to discover whether or not a shell is restricted.
如果在受限模式下启动 shell，shell 会设置此选项（参见受限 shell）。此值不能被更改。执行启动文件时不会重置此选项，允许启动文件检测 shell 是否处于受限状态。

shift_verbose

If this is set, the shift builtin prints an error message when the shift count exceeds the number of positional parameters.
如果设置， shift 内建命令在位移计数超过位置参数数量时会打印一条错误信息。

sourcepath

If set, the . (source) builtin uses the value of PATH to find the directory containing the file supplied as an argument when the -p option is not supplied. This option is enabled by default.
如果设置， . ( source ) 内建命令使用 PATH 的值来查找当未提供 -p 选项时作为参数提供的文件所在的目录。此选项默认启用。

varredir_close

If set, the shell automatically closes file descriptors assigned using the {varname} redirection syntax (see Redirections) instead of leaving them open when the command completes.
如果设置，shell 会在命令执行完毕后自动关闭使用 {varname} 重定向语法（参见重定向）分配的文件描述符，而不是保持它们打开。

xpg_echo

If set, the echo builtin expands backslash-escape sequences by default. If the posix shell option (see The Set Builtin) is also enabled, echo does not interpret any options.
如果设置， echo 内建命令默认展开反斜杠转义序列。如果同时启用了 posix shell 选项（参见 Set 内建命令）， echo 将不会解释任何选项。

Previous: Modifying Shell Behavior, Up: Shell Builtin Commands   [Contents][Index]

4.4 Special Builtins ¶
4.4 特殊内建命令 ¶

For historical reasons, the POSIX standard has classified several builtin commands as special. When Bash is executing in POSIX mode, the special builtins differ from other builtin commands in three respects:
由于历史原因，POSIX 标准将一些内置命令分类为特殊命令。当 Bash 在 POSIX 模式下执行时，特殊内置命令与其他内置命令在三个方面有所不同：

  1. Special builtins are found before shell functions during command lookup.
    在命令查找过程中，特殊内置命令位于 shell 函数之前。
  2. If a special builtin returns an error status, a non-interactive shell exits.
    如果特殊内置命令返回错误状态，非交互式 shell 会退出。
  3. Assignment statements preceding the command stay in effect in the shell environment after the command completes.
    在命令之前的赋值语句在命令执行完毕后仍然保留在 shell 环境中。

When Bash is not executing in POSIX mode, these builtins behave no differently than the rest of the Bash builtin commands. The Bash POSIX mode is described in Bash and POSIX.
当 Bash 不在 POSIX 模式下执行时，这些内置命令的行为与其他 Bash 内置命令没有不同。Bash 的 POSIX 模式在 Bash 和 POSIX 中进行了描述。

These are the POSIX special builtins:
这些是 POSIX 特殊内置命令：

break : . source continue eval exec exit export readonly return set
shift times trap unset

Next: Bash Features, Previous: Shell Builtin Commands, Up: Bash Features   [Contents][Index]

5 Shell Variables ¶

This chapter describes the shell variables that Bash uses. Bash automatically assigns default values to a number of variables.
本章描述了 Bash 使用的 shell 变量。Bash 会自动为一些变量分配默认值。

  • Bourne Shell Variables
  • Bash Variables

Next: Bash Variables, Up: Shell Variables   [Contents][Index]
下一步：Bash 变量，上一节：Shell 变量 [目录][索引]

5.1 Bourne Shell Variables ¶

Bash uses certain shell variables in the same way as the Bourne shell. In some cases, Bash assigns a default value to the variable.
Bash 以与 Bourne shell 相同的方式使用某些 shell 变量。在某些情况下，Bash 会为该变量赋予默认值。

CDPATH ¶

A colon-separated list of directories used as a search path for the cd builtin command.
用于内置命令 cd 的搜索路径的目录列表，以冒号分隔。

HOME ¶

The current user’s home directory; the default for the cd builtin command. The value of this variable is also used by tilde expansion (see Tilde Expansion).
当前用户的主目录；内置命令 cd 的默认值。该变量的值还用于波浪线扩展（参见波浪线扩展）。

IFS ¶

A list of characters that separate fields; used when the shell splits words as part of expansion and by the read builtin to split lines into words. See Word Splitting, for a description of word splitting.
字段分隔符的字符列表；当 shell 在展开时分割单词，或 read 内置命令分割行成单词时使用。有关单词分割的描述，请参见 Word Splitting。

MAIL ¶

If the value is set to a filename or directory name and the MAILPATH variable is not set, Bash informs the user of the arrival of mail in the specified file or Maildir-format directory.
如果值设置为一个文件名或目录名，并且 MAILPATH 变量未设置，Bash 会通知用户指定文件或 Maildir 格式目录中已到达邮件。

MAILPATH ¶

A colon-separated list of filenames which the shell periodically checks for new mail. Each list entry can specify the message that is printed when new mail arrives in the mail file by separating the filename from the message with a ‘?’. When used in the text of the message, $_ expands to the name of the current mail file.
一个由冒号分隔的文件名列表，shell 会定期检查这些文件是否有新邮件。每个列表项可以通过在文件名和消息之间用‘ ? ’来指定当新邮件到达邮件文件时打印的消息。当在消息文本中使用 $_ 时，它会扩展为当前邮件文件的名称。

OPTARG ¶

The value of the last option argument processed by the getopts builtin.
getopts 内置命令处理的最后一个选项参数的值。

OPTIND ¶

The index of the next argument to be processed by the getopts builtin.
下一个要被 getopts 内建命令处理的参数的索引。

PATH ¶

A colon-separated list of directories in which the shell looks for commands. A zero-length (null) directory name in the value of PATH indicates the current directory. A null directory name may appear as two adjacent colons, or as an initial or trailing colon. The default path is system-dependent, and is set by the administrator who installs bash. A common value is "/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/sbin".
一个冒号分隔的目录列表，shell 在其中查找命令。 PATH 值中的零长度（空）目录名表示当前目录。空目录名可能以两个相邻的冒号、或者以开头或结尾的冒号形式出现。默认路径依赖于系统，并由安装 bash 的管理员设置。一个常见的值是 "/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/bin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/sbin"。

PS1 ¶

The primary prompt string. The default value is ‘\s-\v\$ ’. See Controlling the Prompt, for the complete list of escape sequences that are expanded before PS1 is displayed.
主提示字符串。默认值是‘ \s-\v\$ ’。参见“控制提示”以获取在显示 PS1 之前展开的所有转义序列的完整列表。

PS2 ¶

The secondary prompt string. The default value is ‘> ’. PS2 is expanded in the same way as PS1 before being displayed.
次提示字符串。默认值是‘ > ’。 PS2 在显示前以与 PS1 相同的方式进行展开。

Previous: Bourne Shell Variables, Up: Shell Variables   [Contents][Index]

5.2 Bash Variables ¶
5.2 Bash 变量 ¶

These variables are set or used by Bash, but other shells do not normally treat them specially.
这些变量由 Bash 设置或使用，但其他 shell 通常不会特别处理它们。

A few variables used by Bash are described in different chapters: variables for controlling the job control facilities (see Job Control Variables).
Bash 使用的某些变量在不同的章节中进行了描述：用于控制作业控制功能的变量（参见作业控制变量）。

_ ¶

($_, an underscore.) This has a number of meanings depending on context. At shell startup, $_ set to the pathname used to invoke the shell or shell script being executed as passed in the environment or argument list. Subsequently, it expands to the last argument to the previous simple command executed in the foreground, after expansion. It is also set to the full pathname used to invoke each command executed and placed in the environment exported to that command. When checking mail, $_ expands to the name of the mail file.
($_, 一个下划线。) 这个变量在不同上下文中有不同的含义。在 shell 启动时，$_被设置为调用 shell 或正在执行的 shell 脚本的路径名，该路径名是从环境或参数列表中传入的。随后，它会展开为前一个在前台执行的简单命令的最后一个参数，经过展开后。它也会被设置为调用每个执行命令的完整路径名，并放置在该命令的环境中。在检查邮件时，$_会展开为邮件文件的名称。

BASH ¶

The full pathname used to execute the current instance of Bash.
当前 Bash 实例执行的完整路径名。

BASHOPTS ¶

A colon-separated list of enabled shell options. Each word in the list is a valid argument for the -s option to the shopt builtin command (see The Shopt Builtin). The options appearing in BASHOPTS are those reported as ‘on’ by ‘shopt’. If this variable is in the environment when Bash starts up, the shell enables each option in the list before reading any startup files. If this variable is exported, child shells will enable each option in the list. This variable is readonly.
启用的 shell 选项列表，以冒号分隔。列表中的每个单词都是 -s 选项在 shopt 内置命令（参见 Shopt 内置命令）的有效参数。 BASHOPTS 中列出的选项是通过‘ shopt ’报告为‘ on ’的选项。如果 Bash 启动时该变量存在于环境中，shell 会在读取任何启动文件之前启用列表中的每个选项。如果该变量被导出，子 shell 也会启用列表中的每个选项。该变量是只读的。

BASHPID ¶

Expands to the process ID of the current Bash process. This differs from $$ under certain circumstances, such as subshells that do not require Bash to be re-initialized. Assignments to BASHPID have no effect. If BASHPID is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
展开为当前 Bash 进程的进程 ID。在某些情况下，如不需要重新初始化 Bash 的子 shell 中，它与 $$ 不同。对 BASHPID 的赋值不会产生任何效果。如果 BASHPID 未设置，它会失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

BASH_ALIASES ¶

An associative array variable whose members correspond to the internal list of aliases as maintained by the alias builtin. (see Bourne Shell Builtins). Elements added to this array appear in the alias list; however, unsetting array elements currently does not cause aliases to be removed from the alias list. If BASH_ALIASES is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
一个关联数组变量，其成员对应于 alias 内置命令维护的内部别名列表。（参见 Bourne Shell 内置命令）。添加到此数组中的元素会出现在别名列表中；然而，当前取消数组元素并不会导致别名从别名列表中被删除。如果 BASH_ALIASES 未设置，它会失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

BASH_ARGC ¶

An array variable whose values are the number of parameters in each frame of the current Bash execution call stack. The number of parameters to the current subroutine (shell function or script executed with . or source) is at the top of the stack. When a subroutine is executed, the number of parameters passed is pushed onto BASH_ARGC. The shell sets BASH_ARGC only when in extended debugging mode (see The Shopt Builtin for a description of the extdebug option to the shopt builtin). Setting extdebug after the shell has started to execute a subroutine, or referencing this variable when extdebug is not set, may result in inconsistent values. Assignments to BASH_ARGC have no effect, and it may not be unset.
一个数组变量，其值为当前 Bash 执行调用栈中每一帧的参数个数。当前子程序（shell 函数或使用 . 或 source 执行的脚本）的参数个数位于栈顶。当执行一个子程序时，传递的参数个数会被压入 BASH_ARGC 。只有在扩展调试模式下，shell 才会设置 BASH_ARGC （参见 The Shopt Builtin 中对 shopt 内置命令的 extdebug 选项的描述）。在 shell 开始执行子程序之后设置 extdebug ，或者在 extdebug 未设置时引用该变量，可能会导致不一致的值。对 BASH_ARGC 的赋值不会产生任何效果，且不能取消设置。

BASH_ARGV ¶

An array variable containing all of the parameters in the current Bash execution call stack. The final parameter of the last subroutine call is at the top of the stack; the first parameter of the initial call is at the bottom. When a subroutine is executed, the shell pushes the supplied parameters onto BASH_ARGV. The shell sets BASH_ARGV only when in extended debugging mode (see The Shopt Builtin for a description of the extdebug option to the shopt builtin). Setting extdebug after the shell has started to execute a script, or referencing this variable when extdebug is not set, may result in inconsistent values. Assignments to BASH_ARGV have no effect, and it may not be unset.
一个包含当前 Bash 执行调用栈中所有参数的数组变量。最后子程序调用的最后一个参数位于栈顶；初始调用的第一个参数位于栈底。当执行一个子程序时，shell 会将提供的参数压入 BASH_ARGV 。只有在扩展调试模式下，shell 才会设置 BASH_ARGV （参见 The Shopt Builtin，了解 shopt 内置命令的 extdebug 选项描述）。在 shell 开始执行脚本之后设置 extdebug ，或者在 extdebug 未设置时引用该变量，可能会导致不一致的值。对 BASH_ARGV 的赋值不会产生任何效果，且不能取消设置。

BASH_ARGV0 ¶

When referenced, this variable expands to the name of the shell or shell script (identical to $0; See Special Parameters, for the description of special parameter 0). Assigning a value to BASH_ARGV0 sets $0 to the same value. If BASH_ARGV0 is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
当引用该变量时，它会扩展为 shell 或 shell 脚本的名称（与 $0 相同；参见 Special Parameters，了解特殊参数 0 的描述）。对 BASH_ARGV0 赋值会将 $0 设置为相同的值。如果 BASH_ARGV0 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

BASH_CMDS ¶

An associative array variable whose members correspond to the internal hash table of commands as maintained by the hash builtin (see Bourne Shell Builtins). Adding elements to this array makes them appear in the hash table; however, unsetting array elements currently does not remove command names from the hash table. If BASH_CMDS is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
一个关联数组变量，其成员对应由 hash 内置命令维护的命令内部哈希表（参见 Bourne Shell 内置命令）。向此数组添加元素会使它们出现在哈希表中；然而，当前取消数组元素并不会从哈希表中移除命令名称。如果 BASH_CMDS 被取消设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重新设置。

BASH_COMMAND ¶

Expands to the command currently being executed or about to be executed, unless the shell is executing a command as the result of a trap, in which case it is the command executing at the time of the trap. If BASH_COMMAND is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
展开为当前正在执行或即将执行的命令，除非 shell 正在因 trap 而执行命令，此时它表示 trap 发生时正在执行的命令。如果 BASH_COMMAND 被取消设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重新设置。

BASH_COMPAT ¶

The value is used to set the shell’s compatibility level. See Shell Compatibility Mode, for a description of the various compatibility levels and their effects. The value may be a decimal number (e.g., 4.2) or an integer (e.g., 42) corresponding to the desired compatibility level. If BASH_COMPAT is unset or set to the empty string, the compatibility level is set to the default for the current version. If BASH_COMPAT is set to a value that is not one of the valid compatibility levels, the shell prints an error message and sets the compatibility level to the default for the current version. A subset of the valid values correspond to the compatibility levels described below (see Shell Compatibility Mode). For example, 4.2 and 42 are valid values that correspond to the compat42 shopt option and set the compatibility level to 42. The current version is also a valid value.
该值用于设置 shell 的兼容性级别。参见 Shell Compatibility Mode，了解各种兼容性级别及其影响。该值可以是十进制数（例如 4.2）或整数（例如 42），对应所需的兼容性级别。如果 BASH_COMPAT 未设置或设置为空字符串，则将兼容性级别设置为当前版本的默认值。如果 BASH_COMPAT 设置的值不是有效的兼容性级别之一，shell 会打印一条错误信息，并将兼容性级别设置为当前版本的默认值。一部分有效的值对应于下面描述的兼容性级别（参见 Shell Compatibility Mode）。例如，4.2 和 42 是有效的值，对应 compat42 shopt 选项，并将兼容性级别设置为 42。当前版本也是一个有效的值。

BASH_ENV ¶

If this variable is set when Bash is invoked to execute a shell script, its value is expanded and used as the name of a startup file to read before executing the script. Bash does not use PATH to search for the resultant filename. See Bash Startup Files.
如果在调用 Bash 执行 shell 脚本时设置了此变量，其值会被展开，并作为执行脚本前读取的启动文件名。Bash 不会使用 PATH 来搜索得到的文件名。参见 Bash Startup Files。

BASH_EXECUTION_STRING ¶

The command argument to the -c invocation option.
-c 调用选项的命令参数。

BASH_LINENO ¶

An array variable whose members are the line numbers in source files where each corresponding member of FUNCNAME was invoked. ${BASH_LINENO[$i]} is the line number in the source file (${BASH_SOURCE[$i+1]}) where ${FUNCNAME[$i]} was called (or ${BASH_LINENO[$i-1]} if referenced within another shell function). Use LINENO to obtain the current line number. Assignments to BASH_LINENO have no effect, and it may not be unset.
一个数组变量，其成员是每个对应的 FUNCNAME 被调用时的源文件行号。 ${BASH_LINENO[$i]} 是源文件（ ${BASH_SOURCE[$i+1]} ）中调用 ${FUNCNAME[$i]} 的行号（或 ${BASH_LINENO[$i-1]} ，如果是在另一个 shell 函数中被引用的话）。使用 LINENO 来获取当前行号。对 BASH_LINENO 的赋值没有效果，也不能被取消设置。

BASH_LOADABLES_PATH ¶

A colon-separated list of directories in which the enable command looks for dynamically loadable builtins.
一个冒号分隔的目录列表， enable 命令在这些目录中查找可动态加载的内置命令。

BASH_MONOSECONDS ¶

Each time this variable is referenced, it expands to the value returned by the system’s monotonic clock, if one is available. If there is no monotonic clock, this is equivalent to EPOCHSECONDS. If BASH_MONOSECONDS is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
每次引用此变量时，它会扩展为系统单调时钟返回的值，如果有的话。如果没有单调时钟，则等同于 EPOCHSECONDS 。如果 BASH_MONOSECONDS 未设置，即使之后被重置，它也会失去其特殊属性。

BASH_REMATCH ¶

An array variable whose members are assigned by the ‘=~’ binary operator to the [[ conditional command (see Conditional Constructs). The element with index 0 is the portion of the string matching the entire regular expression. The element with index n is the portion of the string matching the nth parenthesized subexpression.
一个数组变量，其成员由‘ =~ ’二元运算符分配给 [[ 条件命令（参见条件结构）。索引为 0 的元素是与整个正则表达式匹配的字符串部分。索引为 n 的元素是与第 n 个括号内子表达式匹配的字符串部分。

BASH_SOURCE ¶

An array variable whose members are the source filenames where the corresponding shell function names in the FUNCNAME array variable are defined. The shell function ${FUNCNAME[$i]} is defined in the file ${BASH_SOURCE[$i]} and called from ${BASH_SOURCE[$i+1]} Assignments to BASH_SOURCE have no effect, and it may not be unset.
一个数组变量，其成员是 FUNCNAME 数组变量中对应 shell 函数名定义的源文件名。shell 函数 ${FUNCNAME[$i]} 在文件 ${BASH_SOURCE[$i]} 中定义，并从 ${BASH_SOURCE[$i+1]} 调用。对 BASH_SOURCE 的赋值不会产生任何效果，且不能被取消设置。

BASH_SUBSHELL ¶

Incremented by one within each subshell or subshell environment when the shell begins executing in that environment. The initial value is 0. If BASH_SUBSHELL is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
在每个子 shell 或子 shell 环境中，当 shell 开始执行时，该变量会增加一。初始值为 0。如果 BASH_SUBSHELL 未设置，则会失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

BASH_TRAPSIG ¶

Set to the signal number corresponding to the trap action being executed during its execution. See the description of trap (see Bourne Shell Builtins) for information about signal numbers and trap execution.
设置为正在执行的 trap 操作对应的信号编号。有关信号编号和 trap 执行的信息，请参见 trap （见 Bourne Shell 内置功能）的描述。

BASH_VERSINFO ¶

A readonly array variable (see Arrays) whose members hold version information for this instance of Bash. The values assigned to the array members are as follows:
一个只读数组变量（见数组），其成员保存了当前 Bash 实例的版本信息。数组成员的值如下：

BASH_VERSINFO[0]

The major version number (the release).
主要版本号（发行版本）。

BASH_VERSINFO[1]

The minor version number (the version).
次要版本号（版本号）。

BASH_VERSINFO[2]

The patch level.   补丁级别。

BASH_VERSINFO[3]

The build version.   构建版本。

BASH_VERSINFO[4]

The release status (e.g., beta).
发布状态（例如， beta ）。

BASH_VERSINFO[5]

The value of MACHTYPE.
MACHTYPE 的值。

BASH_VERSION ¶

Expands to a string describing the version of this instance of Bash (e.g., 5.2.37(3)-release).
展开为一个描述当前 Bash 实例版本的字符串（例如，5.2.37(3)-release）。

BASH_XTRACEFD ¶

If set to an integer corresponding to a valid file descriptor, Bash writes the trace output generated when ‘set -x’ is enabled to that file descriptor, instead of the standard error. This allows tracing output to be separated from diagnostic and error messages. The file descriptor is closed when BASH_XTRACEFD is unset or assigned a new value. Unsetting BASH_XTRACEFD or assigning it the empty string causes the trace output to be sent to the standard error. Note that setting BASH_XTRACEFD to 2 (the standard error file descriptor) and then unsetting it will result in the standard error being closed.
如果设置为一个有效的文件描述符整数，Bash 会在启用‘ set -x ’时将跟踪输出写入该文件描述符，而不是标准错误。这允许将跟踪输出与诊断信息和错误信息分开。当 BASH_XTRACEFD 被取消设置或赋予新值时，该文件描述符会被关闭。取消设置 BASH_XTRACEFD 或将其赋值为空字符串会导致跟踪输出发送到标准错误。请注意，将 BASH_XTRACEFD 设置为 2（标准错误文件描述符）然后取消设置它会导致标准错误被关闭。

CHILD_MAX ¶

Set the number of exited child status values for the shell to remember. Bash will not allow this value to be decreased below a POSIX-mandated minimum, and there is a maximum value (currently 8192) that this may not exceed. The minimum value is system-dependent.
设置 shell 记忆的已退出子进程状态值的数量。Bash 不允许此值低于 POSIX 规定的最小值，且此值有一个最大值（目前为 8192）。最小值取决于系统。

COLUMNS ¶

Used by the select command to determine the terminal width when printing selection lists. Automatically set if the checkwinsize option is enabled (see The Shopt Builtin), or in an interactive shell upon receipt of a SIGWINCH.
用于 select 命令在打印选择列表时确定终端宽度。如果启用了 checkwinsize 选项（参见 The Shopt Builtin），或者在交互式 shell 中接收到 SIGWINCH 时会自动设置。

COMP_CWORD ¶

An index into ${COMP_WORDS} of the word containing the current cursor position. This variable is available only in shell functions invoked by the programmable completion facilities (see Programmable Completion).
指向 ${COMP_WORDS} 中包含当前光标位置的单词的索引。此变量仅在由可编程补全功能调用的 shell 函数中可用（参见 Programmable Completion）。

COMP_KEY ¶

The key (or final key of a key sequence) used to invoke the current completion function. This variable is available only in shell functions and external commands invoked by the programmable completion facilities (see Programmable Completion).
调用当前补全函数所使用的键（或键序列的最后一个键）。此变量仅在由可编程补全功能调用的 shell 函数和外部命令中可用（参见 Programmable Completion）。

COMP_LINE ¶

The current command line. This variable is available only in shell functions and external commands invoked by the programmable completion facilities (see Programmable Completion).
当前命令行。此变量仅在 shell 函数和由可编程补全功能调用的外部命令中可用（参见可编程补全）。

COMP_POINT ¶

The index of the current cursor position relative to the beginning of the current command. If the current cursor position is at the end of the current command, the value of this variable is equal to ${#COMP_LINE}. This variable is available only in shell functions and external commands invoked by the programmable completion facilities (see Programmable Completion).
当前光标位置相对于当前命令起始位置的索引。如果当前光标位置在当前命令的末尾，此变量的值等于 ${#COMP_LINE} 。此变量仅在 shell 函数和由可编程补全功能调用的外部命令中可用（参见可编程补全）。

COMP_TYPE ¶

Set to an integer value corresponding to the type of attempted completion that caused a completion function to be called: TAB, for normal completion, ‘?’, for listing completions after successive tabs, ‘!’, for listing alternatives on partial word completion, ‘@’, to list completions if the word is not unmodified, or ‘%’, for menu completion. This variable is available only in shell functions and external commands invoked by the programmable completion facilities (see Programmable Completion).
设置为一个整数值，表示导致调用补全函数的补全类型： TAB 表示正常补全，‘ ? ’ 表示连续按 tab 键后列出补全内容，‘ ! ’ 表示部分单词补全时列出替代选项，‘ @ ’ 表示如果单词未被修改则列出补全内容，或 ‘ % ’ 表示菜单补全。此变量仅在 shell 函数和由可编程补全功能调用的外部命令中可用（参见可编程补全）。

COMP_WORDBREAKS ¶

The set of characters that the Readline library treats as word separators when performing word completion. If COMP_WORDBREAKS is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
Readline 库在执行单词补全时视为单词分隔符的字符集合。如果 COMP_WORDBREAKS 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重新设置也是如此。

COMP_WORDS ¶

An array variable consisting of the individual words in the current command line. The line is split into words as Readline would split it, using COMP_WORDBREAKS as described above. This variable is available only in shell functions invoked by the programmable completion facilities (see Programmable Completion).
一个数组变量，包含当前命令行中的各个单词。行被分割成单词的方式与 Readline 分割方式相同，使用 COMP_WORDBREAKS 如上所述。此变量仅在由可编程补全功能调用的 shell 函数中可用（参见可编程补全）。

COMPREPLY ¶

An array variable from which Bash reads the possible completions generated by a shell function invoked by the programmable completion facility (see Programmable Completion). Each array element contains one possible completion.
一个数组变量，Bash 从其中读取由可编程补全功能调用的 shell 函数生成的可能补全项（参见可编程补全）。每个数组元素包含一个可能的补全项。

COPROC ¶

An array variable created to hold the file descriptors for output from and input to an unnamed coprocess (see Coprocesses).
一个数组变量，用于保存无名协处理器的输出文件描述符和输入文件描述符（参见协处理器）。

DIRSTACK ¶

An array variable containing the current contents of the directory stack. Directories appear in the stack in the order they are displayed by the dirs builtin. Assigning to members of this array variable may be used to modify directories already in the stack, but the pushd and popd builtins must be used to add and remove directories. Assigning to this variable does not change the current directory. If DIRSTACK is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
包含当前目录栈内容的数组变量。目录在栈中的顺序与 dirs 内置命令显示的顺序相同。对这个数组变量成员的赋值可用于修改栈中已有的目录，但必须使用 pushd 和 popd 内置命令来添加和删除目录。对这个变量的赋值不会改变当前目录。如果 DIRSTACK 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

EMACS ¶

If Bash finds this variable in the environment when the shell starts, and its value is ‘t’, Bash assumes that the shell is running in an Emacs shell buffer and disables line editing.
如果 Bash 在启动时在环境中发现此变量，并且其值为‘ t ’，Bash 会假定 shell 正在一个 Emacs shell 缓冲区中运行，并禁用行编辑功能。

ENV ¶

Expanded and executed similarly to BASH_ENV (see Bash Startup Files) when an interactive shell is invoked in POSIX mode (see Bash and POSIX).
在 POSIX 模式下启动交互式 shell 时，会像 BASH_ENV 一样进行展开和执行（参见 Bash 启动文件）。

EPOCHREALTIME ¶

Each time this parameter is referenced, it expands to the number of seconds since the Unix Epoch as a floating-point value with micro-second granularity (see the documentation for the C library function time for the definition of Epoch). Assignments to EPOCHREALTIME are ignored. If EPOCHREALTIME is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
每次引用此参数时，它都会展开为自 Unix 纪元以来的秒数，以浮点数值形式表示，具有微秒级精度（有关纪元的定义，请参见 C 库函数 time 的文档）。对 EPOCHREALTIME 的赋值将被忽略。如果 EPOCHREALTIME 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

EPOCHSECONDS ¶

Each time this parameter is referenced, it expands to the number of seconds since the Unix Epoch (see the documentation for the C library function time for the definition of Epoch). Assignments to EPOCHSECONDS are ignored. If EPOCHSECONDS is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
每次引用此参数时，它会扩展为自 Unix 纪元以来的秒数（有关纪元的定义，请参阅 C 库函数 time 的文档）。对 EPOCHSECONDS 的赋值将被忽略。如果 EPOCHSECONDS 未设置，则会失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

EUID ¶

The numeric effective user id of the current user. This variable is readonly.
当前用户的数字有效用户 ID。此变量为只读变量。

EXECIGNORE ¶

A colon-separated list of shell patterns (see Pattern Matching) defining the set of filenames to be ignored by command search using PATH. Files whose full pathnames match one of these patterns are not considered executable files for the purposes of completion and command execution via PATH lookup. This does not affect the behavior of the [, test, and [[ commands. Full pathnames in the command hash table are not subject to EXECIGNORE. Use this variable to ignore shared library files that have the executable bit set, but are not executable files. The pattern matching honors the setting of the extglob shell option.
一个由冒号分隔的 shell 模式列表（参见模式匹配），用于定义通过 PATH 命令搜索时要忽略的文件名集合。文件的完整路径名如果匹配其中一个模式，则不会被视为可通过 PATH 查找执行的可执行文件。这不会影响 [ 、 test 和 [[ 命令的行为。命令哈希表中的完整路径名不受 EXECIGNORE 的影响。使用此变量来忽略那些设置了可执行位但并非实际可执行文件的共享库文件。模式匹配会遵循 extglob shell 选项的设置。

FCEDIT ¶

The editor used as a default by the fc builtin command.
fc 内置命令默认使用的编辑器。

FIGNORE ¶

A colon-separated list of suffixes to ignore when performing filename completion. A filename whose suffix matches one of the entries in FIGNORE is excluded from the list of matched filenames. A sample value is ‘.o:~’
忽略后缀的冒号分隔列表，用于文件名补全。当进行文件名补全时，文件名的后缀如果匹配 FIGNORE 中的任何一个条目，则不会包含在匹配的文件名列表中。一个示例值是 ‘ .o:~ ’

FUNCNAME ¶

An array variable containing the names of all shell functions currently in the execution call stack. The element with index 0 is the name of any currently-executing shell function. The bottom-most element (the one with the highest index) is "main". This variable exists only when a shell function is executing. Assignments to FUNCNAME have no effect. If FUNCNAME is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
一个数组变量，包含当前执行调用栈中所有 shell 函数的名称。索引为 0 的元素是当前正在执行的 shell 函数的名称。最底层的元素（索引最高的那个）是 "main" 。这个变量仅在 shell 函数执行时存在。对 FUNCNAME 的赋值不会产生任何效果。如果 FUNCNAME 未设置，则会失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

This variable can be used with BASH_LINENO and BASH_SOURCE. Each element of FUNCNAME has corresponding elements in BASH_LINENO and BASH_SOURCE to describe the call stack. For instance, ${FUNCNAME[$i]} was called from the file ${BASH_SOURCE[$i+1]} at line number ${BASH_LINENO[$i]}. The caller builtin displays the current call stack using this information.
此变量可以与 BASH_LINENO 和 BASH_SOURCE 一起使用。 FUNCNAME 中的每个元素在 BASH_LINENO 和 BASH_SOURCE 中都有对应的元素，用于描述调用栈。例如， ${FUNCNAME[$i]} 是从文件 ${BASH_SOURCE[$i+1]} 的第 ${BASH_LINENO[$i]} 行调用的。 caller 内建命令使用这些信息来显示当前的调用栈。

FUNCNEST ¶

A numeric value greater than 0 defines a maximum function nesting level. Function invocations that exceed this nesting level cause the current command to abort.
一个大于 0 的数值定义了最大函数嵌套层级。超过此嵌套层级的函数调用会导致当前命令中止。

GLOBIGNORE ¶

A colon-separated list of patterns defining the set of file names to be ignored by filename expansion. If a file name matched by a filename expansion pattern also matches one of the patterns in GLOBIGNORE, it is removed from the list of matches. The pattern matching honors the setting of the extglob shell option.
一个由冒号分隔的模式列表，用于定义要被文件名展开忽略的文件名集合。如果一个文件名同时匹配文件名展开模式和 GLOBIGNORE 中的某个模式，它将从匹配列表中被移除。模式匹配遵循 extglob shell 选项的设置。

GLOBSORT ¶

Controls how the results of filename expansion are sorted. The value of this variable specifies the sort criteria and sort order for the results of filename expansion. If this variable is unset or set to the null string, filename expansion uses the historical behavior of sorting by name, in ascending lexicographic order as determined by the LC_COLLATE shell variable.
控制文件名展开结果的排序方式。该变量的值指定了文件名展开结果的排序标准和排序顺序。如果该变量未设置或设置为空字符串，文件名展开将使用历史行为，按名称升序排列，排序方式由 LC_COLLATE shell 变量决定。

If set, a valid value begins with an optional ‘+’, which is ignored, or ‘-’, which reverses the sort order from ascending to descending, followed by a sort specifier. The valid sort specifiers are ‘name’, ‘numeric’, ‘size’, ‘mtime’, ‘atime’, ‘ctime’, and ‘blocks’, which sort the files on name, names in numeric rather than lexicographic order, file size, modification time, access time, inode change time, and number of blocks, respectively. If any of the non-name keys compare as equal (e.g., if two files are the same size), sorting uses the name as a secondary sort key.
如果设置了该选项，有效的值以一个可选的‘ + ’开头，该部分会被忽略，或者以‘ - ’开头，这会将排序顺序从升序改为降序，接着是排序指定符。有效的排序指定符包括‘ name ’、‘ numeric ’、‘ size ’、‘ mtime ’、‘ atime ’、‘ ctime ’和‘ blocks ’，分别按文件名、文件名的数字顺序而非字母顺序、文件大小、修改时间、访问时间、i 节点更改时间以及块数进行排序。如果任何非文件名的键比较相等（例如两个文件大小相同），则会使用文件名作为次要排序键。

For example, a value of -mtime sorts the results in descending order by modification time (newest first).
例如，一个值为 -mtime 的设置会按修改时间降序排列结果（最新文件优先）。

The ‘numeric’ specifier treats names consisting solely of digits as numbers and sorts them using their numeric value (so “2” sorts before “10”, for example). When using ‘numeric’, names containing non-digits sort after all the all-digit names and are sorted by name using the traditional behavior.
‘ numeric ’ 指定符将仅由数字组成的名称视为数字，并根据其数值进行排序（例如，“2” 会排在 “10” 前面）。使用 ‘ numeric ’ 时，包含非数字的名称会在所有全数字名称之后排序，并按照传统的名称排序方式进行排序。

A sort specifier of ‘nosort’ disables sorting completely; Bash returns the results in the order they are read from the file system, ignoring any leading ‘-’.
‘ nosort ’ 的排序指定符会完全禁用排序；Bash 会按照从文件系统中读取的顺序返回结果，忽略任何前面的 ‘ - ’。

If the sort specifier is missing, it defaults to name, so a value of ‘+’ is equivalent to the null string, and a value of ‘-’ sorts by name in descending order.
如果缺少排序指定符，则默认为按名称排序，因此 ‘ + ’ 的值等同于空字符串，而 ‘ - ’ 则按名称降序排列。

Any invalid value restores the historical sorting behavior.
任何无效的值都会恢复历史的排序行为。

GROUPS ¶

An array variable containing the list of groups of which the current user is a member. Assignments to GROUPS have no effect. If GROUPS is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
包含当前用户所属组列表的数组变量。对 GROUPS 的赋值没有效果。如果 GROUPS 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重新设置也是如此。

histchars ¶

The two or three characters which control history expansion, quick substitution, and tokenization (see History Expansion). The first character is the history expansion character, the character which begins a history expansion, normally ‘!’. The second character is the quick substitution character, normally ‘^’. When it appears as the first character on the line, history substitution repeats the previous command, replacing one string with another. The optional third character is the history comment character, normally ‘#’, which indicates that the remainder of the line is a comment when it appears as the first character of a word. The history comment character disables history substitution for the remaining words on the line. It does not necessarily cause the shell parser to treat the rest of the line as a comment.
