控制历史展开、快速替换和分词的两个或三个字符（参见历史展开）。第一个字符是历史展开字符，通常为‘ ! ’，用于开始历史展开。第二个字符是快速替换字符，通常为‘ ^ ’。当它出现在行首时，历史替换会重复上一条命令，将一个字符串替换为另一个。可选的第三个字符是历史注释字符，通常为‘ # ’，当它出现在单词的开头时，表示该行的其余部分为注释。历史注释字符会禁用该行上其余单词的历史替换功能。它不一定导致 shell 解析器将该行的其余部分视为注释。

HISTCMD ¶

The history number, or index in the history list, of the current command. Assignments to HISTCMD have no effect. If HISTCMD is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
当前命令在历史列表中的历史编号或索引。对 HISTCMD 的赋值不会产生任何效果。如果 HISTCMD 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

HISTCONTROL ¶

A colon-separated list of values controlling how commands are saved on the history list. If the list of values includes ‘ignorespace’, lines which begin with a space character are not saved in the history list. A value of ‘ignoredups’ causes lines which match the previous history entry not to be saved. A value of ‘ignoreboth’ is shorthand for ‘ignorespace’ and ‘ignoredups’. A value of ‘erasedups’ causes all previous lines matching the current line to be removed from the history list before that line is saved. Any value not in the above list is ignored. If HISTCONTROL is unset, or does not include a valid value, Bash saves all lines read by the shell parser on the history list, subject to the value of HISTIGNORE. If the first line of a multi-line compound command was saved, the second and subsequent lines are not tested, and are added to the history regardless of the value of HISTCONTROL. If the first line was not saved, the second and subsequent lines of the command are not saved either.
一个由冒号分隔的值列表，控制命令如何被保存到历史列表中。如果该值列表包含‘ ignorespace ’，则以空格开头的行不会被保存到历史列表中。值为‘ ignoredups ’时，与前一条历史记录匹配的行不会被保存。值为‘ ignoreboth ’则等同于‘ ignorespace ’和‘ ignoredups ’。值为‘ erasedups ’时，在该行被保存之前，会将所有与当前行匹配的先前行从历史列表中删除。上述列表以外的任何值都会被忽略。如果 HISTCONTROL 未设置，或者不包含有效的值，Bash 会根据 HISTIGNORE 的值将所有由 shell 解析器读取的行保存到历史列表中。如果多行复合命令的第一行被保存，那么第二行及后续行不会被测试，无论 HISTCONTROL 的值如何都会被添加到历史中。如果第一行未被保存，那么该命令的第二行及后续行也不会被保存。

HISTFILE ¶

The name of the file to which the command history is saved. Bash assigns a default value of ~/.bash_history. If HISTFILE is unset or null, the shell does not save the command history when it exits.
命令历史记录保存的文件名。Bash 会将默认值设为 ~/.bash_history 。如果 HISTFILE 未设置或为空，当 shell 退出时不会保存命令历史记录。

HISTFILESIZE ¶

The maximum number of lines contained in the history file. When this variable is assigned a value, the history file is truncated, if necessary, to contain no more than the number of history entries that total no more than that number of lines by removing the oldest entries. If the history list contains multi-line entries, the history file may contain more lines than this maximum to avoid leaving partial history entries. The history file is also truncated to this size after writing it when a shell exits or by the history builtin. If the value is 0, the history file is truncated to zero size. Non-numeric values and numeric values less than zero inhibit truncation. The shell sets the default value to the value of HISTSIZE after reading any startup files.
历史文件中包含的最大行数。当此变量被赋予一个值时，如果需要，历史文件会被截断，以确保其中包含的命令历史记录条目总数不超过该数值，通过删除最旧的条目来实现。如果历史列表中包含多行条目，历史文件可能包含比此最大值更多的行，以避免留下不完整的记录。当 shell 退出或通过 history 内建命令写入时，历史文件也会被截断到此大小。如果值为 0，历史文件会被截断为零大小。非数字值和小于零的数字值会阻止截断。shell 在读取任何启动文件后，会将此变量的默认值设置为 HISTSIZE 的值。

HISTIGNORE ¶

A colon-separated list of patterns used to decide which command lines should be saved on the history list. If a command line matches one of the patterns in the value of HISTIGNORE, it is not saved on the history list. Each pattern is anchored at the beginning of the line and must match the complete line (Bash does not implicitly append a ‘*’). Each pattern is tested against the line after the checks specified by HISTCONTROL are applied. In addition to the normal shell pattern matching characters, ‘&’ matches the previous history line. A backslash escapes the ‘&’; the backslash is removed before attempting a match. If the first line of a multi-line compound command was saved, the second and subsequent lines are not tested, and are added to the history regardless of the value of HISTIGNORE. If the first line was not saved, the second and subsequent lines of the command are not saved either. The pattern matching honors the setting of the extglob shell option.
用于决定哪些命令行应保存在历史列表中的冒号分隔的模式列表。如果命令行匹配 HISTIGNORE 值中的任何一个模式，则不会保存在历史列表中。每个模式都锚定在行的开头，并且必须完全匹配整行（Bash 不会隐式地添加‘ * ’）。每个模式在应用了 HISTCONTROL 指定的检查之后，才会对行进行测试。除了正常的 shell 模式匹配字符外，‘ & ’匹配前一条历史行。反斜杠用于转义‘ & ’；在尝试匹配之前，反斜杠会被移除。如果一个多行复合命令的第一行被保存，那么第二行及后续行不会被测试，无论 HISTIGNORE 的值如何，都会被添加到历史记录中。如果第一行没有被保存，那么该命令的第二行及后续行也不会被保存。模式匹配会尊重 extglob shell 选项的设置。

HISTIGNORE subsumes some of the function of HISTCONTROL. A pattern of ‘&’ is identical to ignoredups, and a pattern of ‘[ ]*’ is identical to ignorespace. Combining these two patterns, separating them with a colon, provides the functionality of ignoreboth.
HISTIGNORE 有些功能被 HISTCONTROL 所包含。模式‘ & ’与 ignoredups 相同，模式‘ [ ]* ’与 ignorespace 相同。将这两个模式用冒号分隔组合起来，提供了 ignoreboth 的功能。

HISTSIZE ¶

The maximum number of commands to remember on the history list. If the value is 0, commands are not saved in the history list. Numeric values less than zero result in every command being saved on the history list (there is no limit). The shell sets the default value to 500 after reading any startup files.
历史列表中要记住的命令最大数量。如果值为 0，命令不会被保存在历史列表中。数值小于零则表示所有命令都会被保存在历史列表中（没有限制）。shell 在读取任何启动文件后会将默认值设置为 500。

HISTTIMEFORMAT ¶

If this variable is set and not null, its value is used as a format string for strftime(3) to print the time stamp associated with each history entry displayed by the history builtin. If this variable is set, the shell writes time stamps to the history file so they may be preserved across shell sessions. This uses the history comment character to distinguish timestamps from other history lines.
如果此变量被设置且不为空，其值将被用作 strftime (3) 的格式字符串，以打印由 history 内置命令显示的每个历史条目关联的时间戳。如果此变量被设置，shell 会将时间戳写入历史文件，以便在不同的 shell 会话中保留。这使用历史注释字符来区分时间戳和其他历史行。

HOSTFILE ¶

Contains the name of a file in the same format as /etc/hosts that should be read when the shell needs to complete a hostname. The list of possible hostname completions may be changed while the shell is running; the next time hostname completion is attempted after the value is changed, Bash adds the contents of the new file to the existing list. If HOSTFILE is set, but has no value, or does not name a readable file, Bash attempts to read /etc/hosts to obtain the list of possible hostname completions. When HOSTFILE is unset, Bash clears the hostname list.
包含一个与 /etc/hosts 相同格式的文件名，当 shell 需要完成主机名时应读取该文件。在 shell 运行期间，可能的主机名补全列表可能会被更改；在更改值后下一次尝试主机名补全时，Bash 会将新文件的内容添加到现有的列表中。如果 HOSTFILE 被设置，但没有值，或者没有指向可读文件，则 Bash 尝试读取 /etc/hosts 以获取可能的主机名补全列表。当 HOSTFILE 未设置时，Bash 会清除主机名列表。

HOSTNAME ¶

The name of the current host.
当前主机的名称。

HOSTTYPE ¶

A string describing the machine Bash is running on.
描述 Bash 正在运行的机器的字符串。

IGNOREEOF ¶

Controls the action of the shell on receipt of an EOF character as the sole input. If set, the value is the number of consecutive EOF characters that can be read as the first character on an input line before Bash exits. If the variable is set but does not have a numeric value, or the value is null, then the default is 10. If the variable is unset, then EOF signifies the end of input to the shell. This is only in effect for interactive shells.
控制 shell 在接收到 EOF 字符作为唯一输入时的行为。如果设置，其值是 Bash 在退出之前可以读取的连续 EOF 字符的数量。如果变量被设置但没有数值，或者值为空，则默认为 10。如果变量未设置，则 EOF 表示 shell 输入的结束。此设置仅对交互式 shell 有效。

INPUTRC ¶

The name of the Readline initialization file, overriding the default of ~/.inputrc.
Readline 初始化文件的名称，覆盖默认的 ~/.inputrc 。

INSIDE_EMACS ¶

If Bash finds this variable in the environment when the shell starts, it assumes that the shell is running in an Emacs shell buffer and may disable line editing depending on the value of TERM.
如果 Bash 在启动时在环境中找到此变量，它会假定 shell 正在 Emacs shell 缓冲区中运行，并可能根据 TERM 的值禁用行编辑。

LANG ¶

Used to determine the locale category for any category not specifically selected with a variable starting with LC_.
用于确定任何未通过以 LC_ 开头的变量明确选择的 locale 类别。

LC_ALL ¶

This variable overrides the value of LANG and any other LC_ variable specifying a locale category.
此变量覆盖 LANG 的值以及任何其他 LC_ 变量所指定的 locale 类别。

LC_COLLATE ¶

This variable determines the collation order used when sorting the results of filename expansion, and determines the behavior of range expressions, equivalence classes, and collating sequences within filename expansion and pattern matching (see Filename Expansion).
该变量决定了在对文件名展开结果进行排序时所使用的排序顺序，并决定了文件名展开和模式匹配中范围表达式、等价类和排序序列的行为（参见文件名展开）。

LC_CTYPE ¶

This variable determines the interpretation of characters and the behavior of character classes within filename expansion and pattern matching (see Filename Expansion).
此变量决定了字符在文件名展开和模式匹配中的解释方式以及字符类的行为（参见文件名展开）。

LC_MESSAGES ¶

This variable determines the locale used to translate double-quoted strings preceded by a ‘$’ (see Locale-Specific Translation).
此变量决定了用于翻译以‘ $ ’开头的双引号字符串的区域设置。

LC_NUMERIC ¶

This variable determines the locale category used for number formatting.
此变量决定了用于数字格式化的区域设置类别。

LC_TIME ¶

This variable determines the locale category used for data and time formatting.
此变量决定了用于日期和时间格式化的区域设置类别。

LINENO ¶

The line number in the script or shell function currently executing. Line numbers start with 1. When not in a script or function, the value is not guaranteed to be meaningful. If LINENO is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
脚本或正在执行的 shell 函数中的当前行号。行号从 1 开始。当不在脚本或函数中时，该值可能没有实际意义。如果 LINENO 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

LINES ¶

Used by the select command to determine the column length for printing selection lists. Automatically set if the checkwinsize option is enabled (see The Shopt Builtin), or in an interactive shell upon receipt of a SIGWINCH.
由 select 命令使用以确定打印选择列表时的列宽。如果启用了 checkwinsize 选项（参见 The Shopt Builtin），或者在交互式 shell 中接收到 SIGWINCH 时，会自动设置。

MACHTYPE ¶

A string that fully describes the system type on which Bash is executing, in the standard GNU cpu-company-system format.
一个字符串，以标准的 GNU cpu-company-system 格式完整描述 Bash 正在运行的系统类型。

MAILCHECK ¶

How often (in seconds) that the shell should check for mail in the files specified in the MAILPATH or MAIL variables. The default is 60 seconds. When it is time to check for mail, the shell does so before displaying the primary prompt. If this variable is unset, or set to a value that is not a number greater than or equal to zero, the shell disables mail checking.
shell 检查指定在 MAILPATH 或 MAIL 变量中的邮件文件的频率（以秒为单位）。默认值为 60 秒。当需要检查邮件时，shell 会在显示主提示符之前进行检查。如果该变量未设置，或设置的值不是大于或等于零的数字，shell 将禁用邮件检查。

MAPFILE ¶

An array variable created to hold the text read by the mapfile builtin when no variable name is supplied.
用于保存由 mapfile 内置命令读取的文本数组变量，当未提供变量名时。

OLDPWD ¶

The previous working directory as set by the cd builtin.
由 cd 内置命令设置的上一个工作目录。

OPTERR ¶

If set to the value 1, Bash displays error messages generated by the getopts builtin command. OPTERR is initialized to 1 each time the shell is invoked.
如果设置为 1，Bash 会显示由 getopts 内置命令生成的错误信息。 OPTERR 每次调用 shell 时都会被初始化为 1。

OSTYPE ¶

A string describing the operating system Bash is running on.
描述 Bash 正在运行的操作系统的字符串。

PIPESTATUS ¶

An array variable (see Arrays) containing a list of exit status values from the commands in the most-recently-executed foreground pipeline, which may consist of only a simple command (see Shell Commands). Bash sets PIPESTATUS after executing multi-element pipelines, timed and negated pipelines, simple commands, subshells created with the ‘(’ operator, the [[ and (( compound commands, and after error conditions that result in the shell aborting command execution.
一个数组变量（参见数组），包含最近一次执行的前台管道中各个命令的退出状态值，该管道可能仅包含一个简单命令（参见 Shell 命令）。Bash 在执行多元素管道、定时和否定管道、简单命令、使用‘ ( ’操作符创建的子 shell、 [[ 和 (( 复合命令，以及导致 shell 中止命令执行的错误情况后，会设置 PIPESTATUS 。

POSIXLY_CORRECT ¶

If this variable is in the environment when Bash starts, the shell enters POSIX mode (see Bash and POSIX) before reading the startup files, as if the --posix invocation option had been supplied. If it is set while the shell is running, Bash enables POSIX mode, as if the command
如果 Bash 启动时该变量存在于环境中，shell 会在读取启动文件之前进入 POSIX 模式（参见 Bash 和 POSIX），如同已指定 --posix 调用选项。如果在 shell 运行期间设置该变量，Bash 会启用 POSIX 模式，如同已执行命令

set -o posix

had been executed. When the shell enters POSIX mode, it sets this variable if it was not already set.
已经执行过。当 shell 进入 POSIX 模式时，如果该变量尚未设置，它会设置这个变量。

PPID ¶

The process ID of the shell’s parent process. This variable is readonly.
shell 父进程的进程 ID。这个变量是只读的。

PROMPT_COMMAND ¶

If this variable is set, and is an array, the value of each set element is interpreted as a command to execute before printing the primary prompt ($PS1). If this is set but not an array variable, its value is used as a command to execute instead.
如果此变量被设置，并且是一个数组，则每个设置元素的值被解释为在打印主提示符（ $PS1 ）之前执行的命令。如果此变量被设置但不是数组变量，其值将被用作替代的命令。

PROMPT_DIRTRIM ¶

If set to a number greater than zero, the value is used as the number of trailing directory components to retain when expanding the \w and \W prompt string escapes (see Controlling the Prompt). Characters removed are replaced with an ellipsis.
如果设置为大于零的数字，该值将被用作在扩展 \w 和 \W 提示符字符串转义时保留的尾随目录组件的数量（参见控制提示符）。被删除的字符将被替换为省略号。

PS0 ¶

The value of this parameter is expanded like PS1 and displayed by interactive shells after reading a command and before the command is executed.
此参数的值会像 PS1 一样进行展开，并在交互式外壳读取命令并在执行该命令之前显示。

PS3 ¶

The value of this variable is used as the prompt for the select command. If this variable is not set, the select command prompts with ‘#? ’
此变量的值被用作 select 命令的提示符。如果此变量未被设置，则 select 命令使用‘ #? ’作为提示符。

PS4 ¶

The value of this parameter is expanded like PS1 and the expanded value is the prompt printed before the command line is echoed when the -x option is set (see The Set Builtin). The first character of the expanded value is replicated multiple times, as necessary, to indicate multiple levels of indirection. The default is ‘+ ’.
此参数的值会像 PS1 一样进行展开，当设置了 -x 选项时（参见 The Set Builtin），展开后的值是在命令行被输出前打印的提示符。展开后的值的第一个字符会根据需要被重复多次，以表示多级间接引用。默认值为‘ + ’。

PWD ¶

The current working directory as set by the cd builtin.
由 cd 内置命令设置的当前工作目录。

RANDOM ¶

Each time this parameter is referenced, it expands to a random integer between 0 and 32767. Assigning a value to RANDOM initializes (seeds) the sequence of random numbers. Seeding the random number generator with the same constant value produces the same sequence of values. If RANDOM is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
每次引用此参数时，它都会展开为 0 到 32767 之间的随机整数。对 RANDOM 赋值会初始化（播种）随机数序列。使用相同的常量值播种随机数生成器会产生相同的数值序列。如果 RANDOM 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

READLINE_ARGUMENT ¶

Any numeric argument given to a Readline command that was defined using ‘bind -x’ (see Bash Builtin Commands when it was invoked.
任何传递给使用‘ bind -x ’定义的 Readline 命令的数值参数，都会在该命令被调用时（参见 Bash Builtin Commands）被处理。

READLINE_LINE ¶

The contents of the Readline line buffer, for use with ‘bind -x’ (see Bash Builtin Commands).
Readline 行缓冲区的内容，用于‘ bind -x ’（见 Bash 内置命令）。

READLINE_MARK ¶

The position of the mark (saved insertion point) in the Readline line buffer, for use with ‘bind -x’ (see Bash Builtin Commands). The characters between the insertion point and the mark are often called the region.
Readline 行缓冲区中标记（保存的插入点）的位置，用于‘ bind -x ’（见 Bash 内置命令）。插入点和标记之间的字符通常被称为区域。

READLINE_POINT ¶

The position of the insertion point in the Readline line buffer, for use with ‘bind -x’ (see Bash Builtin Commands).
Readline 行缓冲区中插入点的位置，用于‘ bind -x ’（见 Bash 内置命令）。

REPLY ¶

The default variable for the read builtin; set to the line read when read is not supplied a variable name argument.
read 内置命令的默认变量；当未提供变量名参数时，设置为读取的行。

SECONDS ¶

This variable expands to the number of seconds since the shell was started. Assignment to this variable resets the count to the value assigned, and the expanded value becomes the value assigned plus the number of seconds since the assignment. The number of seconds at shell invocation and the current time are always determined by querying the system clock at one-second resolution. If SECONDS is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
此变量展开为自 shell 启动以来经过的秒数。对此变量进行赋值会将计数重置为赋的值，并且展开后的值变为赋的值加上自赋值以来经过的秒数。在 shell 调用时和当前时间的秒数总是通过查询系统时钟来确定，精度为一秒。如果 SECONDS 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后被重置也是如此。

SHELL ¶

This environment variable expands to the full pathname to the shell. If it is not set when the shell starts, Bash assigns to it the full pathname of the current user’s login shell.
此环境变量展开为 shell 的完整路径名。如果在 shell 启动时未设置该变量，Bash 会将其赋值为当前用户登录 shell 的完整路径名。

SHELLOPTS ¶

A colon-separated list of enabled shell options. Each word in the list is a valid argument for the -o option to the set builtin command (see The Set Builtin). The options appearing in SHELLOPTS are those reported as ‘on’ by ‘set -o’. If this variable is in the environment when Bash starts up, the shell enables each option in the list before reading any startup files. If this variable is exported, child shells will enable each option in the list. This variable is readonly.
一个由冒号分隔的已启用 shell 选项列表。列表中的每个单词都是 -o 选项在 set 内置命令中的有效参数（参见 Set 内置命令）。出现在 SHELLOPTS 中的选项是被‘ set -o ’报告为‘ on ’的选项。如果 Bash 启动时该变量已存在于环境中，shell 会在读取任何启动文件之前启用列表中的每个选项。如果该变量被导出，子 shell 也会启用列表中的每个选项。此变量为只读变量。

SHLVL ¶

Incremented by one each time a new instance of Bash is started. This is intended to be a count of how deeply your Bash shells are nested.
每次启动一个新的 Bash 实例时，该变量会增加 1。其目的是统计你的 Bash shell 嵌套的深度。

SRANDOM ¶

This variable expands to a 32-bit pseudo-random number each time it is referenced. The random number generator is not linear on systems that support /dev/urandom or arc4random, so each returned number has no relationship to the numbers preceding it. The random number generator cannot be seeded, so assignments to this variable have no effect. If SRANDOM is unset, it loses its special properties, even if it is subsequently reset.
这个变量每次被引用时都会展开为一个 32 位的伪随机数。在支持 /dev/urandom 或 arc4random 的系统中，随机数生成器不是线性的，因此每个返回的数字与前面的数字没有关系。随机数生成器不能被播种，因此对这个变量的赋值没有效果。如果 SRANDOM 未设置，它将失去其特殊属性，即使之后又被重置也是如此。

TIMEFORMAT ¶

The value of this parameter is used as a format string specifying how the timing information for pipelines prefixed with the time reserved word should be displayed. The ‘%’ character introduces an escape sequence that is expanded to a time value or other information. The escape sequences and their meanings are as follows; the brackets denote optional portions.
这个参数的值被用作一个格式字符串，指定如何显示以 time 保留字开头的管道的计时信息。‘ % ’字符引入一个转义序列，该转义序列会被展开为时间值或其他信息。转义序列及其含义如下；括号中的部分是可选的。

%%

A literal ‘%’.
字面量‘ % ’。

%[p][l]R

The elapsed time in seconds.
经过的时间（以秒为单位）。

%[p][l]U

The number of CPU seconds spent in user mode.
用户模式下消耗的 CPU 秒数。

%[p][l]S

The number of CPU seconds spent in system mode.
系统模式下消耗的 CPU 秒数。

%P

The CPU percentage, computed as (%U + %S) / %R.
CPU 使用百分比，计算方式为（%U + %S） / %R。

The optional p is a digit specifying the precision, the number of fractional digits after a decimal point. A value of 0 causes no decimal point or fraction to be output. time prints at most six digits after the decimal point; values of p greater than 6 are changed to 6. If p is not specified, time prints three digits after the decimal point.
可选的 p 是一个数字，指定精度，即小数点后的位数。p 的值为 0 时，不输出小数点或小数部分。 time 打印最多六位小数；p 的值大于 6 时会被改为 6。如果未指定 p，则 time 打印三位小数。

The optional l specifies a longer format, including minutes, of the form MMmSS.FFs. The value of p determines whether or not the fraction is included.
可选的 l 指定了更长的格式，包括分钟，形式为 MMmSS.FFs。p 的值决定了是否包含小数部分。

If this variable is not set, Bash acts as if it had the value
如果此变量未设置，Bash 会将其视为具有值 

$'\nreal\t%3lR\nuser\t%3lU\nsys\t%3lS'

If the value is null, Bash does not display any timing information. A trailing newline is added when the format string is displayed.
如果值为空，Bash 不会显示任何计时信息。当格式字符串被显示时，会添加一个尾随换行符。

TMOUT ¶

If set to a value greater than zero, the read builtin uses the value as its default timeout (see Bash Builtin Commands). The select command (see Conditional Constructs) terminates if input does not arrive after TMOUT seconds when input is coming from a terminal.
如果设置为大于零的值， read 内建命令会使用该值作为默认超时时间（参见 Bash 内建命令）。 select 命令（参见条件结构）在从终端读取输入时，如果在 TMOUT 秒内没有收到输入，则终止。

In an interactive shell, the value is interpreted as the number of seconds to wait for a line of input after issuing the primary prompt. Bash terminates after waiting for that number of seconds if a complete line of input does not arrive.
在交互式 shell 中，该值被解释为在显示主提示符后等待输入行的秒数。如果在等待该数量的秒数后仍未收到完整的一行输入，Bash 将终止。

TMPDIR ¶

If set, Bash uses its value as the name of a directory in which Bash creates temporary files for the shell’s use.
如果设置，Bash 使用该值作为创建 shell 临时文件的目录名称。

UID ¶

The numeric real user id of the current user. This variable is readonly.
当前用户的数值型真实用户 ID。此变量为只读。

6 Bash 特性 ¶

本章描述了 Bash 特有的功能。

6.1 Invoking Bash ¶
6.1 启动 Bash ¶

bash [long-opt] [-ir] [-abefhkmnptuvxdBCDHP] [-o option]
    [-O shopt_option] [argument ...]
bash [long-opt] [-abefhkmnptuvxdBCDHP] [-o option]
    [-O shopt_option] -c string [argument ...]
bash [long-opt] -s [-abefhkmnptuvxdBCDHP] [-o option]
    [-O shopt_option] [argument ...]

All of the single-character options used with the set builtin (see The Set Builtin) can be used as options when the shell is invoked. In addition, there are several multi-character options that you can use. These options must appear on the command line before the single-character options to be recognized.
在使用 set 内建命令（参见 Set 内建命令）时所用的所有单字符选项都可以作为选项在启动 shell 时使用。此外，还有一些多字符选项可供使用。这些选项必须出现在命令行上单字符选项之前才能被识别。

--debugger

Arrange for the debugger profile to be executed before the shell starts. Turns on extended debugging mode (see The Shopt Builtin for a description of the extdebug option to the shopt builtin).
在 shell 启动前执行调试器配置文件。开启扩展调试模式（有关 extdebug 选项的描述，请参见 The Shopt Builtin）。

--dump-po-strings

Print a list of all double-quoted strings preceded by ‘$’ on the standard output in the GNU gettext PO (portable object) file format. Equivalent to -D except for the output format.
在 GNU gettext PO（可移植对象）文件格式中，将所有以‘ $ ’开头的双引号字符串列表打印到标准输出。等同于 -D ，只是输出格式不同。

--dump-strings

Equivalent to -D.
等同于 -D 。

--help

Display a usage message on standard output and exit successfully.
在标准输出上显示使用信息并成功退出。

--init-file filename
--rcfile filename

Execute commands from filename (instead of ~/.bashrc) in an interactive shell.
从文件名（而不是 ~/.bashrc ）执行命令，在交互式 shell 中。

--login

Equivalent to -l.
等同于 -l 。

--noediting

Do not use the GNU Readline library (see Command Line Editing) to read command lines when the shell is interactive.
当 shell 是交互式的时，不要使用 GNU Readline 库（参见命令行编辑）来读取命令行。

--noprofile

Don’t load the system-wide startup file /etc/profile or any of the personal initialization files ~/.bash_profile, ~/.bash_login, or ~/.profile when Bash is invoked as a login shell.
当 Bash 作为登录 shell 被调用时，不要加载系统范围的启动文件 /etc/profile 或任何个人初始化文件 ~/.bash_profile 、 ~/.bash_login 或 ~/.profile 。

--norc

Don’t read the ~/.bashrc initialization file in an interactive shell. This is on by default if the shell is invoked as sh.
不要在交互式 shell 中读取 ~/.bashrc 初始化文件。如果 shell 被调用为 sh ，则默认会这样做。

--posix

Enable POSIX mode; change the behavior of Bash where the default operation differs from the POSIX standard to match the standard. This is intended to make Bash behave as a strict superset of that standard. See Bash and POSIX, for a description of the Bash POSIX mode.
启用 POSIX 模式；将 Bash 的行为在默认操作与 POSIX 标准不同时，改为符合标准。这旨在使 Bash 的行为成为 POSIX 标准的严格超集。有关 Bash POSIX 模式的描述，请参见 Bash 和 POSIX 部分。

--restricted

Equivalent to -r. Make the shell a restricted shell (see The Restricted Shell).
等同于 -r 。使 shell 成为受限 shell（参见受限 shell 部分）。

--verbose

Equivalent to -v. Print shell input lines as they’re read.
等同于 -v 。在读取时打印 shell 输入行。

--version

Show version information for this instance of Bash on the standard output and exit successfully.
显示此 Bash 实例的版本信息到标准输出并成功退出。

There are several single-character options that may be supplied at invocation which are not available with the set builtin.
在调用时可以提供几个单字符选项，这些选项无法通过 set 内置命令使用。

-c

Read and execute commands from the first non-option argument command_string, then exit. If there are arguments after the command_string, the first argument is assigned to $0 and any remaining arguments are assigned to the positional parameters. The assignment to $0 sets the name of the shell, which is used in warning and error messages.
从第一个非选项参数 command_string 读取并执行命令，然后退出。如果 command_string 后面还有参数，第一个参数将被分配给 $0 ，其余的参数将被分配给位置参数。分配给 $0 的参数将设置 shell 的名称，该名称用于警告和错误信息中。

-i

Force the shell to run interactively. Interactive shells are described in Interactive Shells.
强制 shell 以交互模式运行。交互式 shell 的描述请参见 Interactive Shells。

-l

Make this shell act as if it had been directly invoked by login. When the shell is interactive, this is equivalent to starting a login shell with ‘exec -l bash’. When the shell is not interactive, it will read and execute the login shell startup files. ‘exec bash -l’ or ‘exec bash --login’ will replace the current shell with a Bash login shell. See Bash Startup Files, for a description of the special behavior of a login shell.
使这个 shell 表现得好像它是由 login 直接调用的。当 shell 是交互式的时候，这等同于用‘ exec -l bash ’启动一个 login shell。当 shell 不是交互式的时候，它会读取并执行 login shell 的启动文件。‘ exec bash -l ’或‘ exec bash --login ’将用 Bash login shell 替换当前的 shell。参见 Bash Startup Files，了解 login shell 的特殊行为。

-r

Make the shell a restricted shell (see The Restricted Shell).
使 shell 成为受限 shell（参见 The Restricted Shell）。

-s

If this option is present, or if no arguments remain after option processing, then Bash reads commands from the standard input. This option allows the positional parameters to be set when invoking an interactive shell or when reading input through a pipe.
如果存在此选项，或者在处理完选项后没有剩余参数，则 Bash 从标准输入读取命令。此选项允许在调用交互式 shell 或通过管道读取输入时设置位置参数。

-D

Print a list of all double-quoted strings preceded by ‘$’ on the standard output. These are the strings that are subject to language translation when the current locale is not C or POSIX (see Locale-Specific Translation). This implies the -n option; no commands will be executed.
在标准输出上打印所有以‘ $ ’开头的双引号字符串。这些字符串在当前区域设置不是 C 或 POSIX （参见 Locale-Specific Translation）时会受到语言翻译的影响。这隐含了 -n 选项；不会执行任何命令。

[-+]O [shopt_option]

shopt_option is one of the shell options accepted by the shopt builtin (see The Shopt Builtin). If shopt_option is present, -O sets the value of that option; +O unsets it. If shopt_option is not supplied, Bash prints the names and values of the shell options accepted by shopt on the standard output. If the invocation option is +O, the output is displayed in a format that may be reused as input.
shopt_option 是由 shopt 内置命令接受的 shell 选项之一（参见 The Shopt Builtin）。如果 shopt_option 存在， -O 设置该选项的值； +O 取消该选项。如果未提供 shopt_option，Bash 会将 shopt 所接受的 shell 选项的名称和值打印到标准输出。如果调用选项是 +O ，输出格式可以被重新用作输入。

--

A -- signals the end of options and disables further option processing. Any arguments after the -- are treated as a shell script filename (see Shell Scripts) and arguments passed to that script.
A -- 表示选项结束，并禁用进一步的选项处理。 -- 之后的任何参数都被视为 shell 脚本文件名（参见 Shell Scripts）以及传递给该脚本的参数。

-

Equivalent to --.
等同于 -- 。

A login shell is one whose first character of argument zero is ‘-’, or one invoked with the --login option.
一个登录 shell 是指其参数零的第一个字符是 ‘ - ’，或者是由 --login 选项调用的 shell。

An interactive shell is one started without non-option arguments, unless -s is specified, without specifying the -c option, and whose standard input and standard error are both connected to terminals (as determined by isatty(3)), or one started with the -i option. See Interactive Shells, for more information.
交互式 shell 是在没有指定非选项参数（除非指定了 -s ）且没有指定 -c 选项的情况下启动的，并且其标准输入和标准错误都连接到终端（由 isatty(3)确定），或者是在启动时指定了 -i 选项的 shell。更多信息请参见 Interactive Shells 部分。

If arguments remain after option processing, and neither the -c nor the -s option has been supplied, the first argument is treated as the name of a file containing shell commands (see Shell Scripts). When Bash is invoked in this fashion, $0 is set to the name of the file, and the positional parameters are set to the remaining arguments. Bash reads and executes commands from this file, then exits. Bash’s exit status is the exit status of the last command executed in the script. If no commands are executed, the exit status is 0. Bash first attempts to open the file in the current directory, and, if no file is found, searches the directories in PATH for the script.
如果在处理选项之后还有参数剩余，并且没有提供 -c 或 -s 选项，那么第一个参数会被视为包含 shell 命令的文件名（参见 Shell Scripts）。当 Bash 以这种方式被调用时， $0 会被设置为该文件名，而位置参数会被设置为剩余的参数。Bash 会从该文件中读取并执行命令，然后退出。Bash 的退出状态是脚本中最后执行的命令的退出状态。如果没有执行任何命令，退出状态为 0。Bash 首先尝试在当前目录中打开该文件，如果没有找到，则会在 PATH 指定的目录中搜索脚本。

Next: Interactive Shells, Previous: Invoking Bash, Up: Bash Features   [Contents][Index]

6.2 Bash Startup Files ¶
6.2 Bash 启动文件 ¶

This section describes how Bash executes its startup files. If any of the files exist but cannot be read, Bash reports an error. Tildes are expanded in filenames as described above under Tilde Expansion (see Tilde Expansion).
本节描述了 Bash 如何执行其启动文件。如果任何文件存在但无法读取，Bash 会报告错误。文件名中的波浪线（~）按照上面“波浪线展开”部分所述进行展开。

Interactive shells are described in Interactive Shells.
交互式 shell 的描述请参见 Interactive Shells。

Invoked as an interactive login shell, or with --login ¶
作为交互式登录壳调用，或带有 --login ¶

When Bash is invoked as an interactive login shell, or as a non-interactive shell with the --login option, it first reads and executes commands from the file /etc/profile, if that file exists. After reading that file, it looks for ~/.bash_profile, ~/.bash_login, and ~/.profile, in that order, and reads and executes commands from the first one that exists and is readable. The --noprofile option inhibits this behavior.
当 Bash 作为交互式登录壳调用，或作为非交互式壳并带有 --login 选项调用时，它首先会读取并执行文件 /etc/profile 中的命令，如果该文件存在的话。读取完该文件后，它会按顺序查找 ~/.bash_profile 、 ~/.bash_login 和 ~/.profile ，并从第一个存在的且可读的文件中读取并执行命令。 --noprofile 选项会抑制这种行为。

When an interactive login shell exits, or a non-interactive login shell executes the exit builtin command, Bash reads and executes commands from the file ~/.bash_logout, if it exists.
当交互式登录壳退出，或非交互式登录壳执行 exit 内置命令时，Bash 会从文件 ~/.bash_logout 中读取并执行命令，如果该文件存在的话。

Invoked as an interactive non-login shell ¶
作为交互式非登录壳调用 ¶

When Bash runs as an interactive shell that is not a login shell, it reads and executes commands from ~/.bashrc, if that file exists. The --norc option inhibits this behavior. The --rcfile file option causes Bash to use file instead of ~/.bashrc.
当 Bash 作为非登录的交互式 shell 运行时，如果该文件存在，它会读取并执行 ~/.bashrc 中的命令。 --norc 选项会抑制这种行为。 --rcfile file 选项会使 Bash 使用 file 代替 ~/.bashrc 。

So, typically, your ~/.bash_profile contains the line
因此，通常你的 ~/.bash_profile 文件中包含以下行 

if [ -f ~/.bashrc ]; then . ~/.bashrc; fi

after (or before) any login-specific initializations.
在（或在）任何登录特定的初始化设置之后（或之前）。

Invoked non-interactively ¶
非交互式调用 ¶

When Bash is started non-interactively, to run a shell script, for example, it looks for the variable BASH_ENV in the environment, expands its value if it appears there, and uses the expanded value as the name of a file to read and execute. Bash behaves as if the following command were executed:
当 Bash 以非交互方式启动，例如运行一个 shell 脚本时，它会在环境中查找变量 BASH_ENV ，如果存在则展开其值，并使用展开后的值作为要读取和执行的文件名。Bash 的行为如同执行了以下命令：

if [ -n "$BASH_ENV" ]; then . "$BASH_ENV"; fi

but does not the value of the PATH variable to search for the filename.
但不会将 PATH 变量的值用于搜索文件名。

As noted above, if a non-interactive shell is invoked with the --login option, Bash attempts to read and execute commands from the login shell startup files.
如上所述，如果非交互式 shell 以 --login 选项调用，Bash 会尝试从登录 shell 的启动文件中读取并执行命令。

Invoked with name sh ¶
以名称 sh 调用 ¶

If Bash is invoked with the name sh, it tries to mimic the startup behavior of historical versions of sh as closely as possible, while conforming to the POSIX standard as well.
如果 Bash 以名称 sh 被调用，它会尽可能地模仿历史版本 sh 的启动行为，同时符合 POSIX 标准。

When invoked as an interactive login shell, or as a non-interactive shell with the --login option, it first attempts to read and execute commands from /etc/profile and ~/.profile, in that order. The --noprofile option inhibits this behavior.
当以交互式登录 shell 或非交互式 shell 并带有 --login 选项调用时，它首先尝试按顺序从 /etc/profile 和 ~/.profile 读取并执行命令。 --noprofile 选项会抑制这种行为。

When invoked as an interactive shell with the name sh, Bash looks for the variable ENV, expands its value if it is defined, and uses the expanded value as the name of a file to read and execute. Since a shell invoked as sh does not attempt to read and execute commands from any other startup files, the --rcfile option has no effect.
当以名称 sh 作为交互式 shell 调用时，Bash 会查找变量 ENV ，如果该变量已定义则进行展开，并使用展开后的值作为要读取并执行的文件名。由于以 sh 方式调用的 shell 不会尝试从任何其他启动文件中读取并执行命令，因此 --rcfile 选项在此情况下没有效果。

A non-interactive shell invoked with the name sh does not attempt to read any other startup files.
以名称 sh 调用的非交互式 shell 不会尝试读取任何其他启动文件。

When invoked as sh, Bash enters POSIX mode after reading the startup files.
当以 sh 调用时，Bash 在读取启动文件后进入 POSIX 模式。

Invoked in POSIX mode ¶
在 POSIX 模式下调用 ¶

When Bash is started in POSIX mode, as with the --posix command line option, it follows the POSIX standard for startup files. In this mode, interactive shells expand the ENV variable and read and execute commands from the file whose name is the expanded value. No other startup files are read.
当 Bash 以 POSIX 模式启动时，如同使用 --posix 命令行选项一样，它遵循 POSIX 标准来处理启动文件。在此模式下，交互式 shell 会扩展 ENV 变量，并从文件名由扩展后的值指定的文件中读取并执行命令。不会读取其他启动文件。

Invoked by remote shell daemon ¶
由远程 shell 守护进程调用 ¶

Bash attempts to determine when it is being run with its standard input connected to a network connection, as when executed by the historical and rarely-seen remote shell daemon, usually rshd, or the secure shell daemon sshd. If Bash determines it is being run non-interactively in this fashion, it reads and executes commands from ~/.bashrc, if that file exists and is readable. Bash does not read this file if invoked as sh. The --norc option inhibits this behavior, and the --rcfile option makes Bash use a different file instead of ~/.bashrc, but neither rshd nor sshd generally invoke the shell with those options or allow them to be specified.
Bash 尝试确定它是否以标准输入连接到网络连接的方式运行，例如当由历史上的、很少见的远程外壳守护进程 rshd 或安全外壳守护进程 sshd 执行时。如果 Bash 以这种方式非交互式地运行，它会从 ~/.bashrc 读取并执行命令，如果该文件存在且可读的话。如果 Bash 是以 sh 方式调用的，则不会读取该文件。 --norc 选项会抑制这种行为，而 --rcfile 选项会使 Bash 使用不同于 ~/.bashrc 的文件，但通常 rshd 和 sshd 不会以这些选项调用外壳，也不会允许这些选项被指定。

Invoked with unequal effective and real UID/GIDs ¶
以有效用户（组）ID 与实际用户（组）ID 不相等的方式调用 ¶

If Bash is started with the effective user (group) id not equal to the real user (group) id, and the -p option is not supplied, no startup files are read, shell functions are not inherited from the environment, the SHELLOPTS, BASHOPTS, CDPATH, and GLOBIGNORE variables, if they appear in the environment, are ignored, and the effective user id is set to the real user id. If the -p option is supplied at invocation, the startup behavior is the same, but the effective user id is not reset.
如果 Bash 以有效用户（组）ID 不等于实际用户（组）ID 的方式启动，并且未提供 -p 选项，则不会读取启动文件，环境中的 shell 函数不会被继承，如果环境变量中存在 SHELLOPTS 、 BASHOPTS 、 CDPATH 和 GLOBIGNORE ，则会被忽略，并将有效用户 ID 设置为实际用户 ID。如果在调用时提供了 -p 选项，则启动行为相同，但不会重置有效用户 ID。

Next: Bash Conditional Expressions, Previous: Bash Startup Files, Up: Bash Features   [Contents][Index]

6.3 Interactive Shells ¶
6.3 交互式外壳 ¶

  • What is an Interactive Shell?
    什么是交互式外壳？
  • Is this Shell Interactive?
    这个外壳是交互式的吗？
  • Interactive Shell Behavior
    交互式外壳行为

Next: Is this Shell Interactive?, Up: Interactive Shells   [Contents][Index]

6.3.1 What is an Interactive Shell? ¶
6.3.1 什么是交互式外壳？ ¶

An interactive shell is one started without non-option arguments (unless -s is specified) and without specifying the -c option, whose input and error output are both connected to terminals (as determined by isatty(3)), or one started with the -i option.
一个交互式 shell 是指没有提供非选项参数（除非指定了 -s ）并且没有指定 -c 选项的 shell，其输入和错误输出都连接到终端（由 isatty(3) 确定），或者是指以 -i 选项启动的 shell。

An interactive shell generally reads from and writes to a user’s terminal.
一个交互式外壳通常从用户的终端读取并写入数据。

The -s invocation option may be used to set the positional parameters when an interactive shell starts.
-s 选项可以在交互式 shell 启动时用来设置位置参数。

Next: Interactive Shell Behavior, Previous: What is an Interactive Shell?, Up: Interactive Shells   [Contents][Index]

6.3.2 Is this Shell Interactive? ¶
6.3.2 这个 shell 是交互式的吗？ ¶

To determine within a startup script whether or not Bash is running interactively, test the value of the ‘-’ special parameter. It contains i when the shell is interactive. For example:
在启动脚本中判断 Bash 是否在交互模式下运行，可以测试‘ - ’特殊参数的值。当 shell 是交互式时，该参数包含 i 。例如：

case "$-" in
*i*)	echo This shell is interactive ;;
*)	echo This shell is not interactive ;;
esac

Alternatively, startup scripts may examine the variable PS1; it is unset in non-interactive shells, and set in interactive shells. Thus:
或者，启动脚本可以检查变量 PS1 ；在非交互式 shell 中该变量未设置，在交互式 shell 中该变量被设置。因此：

if [ -z "$PS1" ]; then
        echo This shell is not interactive
else
        echo This shell is interactive
fi

Previous: Is this Shell Interactive?, Up: Interactive Shells   [Contents][Index]

6.3.3 Interactive Shell Behavior ¶
6.3.3 交互式 Shell 的行为 ¶

When the shell is running interactively, it changes its behavior in several ways.
当 shell 以交互方式运行时，它的行为会以几种方式发生变化。

  1. Bash reads and executes startup files as described in Bash Startup Files.
    Bash 会按照 Bash 启动文件 中所述的方式读取并执行启动文件。
  2. Job Control (see Job Control) is enabled by default. When job control is in effect, Bash ignores the keyboard-generated job control signals SIGTTIN, SIGTTOU, and SIGTSTP.
    作业控制（参见作业控制）默认是启用的。当作业控制生效时，Bash 会忽略由键盘生成的作业控制信号 SIGTTIN , SIGTTOU , 和 SIGTSTP 。
  3. Bash executes the values of the set elements of the PROMPT_COMMAND array variable as commands before printing the primary prompt, $PS1 (see Bash Variables).
    Bash 在打印主提示符 $PS1 之前，会执行 PROMPT_COMMAND 数组变量中 set 元素的值作为命令（参见 Bash 变量）。
  4. Bash expands and displays PS1 before reading the first line of a command, and expands and displays PS2 before reading the second and subsequent lines of a multi-line command. Bash expands and displays PS0 after it reads a command but before executing it. See Controlling the Prompt, for a complete list of prompt string escape sequences.
    Bash 在读取命令的第一行之前扩展并显示 PS1 ，并在读取多行命令的第二行及后续行之前扩展并显示 PS2 。Bash 在读取完命令后但在执行之前扩展并显示 PS0 。有关提示符字符串转义序列的完整列表，请参见控制提示符。
  5. Bash uses Readline (see Command Line Editing) to read commands from the user’s terminal.
    Bash 使用 Readline（参见命令行编辑）从用户的终端读取命令。
  6. Bash inspects the value of the ignoreeof option to set -o instead of exiting immediately when it receives an EOF on its standard input when reading a command (see The Set Builtin).
    Bash 检查 ignoreeof 选项的值，而不是在从标准输入读取命令时立即退出，当它接收到 EOF 时（参见 The Set Builtin）。
  7. Bash enables Command history (see Bash History Facilities) and history expansion (see History Expansion) by default. When a shell with history enabled exits, Bash saves the command history to the file named by $HISTFILE.
    Bash 默认启用命令历史记录（参见 Bash 历史记录功能）和历史扩展（参见历史扩展）。当启用了历史记录的 shell 退出时，Bash 会将命令历史记录保存到由 $HISTFILE 指定的文件中。
  8. Alias expansion (see Aliases) is performed by default.
    默认情况下会执行别名扩展（参见别名）。
  9. In the absence of any traps, Bash ignores SIGTERM (see Signals).
    在没有设置任何陷阱的情况下，Bash 会忽略 SIGTERM （参见信号）。
  10. In the absence of any traps, SIGINT is caught and handled (see Signals). SIGINT will interrupt some shell builtins.
    在没有设置任何陷阱的情况下， SIGINT 会被捕获并处理（见信号）。 SIGINT 会中断一些 shell 内置命令。
  11. An interactive login shell sends a SIGHUP to all jobs on exit if the huponexit shell option has been enabled (see Signals).
    一个交互式登录 shell 在退出时，如果启用了 huponexit shell 选项（见信号），会向所有作业发送 SIGHUP 。
  12. The -n option has no effect, whether at invocation or when using ‘set -n’ (see The Set Builtin).
  13. Bash will check for mail periodically, depending on the values of the MAIL, MAILPATH, and MAILCHECK shell variables (see Bash Variables).
    Bash 会根据 MAIL 、 MAILPATH 和 MAILCHECK 这三个 shell 变量的值定期检查是否有新邮件（见 Bash 变量）。
  14. The shell will not exit on expansion errors due to references to unbound shell variables after ‘set -u’ has been enabled (see The Set Builtin).
    当 ‘ set -u ’ 被启用后，由于对未绑定 shell 变量的引用导致的展开错误不会使 shell 退出（见 Set 内置命令）。
  15. The shell will not exit on expansion errors caused by var being unset or null in ${var:?word} expansions (see Shell Parameter Expansion).
    shell 在 ${var:?word} 扩展中由于 var 未设置或为空导致的展开错误不会退出 (见 Shell 参数展开)。
  16. Redirection errors encountered by shell builtins will not cause the shell to exit.
    shell 内置命令遇到的重定向错误不会导致 shell 退出。
  17. When running in POSIX mode, a special builtin returning an error status will not cause the shell to exit (see Bash and POSIX).
    在 POSIX 模式下，一个返回错误状态的特殊内置命令不会导致 shell 退出 (见 Bash 和 POSIX)。
  18. A failed exec will not cause the shell to exit (see Bourne Shell Builtins).
    一个失败的 exec 不会导致 shell 退出 (见 Bourne Shell 内置命令)。
  19. Parser syntax errors will not cause the shell to exit.
    解析器语法错误不会导致 shell 退出。
  20. If the cdspell shell option is enabled, the shell will attempt simple spelling correction for directory arguments to the cd builtin (see the description of the cdspell option to the shopt builtin in The Shopt Builtin). The cdspell option is only effective in interactive shells.
    如果启用了 cdspell shell 选项，shell 将尝试对 cd 内置命令的目录参数进行简单的拼写更正（参见 The Shopt Builtin 中 shopt 内置命令的 cdspell 选项描述）。 cdspell 选项仅在交互式 shell 中生效。
  21. The shell will check the value of the TMOUT variable and exit if a command is not read within the specified number of seconds after printing $PS1 (see Bash Variables).
    shell 将检查 TMOUT 变量的值，并在打印 $PS1 后指定的秒数内未读取到命令时退出（参见 Bash Variables）。

Next: Shell Arithmetic, Previous: Interactive Shells, Up: Bash Features   [Contents][Index]
