10.1 Basic Installation ¶
10.1 基本安装 ¶

These are installation instructions for Bash.
这些是 Bash 的安装说明。

The simplest way to compile Bash is:
编译 Bash 的最简单方法是：

  1. cd to the directory containing the source code and type ‘./configure’ to configure Bash for your system. If you’re using csh on an old version of System V, you might need to type ‘sh ./configure’ instead to prevent csh from trying to execute configure itself.
    cd 进入包含源代码的目录并输入 ‘ ./configure ’ 来为你的系统配置 Bash。如果你在旧版本的 System V 上使用 csh ，你可能需要输入 ‘ sh ./configure ’ 来防止 csh 尝试执行 configure 本身。

    Running configure takes some time. While running, it prints messages telling which features it is checking for.
    运行 configure 会花费一些时间。运行过程中，它会打印信息，说明正在检查哪些功能。

  2. Type ‘make’ to compile Bash and build the bashbug bug reporting script.
    输入 ‘ make ’ 来编译 Bash 并构建 bashbug 报告错误的脚本。
  3. Optionally, type ‘make tests’ to run the Bash test suite.
    可选地，输入 ‘ make tests ’ 来运行 Bash 的测试套件。
  4. Type ‘make install’ to install bash and bashbug. This will also install the manual pages and Info file, message translation files, some supplemental documentation, a number of example loadable builtin commands, and a set of header files for developing loadable builtins. You may need additional privileges to install bash to your desired destination, which may require ‘sudo make install’. More information about controlling the locations where bash and other files are installed is below (see Installation Names).
    输入 ‘ make install ’ 来安装 bash 和 bashbug 。这还将安装手册页和 Info 文件，消息翻译文件，一些补充文档，多个示例可加载内置命令，以及开发可加载内置命令所需的头文件。你可能需要额外的权限才能将 bash 安装到你希望的位置，这可能需要 ‘ sudo make install ’。关于控制 bash 和其他文件安装位置的更多信息，请参见下面的“安装路径”部分。

The configure shell script attempts to guess correct values for various system-dependent variables used during compilation. It uses those values to create a Makefile in each directory of the package (the top directory, the builtins, doc, po, and support directories, each directory under lib, and several others). It also creates a config.h file containing system-dependent definitions. Finally, it creates a shell script named config.status that you can run in the future to recreate the current configuration, a file config.cache that saves the results of its tests to speed up reconfiguring, and a file config.log containing compiler output (useful mainly for debugging configure). If at some point config.cache contains results you don’t want to keep, you may remove or edit it.

To find out more about the options and arguments that the configure script understands, type
要了解 configure 脚本所支持的选项和参数，请输入

bash-4.2$ ./configure --help

at the Bash prompt in your Bash source directory.
在你的 Bash 源代码目录下的 Bash 提示符下。

If you want to build Bash in a directory separate from the source directory – to build for multiple architectures, for example – just use the full path to the configure script. The following commands will build Bash in a directory under /usr/local/build from the source code in /usr/local/src/bash-4.4:
如果你想在与源代码目录不同的目录中构建 Bash（例如，为了构建多个架构的版本），只需使用 configure 脚本的完整路径。以下命令将从 /usr/local/src/bash-4.4 中的源代码构建 Bash 到 /usr/local/build 目录下的子目录中： 

mkdir /usr/local/build/bash-4.4
cd /usr/local/build/bash-4.4
bash /usr/local/src/bash-4.4/configure
make

See Compiling For Multiple Architectures for more information about building in a directory separate from the source.
如需了解有关在与源代码不同的目录中构建的信息，请参阅“为多种架构编译”部分。

If you need to do unusual things to compile Bash, please try to figure out how configure could check whether or not to do them, and mail diffs or instructions to bash-maintainers@gnu.org so they can be considered for the next release.
如果你需要对编译 Bash 进行一些不寻常的操作，请尝试弄清楚 configure 是否能够检查是否需要执行这些操作，并将差异或说明通过电子邮件发送到 bash-maintainers@gnu.org，以便在下一个版本中考虑。

The file configure.ac is used to create configure by a program called Autoconf. You only need configure.ac if you want to change it or regenerate configure using a newer version of Autoconf. If you do this, make sure you are using Autoconf version 2.69 or newer.
该文件 configure.ac 是由一个名为 Autoconf 的程序用来创建 configure 的。只有在你想修改它或使用较新版本的 Autoconf 重新生成 configure 时才需要 configure.ac 。如果你这样做，请确保你使用的是 Autoconf 版本 2.69 或更高版本。

You can remove the program binaries and object files from the source code directory by typing ‘make clean’. To also remove the files that configure created (so you can compile Bash for a different kind of computer), type ‘make distclean’.
你可以通过输入 ‘ make clean ’ 来删除源代码目录中的程序二进制文件和对象文件。如果你想同时删除 configure 创建的文件（这样你就可以为不同类型的计算机编译 Bash），则输入 ‘ make distclean ’。

Next: Compiling For Multiple Architectures, Previous: Basic Installation, Up: Installing Bash   [Contents][Index]

10.2 Compilers and Options ¶
10.2 编译器和选项 ¶

Some systems require unusual options for compilation or linking that the configure script does not know about. You can give configure initial values for variables by setting them in the environment. Using a Bourne-compatible shell, you can do that on the command line like this:
某些系统在编译或链接时需要 configure 脚本所不知道的特殊选项。您可以通过在环境变量中设置它们来给 configure 变量提供初始值。使用兼容 Bourne 的 shell，您可以在命令行中这样做：

CC=c89 CFLAGS=-O2 LIBS=-lposix ./configure

On systems that have the env program, you can do it like this:
在拥有 env 程序的系统上，您可以这样做：

env CPPFLAGS=-I/usr/local/include LDFLAGS=-s ./configure

The configuration process uses GCC to build Bash if it is available.
如果可用，配置过程会使用 GCC 来构建 Bash。

Next: Installation Names, Previous: Compilers and Options, Up: Installing Bash   [Contents][Index]
Next: 安装名称， Previous: 编译器和选项， Up: 安装 Bash [ 内容][ 索引]

10.3 Compiling For Multiple Architectures ¶
10.3 为多种架构编译 ¶

You can compile Bash for more than one kind of computer at the same time, by placing the object files for each architecture in their own directory. To do this, you must use a version of make that supports the VPATH variable, such as GNU make. cd to the directory where you want the object files and executables to go and run the configure script from the source directory (see Basic Installation). You may need to supply the --srcdir=PATH argument to tell configure where the source files are. configure automatically checks for the source code in the directory that configure is in and in ...
你可以同时为多种不同的计算机架构编译 Bash，方法是将每个架构的 object 文件放在各自的目录中。要做到这一点，你必须使用一个支持 VPATH 变量的 make 版本，例如 GNU make 。进入你希望存放 object 文件和可执行文件的目录，并从源代码目录运行 configure 脚本（参见基本安装）。你可能需要提供 --srcdir=PATH 参数来告诉 configure 源代码文件的位置。 configure 会自动检查 configure 所在目录以及 .. 中的源代码。

If you have to use a make that does not support the VPATH variable, you can compile Bash for one architecture at a time in the source code directory. After you have installed Bash for one architecture, use ‘make distclean’ before reconfiguring for another architecture.
如果你必须使用一个不支持 VPATH 变量的 make ，你可以在源代码目录中一次为一个架构编译 Bash。在为一个架构安装完 Bash 之后，在重新配置另一个架构之前使用‘ make distclean ’。

Alternatively, if your system supports symbolic links, you can use the support/mkclone script to create a build tree which has symbolic links back to each file in the source directory. Here’s an example that creates a build directory in the current directory from a source directory /usr/gnu/src/bash-2.0:
或者，如果你的系统支持符号链接，你可以使用 support/mkclone 脚本来创建一个包含指向源代码目录中每个文件的符号链接的构建树。以下是从源代码目录 /usr/gnu/src/bash-2.0 创建一个构建目录在当前目录中的示例：

bash /usr/gnu/src/bash-2.0/support/mkclone -s /usr/gnu/src/bash-2.0 .

The mkclone script requires Bash, so you must have already built Bash for at least one architecture before you can create build directories for other architectures.
mkclone 脚本需要 Bash，因此你必须在为其他架构创建构建目录之前，已经为至少一个架构构建了 Bash。

Next: Specifying the System Type, Previous: Compiling For Multiple Architectures, Up: Installing Bash   [Contents][Index]
下一步：指定系统类型，上一步：为多种架构编译，向上：安装 Bash [目录][索引]

10.4 Installation Names ¶
10.4 安装名称 ¶

By default, ‘make install’ will install into /usr/local/bin, /usr/local/man, etc.; that is, the installation prefix defaults to /usr/local. You can specify an installation prefix other than /usr/local by giving configure the option --prefix=PATH, or by specifying a value for the prefix ‘make’ variable when running ‘make install’ (e.g., ‘make install prefix=PATH’). The prefix variable provides a default for exec_prefix and other variables used when installing Bash.
默认情况下，‘ make install ’ 会安装到 /usr/local/bin 、 /usr/local/man 等目录中；也就是说，安装前缀默认为 /usr/local 。你可以通过给 configure 指定选项 --prefix=PATH ，或者在运行 ‘ make install ’ 时为 prefix ‘ make ’ 变量指定一个值（例如 ‘ make install prefix=PATH ’）来指定不同于 /usr/local 的安装前缀。 prefix 变量为 exec_prefix 和其他安装 Bash 时使用的变量提供默认值。

You can specify separate installation prefixes for architecture-specific files and architecture-independent files. If you give configure the option --exec-prefix=PATH, ‘make install’ will use PATH as the prefix for installing programs and libraries. Documentation and other data files will still use the regular prefix.
你可以为特定架构的文件和非特定架构的文件分别指定安装前缀。如果你给 configure 指定选项 --exec-prefix=PATH ，‘ make install ’ 将使用 PATH 作为安装程序和库的前缀。文档和其他数据文件仍会使用常规前缀。

If you would like to change the installation locations for a single run, you can specify these variables as arguments to make: ‘make install exec_prefix=/’ will install bash and bashbug into /bin instead of the default /usr/local/bin.
如果你想在单次运行中更改安装位置，可以将这些变量作为参数传递给 make ：‘ make install exec_prefix=/ ’ 会将 bash 和 bashbug 安装到 /bin 而不是默认的 /usr/local/bin 。

If you want to see the files Bash will install and where it will install them without changing anything on your system, specify the variable DESTDIR as an argument to make. Its value should be the absolute directory path you’d like to use as the root of your sample installation tree. For example,
如果你想查看 Bash 将安装哪些文件以及安装位置，而不改变你的系统，可以将变量 DESTDIR 作为参数传递给 make 。其值应为你希望用作示例安装树根目录的绝对路径。例如， 

mkdir /fs1/bash-install
make install DESTDIR=/fs1/bash-install

will install bash into /fs1/bash-install/usr/local/bin/bash, the documentation into directories within /fs1/bash-install/usr/local/share, the example loadable builtins into /fs1/bash-install/usr/local/lib/bash, and so on. You can use the usual exec_prefix and prefix variables to alter the directory paths beneath the value of DESTDIR.
会将 bash 安装到 /fs1/bash-install/usr/local/bin/bash ，文档安装到 /fs1/bash-install/usr/local/share 内的目录，示例可加载的内置命令安装到 /fs1/bash-install/usr/local/lib/bash ，依此类推。你可以使用通常的 exec_prefix 和 prefix 变量来修改 DESTDIR 值下的目录路径。

The GNU Makefile standards provide a more complete description of these variables and their effects.
GNU Makefile 标准提供了这些变量及其影响的更完整描述。

Next: Sharing Defaults, Previous: Installation Names, Up: Installing Bash   [Contents][Index]

10.5 Specifying the System Type ¶
10.5 指定系统类型 ¶

There may be some features configure can not figure out automatically, but needs to determine by the type of host Bash will run on. Usually configure can figure that out, but if it prints a message saying it can not guess the host type, give it the --host=TYPE option. ‘TYPE’ can either be a short name for the system type, such as ‘sun4’, or a canonical name with three fields: ‘CPU-COMPANY-SYSTEM’ (e.g., ‘i386-unknown-freebsd4.2’).
有些特性 configure 无法自动识别，但需要根据 Bash 运行的主机类型来确定。通常 configure 能够识别出主机类型，但如果它打印出一条信息说无法猜测主机类型，请使用 --host=TYPE 选项。‘ TYPE ’可以是系统类型的简短名称，如‘ sun4 ’，也可以是具有三个字段的标准名称：‘ CPU-COMPANY-SYSTEM ’（例如‘ i386-unknown-freebsd4.2 ’）。

See the file support/config.sub for the possible values of each field.
参见文件 support/config.sub 以了解每个字段的可能值。

Next: Operation Controls, Previous: Specifying the System Type, Up: Installing Bash   [Contents][Index]
Next: 操作控制, Previous: 指定系统类型, Up: 安装 Bash [ 内容][ 索引]

10.6 Sharing Defaults ¶
10.6 共享默认值 ¶

If you want to set default values for configure scripts to share, you can create a site shell script called config.site that gives default values for variables like CC, cache_file, and prefix. configure looks for PREFIX/share/config.site if it exists, then PREFIX/etc/config.site if it exists. Or, you can set the CONFIG_SITE environment variable to the location of the site script. A warning: the Bash configure looks for a site script, but not all configure scripts do.
如果你想为 configure 脚本设置共享的默认值，可以创建一个名为 config.site 的站点外壳脚本，为像 CC 、 cache_file 和 prefix 这样的变量提供默认值。 configure 会先查找 PREFIX/share/config.site ，如果存在的话，然后查找 PREFIX/etc/config.site 。或者，你可以设置 CONFIG_SITE 环境变量来指定站点脚本的位置。警告：Bash configure 会查找站点脚本，但并不是所有的 configure 脚本都会这样做。

Next: Optional Features, Previous: Sharing Defaults, Up: Installing Bash   [Contents][Index]
Next: 可选功能， Previous: 共享默认值， Up: 安装 Bash [ 内容][ 索引]

10.7 Operation Controls ¶
10.7 操作控制 ¶

configure recognizes the following options to control how it operates.
configure 识别以下选项以控制其操作方式。

--cache-file=file

Use and save the results of the tests in file instead of ./config.cache. Set file to /dev/null to disable caching, for debugging configure.
将测试结果用于文件而不是 ./config.cache 。设置 file 为 /dev/null 以禁用缓存，用于调试 configure 。

--help

Print a summary of the options to configure, and exit.
打印 configure 的选项摘要，并退出。

--quiet
--silent
-q

Do not print messages saying which checks are being made.
不要打印说明正在执行哪些检查的信息。

--srcdir=dir

Look for the Bash source code in directory dir. Usually configure can determine that directory automatically.
在目录 dir 中查找 Bash 源代码。通常 configure 可以自动确定该目录。

--version

Print the version of Autoconf used to generate the configure script, and exit.
打印用于生成 configure 脚本的 Autoconf 版本，并退出。

configure also accepts some other, not widely used, boilerplate options. ‘configure --help’ prints the complete list.
configure 也接受一些其他不常用的标准选项。‘ configure --help ’ 会打印完整的列表。

Previous: Operation Controls, Up: Installing Bash   [Contents][Index]

10.8 Optional Features ¶
10.8 可选功能 ¶

The Bash configure has a number of --enable-feature options, where feature indicates an optional part of Bash. There are also several --with-package options, where package is something like ‘bash-malloc’ or ‘afs’. To turn off the default use of a package, use --without-package. To configure Bash without a feature that is enabled by default, use --disable-feature.
Bash configure 有许多 --enable-feature 选项，其中 feature 表示 Bash 的可选部分。还有一些 --with-package 选项，其中 package 是像 ‘ bash-malloc ’ 或 ‘ afs ’ 这样的东西。要关闭某个包的默认使用，使用 --without-package 。要配置 Bash 以禁用默认启用的某个功能，使用 --disable-feature 。

Here is a complete list of the --enable- and --with- options that the Bash configure recognizes.
以下是 Bash configure 所识别的 --enable- 和 --with- 选项的完整列表。

--with-afs

Define if you are using the Andrew File System from Transarc.
定义你是否在使用 Transarc 的 Andrew 文件系统。

--with-bash-malloc

Use the Bash version of malloc in the directory lib/malloc. This is not the same malloc that appears in GNU libc, but a custom version originally derived from the 4.2 BSD malloc. This malloc is very fast, but wastes some space on each allocation, though it uses several techniques to minimize the waste. This option is enabled by default. The NOTES file contains a list of systems for which this should be turned off, and configure disables this option automatically for a number of systems.
使用目录 lib/malloc 中的 Bash 版本 malloc 。这并不是 GNU libc 中出现的 malloc ，而是一个最初源自 4.2 BSD 的定制版本 malloc 。这个 malloc 非常快速，但每次分配时会浪费一些空间，不过它使用了多种技术来尽量减少浪费。此选项默认启用。 NOTES 文件列出了应禁用此功能的系统， configure 会自动为多个系统禁用此选项。

--with-curses

Use the curses library instead of the termcap library. configure usually chooses this automatically, since most systems include the termcap functions in the curses library.
使用 curses 库而不是 termcap 库。 configure 通常会自动选择这个选项，因为大多数系统都在 curses 库中包含了 termcap 函数。

--with-gnu-malloc

A synonym for --with-bash-malloc.
Readline 的同义词。

--with-installed-readline[=PREFIX]

Define this to make Bash link with a locally-installed version of Readline rather than the version in lib/readline. This works only with Readline 5.0 and later versions. If PREFIX is yes or not supplied, configure uses the values of the make variables includedir and libdir, which are subdirectories of prefix by default, to find the installed version of Readline if it is not in the standard system include and library directories. If PREFIX is no, Bash links with the version in lib/readline. If PREFIX is set to any other value, configure treats it as a directory pathname and looks for the installed version of Readline in subdirectories of that directory (include files in PREFIX/include and the library in PREFIX/lib). The Bash default is to link with a static library built in the lib/readline subdirectory of the build directory.
定义此变量使 Bash 使用本地安装的 Readline 版本而不是 lib/readline 中的版本。这仅适用于 Readline 5.0 及以后的版本。如果 PREFIX 是 yes 或未设置， configure 会使用 make 变量 includedir 和 libdir 的值，这些值默认是 prefix 的子目录，以在标准系统 include 和 library 目录之外查找已安装的 Readline。如果 PREFIX 是 no ，Bash 会链接 lib/readline 中的版本。如果 PREFIX 设置为其他任何值， configure 会将其视为目录路径，并在该目录的子目录中查找已安装的 Readline（包含文件在 PREFIX/ include ，库在 PREFIX/ lib 中）。Bash 默认会在构建目录的 lib/readline 子目录中链接静态库。

--with-libintl-prefix[=PREFIX]

Define this to make Bash link with a locally-installed version of the libintl library instead of the version in lib/intl.
定义此变量使 Bash 使用本地安装的 libintl 库版本而不是 lib/intl 中的版本。

--with-libiconv-prefix[=PREFIX]

Define this to make Bash look for libiconv in PREFIX instead of the standard system locations. The Bash distribution does not include this library.
定义此变量使 Bash 在 PREFIX 路径下查找 libiconv，而不是标准系统路径。Bash 发行版不包含此库。

--enable-minimal-config

This produces a shell with minimal features, closer to the historical Bourne shell.
这会产生一个功能最少的 shell，更接近历史上的 Bourne shell。

There are several --enable- options that alter how Bash is compiled, linked, and installed, rather than changing run-time features.
有一些 --enable- 选项会改变 Bash 的编译、链接和安装方式，而不是改变运行时的功能。

--enable-largefile

Enable support for large files if the operating system requires special compiler options to build programs which can access large files. This is enabled by default, if the operating system provides large file support.
如果操作系统需要特殊的编译选项来构建能够访问大文件的程序，则启用对大文件的支持。如果操作系统提供了大文件支持，这项功能默认是启用的。

--enable-profiling

This builds a Bash binary that produces profiling information to be processed by gprof each time it is executed.
这会构建一个 Bash 二进制文件，在每次执行时生成可供 gprof 处理的性能分析信息。

--enable-separate-helpfiles

Use external files for the documentation displayed by the help builtin instead of storing the text internally.
使用外部文件来存储由 help 内置命令显示的文档，而不是将文本存储在内部。

--enable-static-link

This causes Bash to be linked statically, if gcc is being used. This could be used to build a version to use as root’s shell.
这会导致 Bash 被静态链接，如果 gcc 被使用的话。这可以用来构建一个作为 root shell 使用的版本。

The ‘minimal-config’ option can be used to disable all of the following options, but it is processed first, so individual options may be enabled using ‘enable-feature’.
‘ minimal-config ’选项可以用来禁用所有后续选项，但它会首先被处理，因此可以使用‘ enable-feature ’来启用个别选项。

All of the following options except for ‘alt-array-implementation’, ‘disabled-builtins’, ‘direxpand-default’, ‘strict-posix-default’, and ‘xpg-echo-default’ are enabled by default, unless the operating system does not provide the necessary support.
所有下列选项除‘ alt-array-implementation ’、‘ disabled-builtins ’、‘ direxpand-default ’、‘ strict-posix-default ’和‘ xpg-echo-default ’外，默认都是启用的，除非操作系统不提供必要的支持。

--enable-alias

Allow alias expansion and include the alias and unalias builtins (see Aliases).
允许别名扩展，并包含 alias 和 unalias 内置命令（参见别名）。

--enable-alt-array-implementation

This builds Bash using an alternate implementation of arrays (see Arrays) that provides faster access at the expense of using more memory (sometimes many times more, depending on how sparse an array is).
此方法使用数组的替代实现（参见数组）来构建 Bash，以换取更快的访问速度，但会消耗更多内存（有时会消耗许多倍的内存，具体取决于数组的稀疏程度）。

--enable-arith-for-command

Include support for the alternate form of the for command that behaves like the C language for statement (see Looping Constructs).
包含对 for 命令的替代形式的支持，其行为类似于 C 语言中的 for 语句（参见循环结构）。

--enable-array-variables

Include support for one-dimensional array shell variables (see Arrays).
支持一维数组 shell 变量（参见 Arrays）。

--enable-bang-history

Include support for csh-like history substitution (see History Expansion).
支持类似 csh 的历史替换（参见 History Expansion）。

--enable-bash-source-fullpath-default

Set the default value of the bash_source_fullpath shell option described above under The Shopt Builtin to be enabled. This controls how filenames are assigned to the BASH_SOURCE array variable.
将上述 The Shopt Builtin 中描述的 bash_source_fullpath shell 选项的默认值设为启用。这将控制如何将文件名分配给 BASH_SOURCE 数组变量。

--enable-brace-expansion

Include csh-like brace expansion ( b{a,b}c → bac bbc ). See Brace Expansion, for a complete description.
包含类似 csh 的花括号扩展（ b{a,b}c → bac bbc ）。有关完整描述，请参见 Brace Expansion。

--enable-casemod-attributes

Include support for case-modifying attributes in the declare builtin and assignment statements. Variables with the uppercase attribute, for example, will have their values converted to uppercase upon assignment.
包含对 declare 内置命令和赋值语句的大小写修改属性支持。例如，带有 uppercase 属性的变量在其赋值时会将其值转换为大写。

--enable-casemod-expansion

Include support for case-modifying word expansions.
包含对大小写修改单词展开的支持。

--enable-command-timing

Include support for recognizing time as a reserved word and for displaying timing statistics for the pipeline following time (see Pipelines). This allows timing pipelines, shell compound commands, shell builtins, and shell functions, which an external command cannot do easily.
包含对将 time 识别为保留字以及在 time 之后显示管道的定时统计信息的支持（参见管道）。这允许定时管道、shell 复合命令、shell 内置命令和 shell 函数，而外部命令难以轻松实现。

--enable-cond-command

Include support for the [[ conditional command. (see Conditional Constructs).
包含对 [[ 条件命令的支持。（参见条件结构）

--enable-cond-regexp

Include support for matching POSIX regular expressions using the ‘=~’ binary operator in the [[ conditional command. (see Conditional Constructs).
在条件命令中包含使用‘ =~ ’二进制操作符匹配 POSIX 正则表达式的支持。(参见条件结构)。

--enable-coprocesses

Include support for coprocesses and the coproc reserved word (see Pipelines).
包含对协处理程序和 coproc 保留字的支持(参见管道)。

--enable-debugger

Include support for the Bash debugger (distributed separately).
包含对 Bash 调试器的支持(单独分发)。

--enable-dev-fd-stat-broken

If calling stat on /dev/fd/N returns different results than calling fstat on file descriptor N, supply this option to enable a workaround. This has implications for conditional commands that test file attributes.
如果在/dev/fd/N 上调用 stat 返回的结果与在文件描述符 N 上调用 fstat 不同，请提供此选项以启用一个变通方法。这会对测试文件属性的条件命令产生影响。

--enable-direxpand-default

Cause the direxpand shell option (see The Shopt Builtin) to be enabled by default when the shell starts. It is normally disabled by default.
当 shell 启动时，默认启用 direxpand shell 选项（参见 Shopt 内建命令）。它通常默认是禁用的。

--enable-directory-stack

Include support for a csh-like directory stack and the pushd, popd, and dirs builtins (see The Directory Stack).
支持类似 csh 的目录栈以及 pushd 、 popd 和 dirs 内建命令（参见目录栈）。

--enable-disabled-builtins

Allow builtin commands to be invoked via ‘builtin xxx’ even after xxx has been disabled using ‘enable -n xxx’. See Bash Builtin Commands, for details of the builtin and enable builtin commands.
允许通过 ‘ builtin xxx ’ 来调用内建命令，即使 xxx 已经被使用 ‘ enable -n xxx ’ 禁用。有关 builtin 和 enable 内建命令的详细信息，请参见 Bash 内建命令。

--enable-dparen-arithmetic

Include support for the ((…)) command (see Conditional Constructs).
支持 ((…)) 命令（参见条件结构）。

--enable-extended-glob

Include support for the extended pattern matching features described above under Pattern Matching.
支持上述模式匹配部分中描述的扩展模式匹配功能。

--enable-extended-glob-default

Set the default value of the extglob shell option described above under The Shopt Builtin to be enabled.
将上述“shopt”内置命令中描述的 extglob shell 选项的默认值设置为启用状态。

--enable-function-import

Include support for importing function definitions exported by another instance of the shell from the environment. This option is enabled by default.
支持从环境导入由另一个 shell 实例导出的函数定义。此选项默认启用。

--enable-glob-asciiranges-default

Set the default value of the globasciiranges shell option described above under The Shopt Builtin to be enabled. This controls the behavior of character ranges when used in pattern matching bracket expressions.
将上述“shopt”内置命令中描述的 globasciiranges shell 选项的默认值设置为启用状态。这控制了在模式匹配括号表达式中使用字符范围时的行为。

--enable-help-builtin

Include the help builtin, which displays help on shell builtins and variables (see Bash Builtin Commands).
包含 help 内置命令，用于显示 shell 内置命令和变量的帮助信息（参见 Bash 内置命令）。

--enable-history

Include command history and the fc and history builtin commands (see Bash History Facilities).
包含命令历史记录以及 fc 和 history 内置命令（参见 Bash 历史功能）。

--enable-job-control

This enables the job control features (see Job Control), if the operating system supports them.
这启用了作业控制功能（参见作业控制），如果操作系统支持的话。

--enable-multibyte

This enables support for multibyte characters if the operating system provides the necessary support.
如果操作系统提供了必要的支持，这将启用对多字节字符的支持。

--enable-net-redirections

This enables the special handling of filenames of the form /dev/tcp/host/port and /dev/udp/host/port when used in redirections (see Redirections).
这将启用在重定向中使用形如 /dev/tcp/host/port 和 /dev/udp/host/port 的文件名时的特殊处理（参见重定向）。

--enable-process-substitution

This enables process substitution (see Process Substitution) if the operating system provides the necessary support.
这启用了进程替换功能（参见进程替换），如果操作系统提供了必要的支持的话。

--enable-progcomp

Enable the programmable completion facilities (see Programmable Completion). If Readline is not enabled, this option has no effect.
启用可编程补全功能（参见可编程补全）。如果未启用 Readline，则此选项无效。

--enable-prompt-string-decoding

Turn on the interpretation of a number of backslash-escaped characters in the $PS0, $PS1, $PS2, and $PS4 prompt strings. See Controlling the Prompt, for a complete list of prompt string escape sequences.
在 $PS0 、 $PS1 、 $PS2 和 $PS4 提示字符串中启用对多个反斜杠转义字符的解释。有关提示字符串转义序列的完整列表，请参见控制提示。

--enable-readline

Include support for command-line editing and history with the Bash version of the Readline library (see Command Line Editing).
包含对 Bash 版本的 Readline 库的命令行编辑和历史记录的支持（参见命令行编辑）。

--enable-restricted

Include support for a restricted shell. If this is enabled, Bash enters a restricted mode when called as rbash. See The Restricted Shell, for a description of restricted mode.
支持受限 shell。如果启用此功能，当 Bash 被调用为 rbash 时，会进入受限模式。有关受限模式的描述，请参见受限 shell 部分。

--enable-select

Include the select compound command, which allows generation of simple menus (see Conditional Constructs).
包含 select 复合命令，该命令允许生成简单的菜单（参见条件结构）。

--enable-single-help-strings

Store the text displayed by the help builtin as a single string for each help topic. This aids in translating the text to different languages. You may need to disable this if your compiler cannot handle very long string literals.
将 help 内置命令显示的文本存储为每个帮助主题的一个字符串。这有助于将文本翻译成不同的语言。如果你的编译器无法处理非常长的字符串字面量，可能需要禁用此功能。

--enable-strict-posix-default

Make Bash POSIX-conformant by default (see Bash and POSIX).
使 Bash 默认符合 POSIX 标准（参见 Bash 和 POSIX）。

--enable-translatable-strings

Enable support for $"string" translatable strings (see Locale-Specific Translation).
启用对 $"string" 可翻译字符串的支持（参见 Locale-Specific Translation）。

--enable-usg-echo-default

A synonym for --enable-xpg-echo-default.
--enable-xpg-echo-default 的同义词。

--enable-xpg-echo-default

Make the echo builtin expand backslash-escaped characters by default, without requiring the -e option. This sets the default value of the xpg_echo shell option to on, which makes the Bash echo behave more like the version specified in the Single Unix Specification, version 3. See Bash Builtin Commands, for a description of the escape sequences that echo recognizes.
使 echo 内置命令默认展开转义字符，而无需使用 -e 选项。这将设置 xpg_echo shell 选项的默认值为 on ，这使得 Bash 的 echo 更像单 Unix 规范版本 3 中所指定的行为。有关 echo 所识别的转义序列的描述，请参见 Bash 内置命令。

The file config-top.h contains C Preprocessor ‘#define’ statements for options which are not settable from configure. Some of these are not meant to be changed; beware of the consequences if you do. Read the comments associated with each definition for more information about its effect.
文件 config-top.h 包含 C 预处理器‘ #define ’语句，用于那些不能从 configure 设置的选项。其中一些选项不应被修改；如果你修改了，请注意其后果。有关每个定义的影响，请阅读相关注释。

Next: Major Differences From The Bourne Shell, Previous: Installing Bash, Up: Bash Features   [Contents][Index]

Appendix A Reporting Bugs ¶
附录 A 报告错误 ¶

Please report all bugs you find in Bash. But first, you should make sure that it really is a bug, and that it appears in the latest version of Bash. The latest released version of Bash is always available for FTP from ftp://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/bash/ and from http://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/bash.git/snapshot/bash-master.tar.gz.
请报告你在 Bash 中发现的所有错误。但首先，你应该确保这确实是一个错误，并且它出现在 Bash 的最新版本中。Bash 的最新发布版本总是可以通过 ftp://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/bash/ 从 FTP 获取，也可以从 http://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/bash.git/snapshot/bash-master.tar.gz. 获取。

Once you have determined that a bug actually exists, use the bashbug command to submit a bug report or use the form at the Bash project page. If you have a fix, you are encouraged to submit that as well! Suggestions and ‘philosophical’ bug reports may be mailed to bug-bash@gnu.org or help-bash@gnu.org.
一旦你确认确实存在一个错误，请使用 bashbug 命令提交错误报告，或者使用 Bash 项目页面上的表单。如果你有一个修复方法，也鼓励你一并提交！建议和“哲学性”的错误报告可以发送到 bug-bash@gnu.org 或 help-bash@gnu.org。

All bug reports should include:
所有错误报告都应包括：

  • The version number of Bash.
    Bash 的版本号。
  • The hardware and operating system.
    使用的硬件和操作系统。
  • The compiler used to compile Bash.
    编译 Bash 所用的编译器。
  • A description of the bug behavior.
    一个对错误行为的描述。
  • A short script or ‘recipe’ which exercises the bug and may be used to reproduce it.
    一个简短的脚本或“配方”，用于展示错误并可能用于重现它。

bashbug inserts the first three items automatically into the template it provides for filing a bug report.
bashbug 会自动将前三个项目插入到它提供的用于提交错误报告的模板中。

Please send all reports concerning this manual to bug-bash@gnu.org.
请将所有与此手册相关的报告发送到 bug-bash@gnu.org。

Next: GNU Free Documentation License, Previous: Reporting Bugs, Up: Bash Features   [Contents][Index]
下一节：GNU 自由文档许可证，上一节：报告错误，向上：Bash 特性 [目录][索引]

Appendix B Major Differences From The Bourne Shell ¶
附录 B 与 Bourne Shell 的主要差异 ¶

Bash implements essentially the same grammar, parameter and variable expansion, redirection, and quoting as the Bourne Shell. Bash uses the POSIX standard as the specification of how these features are to be implemented and how they should behave. There are some differences between the traditional Bourne shell and Bash; this section quickly details the differences of significance. A number of these differences are explained in greater depth in previous sections. This section uses the version of sh included in SVR4.2 (the last version of the historical Bourne shell) as the baseline reference.
Bash 实现了与 Bourne Shell 几乎相同的语法、参数和变量扩展、重定向以及引号功能。Bash 使用 POSIX 标准作为这些功能实现方式和行为规范的依据。Bash 与传统的 Bourne Shell 存在一些差异，本节简要说明这些有重要意义的差异。其中一些差异在前面的章节中已有更详细的解释。本节以 SVR4.2 版本（历史 Bourne Shell 的最后一个版本）中的 sh 作为基准参考。

  • Bash is POSIX-conformant, even where the POSIX specification differs from traditional sh behavior (see Bash and POSIX).
    Bash 是符合 POSIX 标准的，即使 POSIX 规范与传统 sh 的行为有所不同（参见 Bash 和 POSIX）。
  • Bash has multi-character invocation options (see Invoking Bash).
    Bash 支持多字符调用选项（参见 Invoking Bash）。
  • The Bash restricted mode is more useful (see The Restricted Shell); the SVR4.2 shell restricted mode is too limited.
    Bash 的受限模式更有用（参见 The Restricted Shell）；SVR4.2 shell 的受限模式则过于有限。
  • Bash has command-line editing (see Command Line Editing) and the bind builtin.
    Bash 具备命令行编辑功能（参见 Command Line Editing）以及 bind 内建命令。
  • Bash provides a programmable word completion mechanism (see Programmable Completion), and builtin commands complete, compgen, and compopt, to manipulate it.
    Bash 提供了可编程的单词补全机制（参见 Programmable Completion），并提供了内建命令 complete 、 compgen 和 compopt 来操作该机制。
  • Bash decodes a number of backslash-escape sequences in the prompt string variables (PS0, PS1, PS2, and PS4) (see Controlling the Prompt).
    Bash 在提示符字符串变量（ PS0 、 PS1 、 PS2 和 PS4 ）中解码许多反斜杠转义序列（参见控制提示符）。
  • Bash expands and displays the PS0 prompt string variable.
    Bash 展开并显示 PS0 提示字符串变量。
  • Bash runs commands from the PROMPT_COMMAND array variable before issuing each primary prompt.
    Bash 在显示每个主提示之前，会先从 PROMPT_COMMAND 数组变量中运行命令。
  • Bash has command history (see Bash History Facilities) and the history and fc builtins to manipulate it. The Bash history list maintains timestamp information and uses the value of the HISTTIMEFORMAT variable to display it.
    Bash 具有命令历史记录（参见 Bash 历史功能）以及 history 和 fc 内置命令来操作它。Bash 历史列表维护时间戳信息，并使用 HISTTIMEFORMAT 变量的值来显示它。
  • Bash implements csh-like history expansion (see History Expansion).
    Bash 实现了类似 csh 的历史扩展功能（参见历史扩展）。
  • Bash supports the $'…' quoting syntax, which expands ANSI-C backslash-escaped characters in the text between the single quotes (see ANSI-C Quoting).
    Bash 支持 $'…' 引号语法，该语法会扩展单引号之间文本中的 ANSI-C 反斜杠转义字符（参见 ANSI-C 引号）。
  • Bash supports the $"…" quoting syntax and performs locale-specific translation of the characters between the double quotes. The -D, --dump-strings, and --dump-po-strings invocation options list the translatable strings found in a script (see Locale-Specific Translation).
    Bash 支持 $"…" 引号语法，并对双引号之间的字符进行本地化特定的翻译。 -D 、 --dump-strings 和 --dump-po-strings 调用选项会列出脚本中发现的可翻译字符串（参见本地化特定翻译）。
  • Bash includes brace expansion (see Brace Expansion) and tilde expansion (see Tilde Expansion).
    Bash 包含大括号扩展（参见大括号扩展）和波浪号扩展（参见波浪号扩展）。
  • Bash implements command aliases and the alias and unalias builtins (see Aliases).
    Bash 实现了命令别名以及 alias 和 unalias 内置命令（参见别名）。
  • Bash implements the ! reserved word to negate the return value of a pipeline (see Pipelines). This is very useful when an if statement needs to act only if a test fails. The Bash ‘-o pipefail’ option to set will cause a pipeline to return a failure status if any command fails (see The Set Builtin).
    Bash 实现了 ! 保留字来否定管道命令的返回值（见 Pipelines）。这在需要仅当测试失败时才执行 if 语句时非常有用。Bash 的 ‘ -o pipefail ’ 选项在 set 时会导致管道命令在任何命令失败时返回失败状态（见 The Set Builtin）。
  • Bash has the time reserved word and command timing (see Pipelines). The display of the timing statistics may be controlled with the TIMEFORMAT variable.
    Bash 有 time 保留字和命令计时（见 Pipelines）。可以使用 TIMEFORMAT 变量来控制计时统计信息的显示。
  • Bash provides coprocesses and the coproc reserved word (see Coprocesses).
    Bash 提供了 coprocesses 和 coproc 保留字（见 Coprocesses）。
  • Bash implements the for (( expr1 ; expr2 ; expr3 )) arithmetic for command, similar to the C language (see Looping Constructs).
    Bash 实现了 for (( expr1 ; expr2 ; expr3 )) 算术运算用于命令，类似于 C 语言（见 Looping Constructs）。
  • Bash includes the select compound command, which allows the generation of simple menus (see Conditional Constructs).
    Bash 包含 select 组合命令，允许生成简单的菜单（参见条件结构）。
  • Bash includes the [[ compound command, which makes conditional testing part of the shell grammar (see Conditional Constructs), including optional regular expression matching.
    Bash 包含 [[ 组合命令，使条件测试成为 shell 语法的一部分（参见条件结构），包括可选的正则表达式匹配。
  • Bash provides optional case-insensitive matching for the case and [[ constructs (see Conditional Constructs).
    Bash 为 case 和 [[ 结构提供可选的不区分大小写的匹配（参见条件结构）。
  • Bash provides additional case statement action list terminators: ‘;&’ and ‘;;&’ (see Conditional Constructs).
    Bash 提供了额外的 case 语句动作列表终止符：‘ ;& ’ 和 ‘ ;;& ’（参见条件结构）。
  • Bash provides shell arithmetic, the (( compound command (see Conditional Constructs), the let builtin, and arithmetic expansion (see Shell Arithmetic).
    Bash 提供了 shell 算术， (( 复合命令（参见条件结构）， let 内建命令，以及算术扩展（参见 Shell 算术）。
  • Bash has one-dimensional array variables (see Arrays), and the appropriate variable expansions and assignment syntax to use them. Several of the Bash builtins take options to act on arrays. Bash provides a number of built-in array variables.
    Bash 支持一维数组变量（参见数组），并提供了相应的变量扩展和赋值语法。一些 Bash 内建命令接受选项来处理数组。Bash 提供了多个内建数组变量。
  • Variables present in the shell’s initial environment are automatically exported to child processes (see Command Execution Environment). The Bourne shell does not normally do this unless the variables are explicitly marked using the export command.
    shell 初始环境中的变量会自动导出到子进程（参见命令执行环境）。Bourne shell 通常不会这样做，除非使用 export 命令显式标记这些变量。
  • Bash can expand positional parameters beyond $9 using ${num} (see Shell Parameter Expansion).
    Bash 可以使用 ${num} 扩展位置参数，超出 $9 的范围（参见 Shell 参数扩展）。
  • Bash supports the ‘+=’ assignment operator, which appends to the value of the variable named on the left hand side (see Shell Parameters).
    Bash 支持 ‘ += ’ 赋值操作符，它将值追加到左边变量名所指定的变量中（参见 Shell 参数）。
  • Bash includes the POSIX pattern removal ‘%’, ‘#’, ‘%%’ and ‘##’ expansions to remove leading or trailing substrings from variable values (see Shell Parameter Expansion).
    Bash 包含 POSIX 模式删除的 ‘ % ’、‘ # ’、‘ %% ’ 和 ‘ ## ’ 扩展，用于从变量值中删除前导或尾随的子字符串（参见 Shell 参数扩展）。
  • The expansion ${#xx}, which returns the length of ${xx}, is supported (see Shell Parameter Expansion).
    扩展 ‘ ${#xx} ’，它返回 ${xx} 的长度，是被支持的（参见 Shell 参数扩展）。
  • The expansion ${var:offset[:length]}, which expands to the substring of var’s value of length length, beginning at offset, is present (see Shell Parameter Expansion).
    扩展 ‘ ${var: offset [: length ]} ’，它扩展为从 var 的值中，从 offset 开始长度为 length 的子字符串，是存在的（参见 Shell 参数扩展）。
  • The expansion ${var/[/]pattern[/replacement]}, which matches pattern and replaces it with replacement in the value of var, is available (see Shell Parameter Expansion), with a mechanism to use the matched text in replacement.
    ${var/[/] 模式 [/ 替换 ]} ，该模式匹配 pattern 并将其替换为 replacement 在 var 的值中，是可用的（参见 Shell 参数扩展），并且提供了一种在替换中使用匹配文本的机制。
  • The expansion ${!prefix*} expansion, which expands to the names of all shell variables whose names begin with prefix, is available (see Shell Parameter Expansion).
    ${!prefix*} 扩展，该扩展会扩展为所有以 prefix 开头的 shell 变量名，是可用的（参见 Shell 参数扩展）。
  • Bash has indirect variable expansion using ${!word} (see Shell Parameter Expansion) and implements the nameref variable attribute for automatic indirect variable expansion.
    Bash 使用 ${!word} 进行间接变量扩展（参见 Shell 参数扩展），并实现了 nameref 变量属性用于自动间接变量扩展。
  • Bash includes a set of parameter transformation word expansions of the form ${var@X}, where ‘X’ specifies the transformation (see Shell Parameter Expansion).
    Bash 包含一组参数转换单词扩展，形式为 ${var@X} ，其中 ‘ X ’ 指定转换类型（参见 Shell 参数扩展）。
  • The POSIX $() form of command substitution is implemented (see Command Substitution), and preferred to the Bourne shell’s `` (which is also implemented for backwards compatibility).
    命令替换的 POSIX $() 形式已实现（参见命令替换），并且优先于 Bourne shell 的 `` （也为了向后兼容而实现）。
  • Bash implements a variant of command substitution that runs the enclosed command in the current shell execution environment: ${ command;} or ${|command;} (see Command Substitution).
    Bash 实现了一种命令替换的变体，该变体在当前 shell 执行环境中运行被包含的命令： ${ command;} 或 ${|command;} （参见命令替换）。
  • Bash has process substitution (see Process Substitution).
    Bash 支持进程替换（参见进程替换）。
  • Bash automatically assigns variables that provide information about the current user (UID, EUID, and GROUPS), the current host (HOSTTYPE, OSTYPE, MACHTYPE, and HOSTNAME), and the instance of Bash that is running (BASH, BASH_VERSION, and BASH_VERSINFO). See Bash Variables, for details.
    Bash 会自动分配变量，提供有关当前用户（ UID 、 EUID 和 GROUPS ）、当前主机（ HOSTTYPE 、 OSTYPE 、 MACHTYPE 和 HOSTNAME ）以及正在运行的 Bash 实例（ BASH 、 BASH_VERSION 和 BASH_VERSINFO ）的信息。详情请参见 Bash Variables。
  • Bash uses many variables to provide functionality and customize shell behavior that the Bourne shell does not. Examples include RANDOM, SRANDOM, EPOCHSECONDS, EPOCHREALTIME, TIMEFORMAT, BASHPID, BASH_XTRACEFD, GLOBIGNORE, HISTIGNORE, and BASH_VERSION. See Bash Variables, for a complete list.
    Bash 使用许多变量来提供 Bourne shell 不具备的功能并自定义 shell 行为。示例包括 RANDOM 、 SRANDOM 、 EPOCHSECONDS 、 EPOCHREALTIME 、 TIMEFORMAT 、 BASHPID 、 BASH_XTRACEFD 、 GLOBIGNORE 、 HISTIGNORE 和 BASH_VERSION 。完整列表请参见 Bash Variables。
  • Bash uses the GLOBSORT shell variable to control how to sort the results of filename expansion (see Filename Expansion).
    Bash 使用 GLOBSORT shell 变量来控制文件名扩展结果的排序（参见文件名扩展）。
  • Bash uses the IFS variable to split only the results of expansion, not all words (see Word Splitting). This closes a longstanding shell security hole.
    Bash 使用 IFS 变量仅分割文件名扩展的结果，而不是所有单词（参见单词分割）。这弥补了一个长期存在的 shell 安全漏洞。
  • The filename expansion bracket expression code uses ‘!’ and ‘^’ to negate the set of characters between the brackets (see Filename Expansion). The Bourne shell uses only ‘!’.
    文件名扩展括号表达式代码使用 ‘ ! ’ 和 ‘ ^ ’ 来否定括号之间的字符集（参见文件名扩展）。Bourne shell 仅使用 ‘ ! ’。
  • Bash implements the full set of POSIX filename expansion operators, including character classes, equivalence classes, and collating symbols (see Filename Expansion).
    Bash 实现了完整的 POSIX 文件名扩展操作符，包括字符类、等价类和排序符号（参见文件名扩展）。
  • Bash implements extended pattern matching features when the extglob shell option is enabled (see Pattern Matching).
    Bash 实现了扩展的模式匹配功能，当启用 extglob shell 选项时（参见模式匹配）。
  • The globstar shell option extends filename expansion to recursively scan directories and subdirectories for matching filenames (see Pattern Matching).
    globstar shell 选项扩展了文件名扩展功能，使其能够递归地扫描目录和子目录以匹配文件名（参见模式匹配）。
  • It is possible to have a variable and a function with the same name; sh does not separate the two name spaces.
    可以有变量和函数同名； sh 不会将这两个名称空间分开。
  • Bash functions are permitted to have local variables using the local builtin, and thus users can write useful recursive functions (see Bash Builtin Commands).
    Bash 函数可以使用 local 内置命令来拥有局部变量，因此用户可以编写有用的递归函数（参见 Bash 内置命令）。
  • Bash performs filename expansion on filenames specified as operands to input and output redirection operators (see Redirections).
    Bash 对作为输入和输出重定向操作符的操作数指定的文件名执行文件名扩展（参见重定向）。
  • Bash contains the ‘<>’ redirection operator, allowing a file to be opened for both reading and writing, and the ‘&>’ redirection operator, for directing standard output and standard error to the same file (see Redirections).
    Bash 包含 ‘ <> ’ 重定向操作符，允许同时以读写方式打开文件，以及 ‘ &> ’ 重定向操作符，用于将标准输出和标准错误导向同一个文件（参见重定向）。
  • Bash includes the ‘<<<’ redirection operator, allowing a string to be used as the standard input to a command (see Redirections).
    Bash 包含 ‘ <<< ’ 重定向操作符，允许使用一个字符串作为命令的标准输入（参见重定向）。
  • Bash implements the ‘[n]<&word’ and ‘[n]>&word’ redirection operators, which move one file descriptor to another.
    Bash 实现了 ‘ [n]<&word ’ 和 ‘ [n]>&word ’ 重定向操作符，它们用于将一个文件描述符移动到另一个文件描述符。
  • Bash treats a number of filenames specially when they are used in redirection operators (see Redirections).
    Bash 对一些文件名在使用重定向操作符时有特殊处理（参见重定向）。
  • Bash provides the {var}<word capability to have the shell allocate file descriptors for redirections and assign them to var (see Redirections). This works with multiple redirection operators.
    Bash 提供了 {var}<word 的功能，使 shell 能够为重定向分配文件描述符，并将其分配给 var（参见重定向）。此功能适用于多个重定向操作符。
  • Bash can open network connections to arbitrary machines and services with the redirection operators (see Redirections).
    Bash 可以使用重定向操作符打开到任意机器和服务的网络连接（参见重定向）。
  • The noclobber option is available to avoid overwriting existing files with output redirection (see The Set Builtin). The ‘>|’ redirection operator may be used to override noclobber.
    noclobber 选项可用于避免使用输出重定向时覆盖现有文件（参见 set 内建命令）。‘ >| ’ 重定向操作符可用于覆盖 noclobber 。
  • Variable assignments preceding commands affect only that command, even builtins and functions (see Environment). In sh, all variable assignments preceding commands are global unless the command is executed from the file system.
    变量赋值在命令之前会影响仅该命令，即使包括内置命令和函数（参见环境）。在 sh 中，所有在命令之前的变量赋值都是全局的，除非该命令是从文件系统中执行的。
  • Bash includes a number of features to support a separate debugger for shell scripts: variables (BASH_ARGC, BASH_ARGV, BASH_LINENO, BASH_SOURCE), the DEBUG, RETURN, and ERR traps, ‘declare -F’, and the caller builtin.
    Bash 包含一些功能，以支持对 shell 脚本的独立调试器：变量（ BASH_ARGC ， BASH_ARGV ， BASH_LINENO ， BASH_SOURCE ）， DEBUG ， RETURN 和 ERR 捕获，‘ declare -F ’，以及 caller 内置命令。
  • Bash implements a csh-like directory stack, and provides the pushd, popd, and dirs builtins to manipulate it (see The Directory Stack). Bash also makes the directory stack visible as the value of the DIRSTACK shell variable.
    Bash 实现了一个类似 csh 的目录栈，并提供了 pushd ， popd 和 dirs 内置命令来操作它（参见目录栈）。Bash 还将目录栈作为 DIRSTACK shell 变量的值来显示。
  • Bash allows a function to override a builtin with the same name, and provides access to that builtin’s functionality within the function via the builtin and command builtins (see Bash Builtin Commands).
    Bash 允许函数覆盖同名的内置命令，并通过 builtin 和 command 内置命令在函数中访问该内置命令的功能（参见 Bash 内置命令）。
  • Bash includes the caller builtin (see Bash Builtin Commands), which displays the context of any active subroutine call (a shell function or a script executed with the . or source builtins). This supports the Bash debugger.
    Bash 包含 caller 内建命令（参见 Bash 内建命令），用于显示任何活动的子程序调用（一个 shell 函数或使用 . 或 source 内建命令执行的脚本）的上下文。这支持 Bash 调试器。
  • The Bash cd and pwd builtins (see Bourne Shell Builtins) each take -L and -P options to switch between logical and physical modes.
    Bash 的 cd 和 pwd 内建命令（参见 Bourne Shell 内建命令）各自接受 -L 和 -P 选项以在逻辑模式和物理模式之间切换。
  • The command builtin allows selectively skipping shell functions when performing command lookup (see Bash Builtin Commands).
    command 内建命令允许在执行命令查找时选择性地跳过 shell 函数（参见 Bash 内建命令）。
  • Bash uses the declare builtin to modify the full set of variable and function attributes, and to assign values to variables.
    Bash 使用 declare 内建命令来修改所有变量和函数属性的完整集合，并为变量赋值。
  • The disown builtin can remove a job from the internal shell job table (see Job Control Builtins) or suppress sending SIGHUP to a job when the shell exits as the result of a SIGHUP.
    disown 内置命令可以将作业从内部 shell 作业表中删除（参见 Job Control Builtins），或者在 shell 因 SIGHUP 而退出时阻止向作业发送 SIGHUP 。
  • The enable builtin (see Bash Builtin Commands) can enable or disable individual builtins and implements support for dynamically loading builtin commands from shared objects.
    enable 内置命令（参见 Bash Builtin Commands）可以启用或禁用单个内置命令，并实现从共享对象动态加载内置命令的支持。
  • The Bash exec builtin takes additional options that allow users to control the contents of the environment passed to the executed command, and what the zeroth argument to the command is to be (see Bourne Shell Builtins).
    Bash 的 exec 内置命令接受额外的选项，允许用户控制传递给执行命令的环境内容，以及该命令的零号参数（参见 Bourne Shell Builtins）。
  • Shell functions may be exported to children via the environment using export -f (see Shell Functions).
    可以通过环境将 shell 函数导出到子进程，使用 export -f （参见 Shell Functions）。
  • The Bash export and readonly builtins (see Bourne Shell Builtins can take a -f option to act on shell functions, a -p option to display variables with various attributes set in a format that can be used as shell input, a -n option to remove various variable attributes, and ‘name=value’ arguments to set variable attributes and values simultaneously.
    Bash 的 export 和 readonly 内建命令（参见 Bourne Shell 内建命令）可以接受一个 -f 选项来处理 shell 函数，一个 -p 选项来以可作为 shell 输入的格式显示具有各种属性的变量，一个 -n 选项来移除各种变量属性，并使用 ‘ name=value ’ 参数同时设置变量属性和值。
  • The Bash hash builtin allows a name to be associated with an arbitrary filename, even when that filename cannot be found by searching the $PATH, using ‘hash -p’ (see Bourne Shell Builtins).
    Bash 的 hash 内建命令允许将一个名称与任意文件名关联，即使该文件名无法通过搜索 $PATH 找到，使用 ‘ hash -p ’（参见 Bourne Shell 内建命令）。
  • Bash includes a help builtin for quick reference to shell facilities (see Bash Builtin Commands).
    Bash 包含一个 help 内建命令，用于快速查阅 shell 功能（参见 Bash 内建命令）。
  • Bash includes the mapfile builtin to quickly read the contents of a file into an indexed array variable (see Bash Builtin Commands).
    Bash 包含 mapfile 内建命令，用于快速将文件内容读取到一个索引数组变量中（参见 Bash 内建命令）。
  • The printf builtin is available to display formatted output (see Bash Builtin Commands), and has additional custom format specifiers and an option to assign the formatted output directly to a shell variable.
    printf 内置命令可用于显示格式化输出（参见 Bash 内置命令），并且具有额外的自定义格式说明符以及一个将格式化输出直接赋值给 shell 变量的选项。
  • The Bash read builtin (see Bash Builtin Commands) will read a line ending in ‘\’ with the -r option, and will use the REPLY variable as a default if no non-option arguments are supplied.
    Bash 的 read 内置命令（参见 Bash 内置命令）在使用 -r 选项时，会读取以 ‘ \ ’ 结尾的一行，并在未提供非选项参数时使用 REPLY 变量作为默认值。
  • The read builtin (see Bash Builtin Commands) accepts a prompt string with the -p option and will use Readline to obtain the line when given the -e or -E options, with the ability to insert text into the line using the -i option. The read builtin also has additional options to control input: the -s option will turn off echoing of input characters as they are read, the -t option will allow read to time out if input does not arrive within a specified number of seconds, the -n option will allow reading only a specified number of characters rather than a full line, and the -d option will read until a particular character rather than newline.
    read 内置命令（参见 Bash 内置命令）接受带有 -p 选项的提示字符串，并在给出 -e 或 -E 选项时使用 Readline 获取行，同时使用 -i 选项能够将文本插入到行中。 read 内置命令还有其他选项来控制输入： -s 选项会在读取输入字符时关闭回显， -t 选项允许 read 在指定的秒数内未收到输入时超时， -n 选项允许只读取指定数量的字符而不是整行， -d 选项则允许读取直到特定字符而不是换行符。
  • The return builtin may be used to abort execution of scripts executed with the . or source builtins (see Bourne Shell Builtins).
    return 内置命令可用于中止使用 . 或 source 内置命令执行的脚本（参见 Bourne Shell 内置命令）。
  • Bash has much more optional behavior controllable with the set builtin (see The Set Builtin).
    Bash 的 set 内置命令具有更多可选行为，可以通过其进行控制（参见 The Set Builtin）。
  • The -x (xtrace) option displays commands other than simple commands when performing an execution trace (see The Set Builtin).
    -x （ xtrace ）选项在执行跟踪时显示除简单命令以外的命令（参见 Set 内建命令）。
  • Bash includes the shopt builtin, for finer control of shell optional capabilities (see The Shopt Builtin), and allows these options to be set and unset at shell invocation (see Invoking Bash).
    Bash 包含 shopt 内建命令，用于更精细地控制 shell 的可选功能（参见 Shopt 内建命令），并且允许在启动 shell 时设置和取消这些选项（参见 Invoking Bash）。
  • The test builtin (see Bourne Shell Builtins) is slightly different, as it implements the POSIX algorithm, which specifies the behavior based on the number of arguments.
    test 内建命令（参见 Bourne Shell 内建命令）略有不同，因为它实现了 POSIX 算法，该算法根据参数的数量来指定行为。
  • The trap builtin (see Bourne Shell Builtins) allows a DEBUG pseudo-signal specification, similar to EXIT. Commands specified with a DEBUG trap are executed before every simple command, for command, case command, select command, every arithmetic for command, and before the first command executes in a shell function. The DEBUG trap is not inherited by shell functions unless the function has been given the trace attribute or the functrace option has been enabled using the shopt builtin. The extdebug shell option has additional effects on the DEBUG trap.
    trap 内建命令（参见 Bourne Shell 内建命令）允许使用 DEBUG 伪信号指定，类似于 EXIT 。使用 DEBUG trap 指定的命令会在每个简单命令、 for 命令、 case 命令、 select 命令、每次算术 for 命令以及 shell 函数中的第一个命令执行前运行。除非函数被赋予了 trace 属性或使用 shopt 内建命令启用了 functrace 选项，否则 DEBUG trap 不会被 shell 函数继承。 extdebug shell 选项对 DEBUG trap 有额外的影响。

    The trap builtin (see Bourne Shell Builtins) allows an ERR pseudo-signal specification, similar to EXIT and DEBUG. Commands specified with an ERR trap are executed after a simple command fails, with a few exceptions. The ERR trap is not inherited by shell functions unless the -o errtrace option to the set builtin is enabled.

    The trap builtin (see Bourne Shell Builtins) allows a RETURN pseudo-signal specification, similar to EXIT and DEBUG. Commands specified with a RETURN trap are executed before execution resumes after a shell function or a shell script executed with . or source returns. The RETURN trap is not inherited by shell functions unless the function has been given the trace attribute or the functrace option has been enabled using the shopt builtin.

  • The Bash type builtin is more extensive and gives more information about the names it finds (see Bash Builtin Commands).
  • The ulimit builtin provides control over many more per-process resources (see Bash Builtin Commands).
  • The Bash umask builtin uses the -p option to display the output in the form of a umask command that may be reused as input (see Bourne Shell Builtins).
    Bash umask 内置命令使用 -p 选项以显示可作为输入重新使用的 umask 命令形式的输出（参见 Bourne Shell 内置命令）。
  • The Bash wait builtin has a -n option to wait for the next child to exit, possibly selecting from a list of supplied jobs, and the -p option to store information about a terminated child process in a shell variable.
    Bash wait 内置命令有一个 -n 选项用于等待下一个子进程退出，可能从提供的作业列表中选择，还有一个 -p 选项用于将终止的子进程信息存储到 shell 变量中。
  • The SVR4.2 shell behaves differently when invoked as jsh (it turns on job control).
    当作为 jsh 调用时，SVR4.2 shell 的行为有所不同（它启用了作业控制）。
  • The SVR4.2 shell has two privilege-related builtins (mldmode and priv) not present in Bash.
    SVR4.2 shell 有两个与特权相关的内置命令（ mldmode 和 priv ），这些在 Bash 中并不存在。
  • Bash does not have the stop or newgrp builtins.
    Bash 没有 stop 或 newgrp 的内置命令。
  • Bash does not use the SHACCT variable or perform shell accounting.
    Bash 不使用 SHACCT 变量，也不执行 shell 记账。
  • The SVR4.2 sh uses a TIMEOUT variable like Bash uses TMOUT.
    SVR4.2 的 sh 使用一个 TIMEOUT 变量，就像 Bash 使用 TMOUT 一样。

More features unique to Bash may be found in Bash Features.
更多 Bash 独有的特性可以在 Bash Features 中找到。

  • Implementation Differences From The SVR4.2 Shell
    实现与 SVR4.2 Shell 的不同之处

B.1 Implementation Differences From The SVR4.2 Shell ¶
B.1 实现与 SVR4.2 Shell 的不同之处 ¶

Since Bash is a completely new implementation, it does not suffer from many of the limitations of the SVR4.2 shell. For instance:
由于 Bash 是一个全新的实现，它不会受到 SVR4.2 shell 的许多限制。例如：

  • Bash does not fork a subshell when redirecting into or out of a shell control structure such as an if or while statement.
    当重定向进入或离开一个 shell 控制结构（如 if 或 while 语句）时，Bash 不会创建子 shell。
  • Bash does not allow unbalanced quotes. The SVR4.2 shell will silently insert a needed closing quote at EOF under certain circumstances. This can be the cause of some hard-to-find errors.
    Bash 不允许不匹配的引号。SVR4.2 shell 在某些情况下会静默地在 EOF 处插入所需的闭合引号。这可能是某些难以发现的错误的原因。
  • The SVR4.2 shell uses a baroque memory management scheme based on trapping SIGSEGV. If the shell is started from a process with SIGSEGV blocked (e.g., by using the system() C library function call), it misbehaves badly.
    SVR4.2 shell 使用基于捕获 SIGSEGV 的复杂内存管理方案。如果 shell 从一个将 SIGSEGV 阻塞的进程启动（例如通过使用 system() C 库函数调用），它会表现得很糟糕。
  • In a questionable attempt at security, the SVR4.2 shell, when invoked without the -p option, will alter its real and effective UID and GID if they are less than some magic threshold value, commonly 100. This can lead to unexpected results.
    在一次有疑问的安全尝试中，当 SVR4.2 shell 被调用而未使用 -p 选项时，如果其真实和有效 UID 和 GID 小于某个魔法阈值（通常为 100），它会更改这些 UID 和 GID。这可能导致意外的结果。
  • The SVR4.2 shell does not allow users to trap SIGSEGV, SIGALRM, or SIGCHLD.
    SVR4.2 shell 不允许用户捕获 SIGSEGV 、 SIGALRM 或 SIGCHLD 。
  • The SVR4.2 shell does not allow the IFS, MAILCHECK, PATH, PS1, or PS2 variables to be unset.
    SVR4.2 shell 不允许取消设置 IFS 、 MAILCHECK 、 PATH 、 PS1 或 PS2 变量。
  • The SVR4.2 shell treats ‘^’ as the undocumented equivalent of ‘|’.
    SVR4.2 shell 将‘ ^ ’视为未文档化的等同于‘ | ’。
  • Bash allows multiple option arguments when it is invoked (-x -v); the SVR4.2 shell allows only one option argument (-xv). In fact, some versions of the shell dump core if the second argument begins with a ‘-’.
    Bash 允许在调用时有多个选项参数（ -x -v ）；SVR4.2 shell 只允许一个选项参数（ -xv ）。实际上，某些版本的 shell 如果第二个参数以‘ - ’开头，会导致核心转储。
  • The SVR4.2 shell exits a script if any builtin fails; Bash exits a script only if one of the POSIX special builtins fails, and only for certain failures, as enumerated in the POSIX standard.
    如果任何内置命令失败，SVR4.2 shell 会退出脚本；Bash 仅在 POSIX 特殊内置命令失败时退出脚本，并且仅在 POSIX 标准中列举的某些失败情况下退出。
  • If the lastpipe option is enabled, and job control is not active, Bash runs the last element of a pipeline in the current shell execution environment.
    如果启用了 lastpipe 选项，并且没有启用作业控制，Bash 会在当前 shell 的执行环境中运行管道的最后一个元素。
